developments.title: A $1.2 Billion Dairy Investment Is Planned for Pennsylvania
developments.summary: A dairy company plans to build a 1.5-million-square-foot manufacturing campus in Allentown, Pennsylvania, at an estimated cost of $1.2 billion. The facility is intended to make higher-protein, lower-sugar dairy products and support more than 900 jobs.

developments.title: Skim Milk Powder Lifted the Global Dairy Trade Index
developments.summary: Skim milk powder prices rose 5.3% at the latest Global Dairy Trade auction, lifting the overall index by 0.9%. The SMP index reached $3,665 per tonne, $110 above whole milk powder, as milk supplies increased across major producing regions.

developments.title: Skim Milk Powder Gains a Premium Over Whole Milk Powder
developments.summary: Skim Milk Powder has moved above Whole Milk Powder in price on international dairy markets. Rising demand for concentrated dairy proteins and lower Chinese inventories are supporting the shift, while supply constraints are limiting export availability.

developments.title: Irish Dairy Companies Stand to Benefit From €11.6bn Whey Market by 2030
developments.summary: Irish dairy processors are positioned to gain from the global whey-protein market, which a sector report values at €7.7bn in 2025 and projects will reach €11.6bn by 2030. Tirlán, Glanbia Nutritionals, Kerry Group and Carbery Group are identified among the principal market participants.

developments.title: China’s Domestic Dairy Enterprises 2026 H1 Reports: Revenue Recovers as Giants Diverge on Profits
developments.summary: China's dairy giants post H1 2026 revenue rebound as raw milk gluts ease, though Yili and Mengniu diverge on profits amid portfolio shifts.

developments.title: Chobani Investing $1.2B in Pennsylvania Facility, Seeking Huge Share of In-State Milk
developments.summary: Chobani invests $1.2B in Allentown, PA to process 3B lbs of local milk annually into high-protein dairy, creating 900 jobs in historic state deal.

developments.title: Grass-fed dairy: Ireland eyes Asia’s premium nutrition boom
developments.summary: Ireland has its sights on Asia's growing premium nutrition market, positioning its grass-fed dairy credentials to meet rising demand for quality dairy products

developments.title: Keurig Dr Pepper to sell stake – and factory – to Chobani
developments.summary: Keurig Dr Pepper has agreed to exit its shareholding in Chobani and sell a manufacturing and warehousing site to the dairy group. The post Keurig Dr Pepper to sell stake – and factory – to Chobani appeared first on Just Food .

developments.title: El Rosquinense Produces Up to 800 Tonnes and Expands Exports
developments.summary: Argentina’s El Rosquinense, which is marking its 50th anniversary, produces between 700 and 800 tonnes of dulce de leche each month. The family-owned company added Brazil and Bolivia to its export markets in 2026 and is seeking a third new destination, potentially Paraguay or Colombia.

developments.title: Milk Replacers Market Is Projected to Reach $10.1bn by 2035
developments.summary: The global milk replacers market is projected to rise from $4.9bn in 2025 to $10.1bn by 2035, with a compound annual growth rate of 7.4% from 2026 to 2035. Non-medicated products, ruminants, milk-based formulations and powders held the leading positions in 2025.

developments.title: Manchego Cheese Producers Seek Aid as Milk Prices Fall
developments.summary: The Manchego Cheese designation of origin will request direct payments for each sheep after farms lost profitability. Producers say they need between €1.90 and €2 per litre to maintain the activity, while the milk price has fallen to €1.30.

developments.title: Mennonite Farmers Take Most Federal Farm Credit in Chihuahua
developments.summary: Mennonite communities and producers receive most agricultural credit issued by Mexico’s federal development bank in Chihuahua, particularly through FIRA. Their access is linked in the report to highly mechanised operations, available collateral and established credit records, while traditional smallholders face a renewed debate over unequal financing.

developments.title: Country Delight targets a $200m-$300m IPO
developments.summary: Country Delight is preparing for a possible initial public offering that could raise between $200m and $300m. Its parent company, Beejapuri Dairy, is expected to start informal talks with investment banks about appointing lead managers.

developments.title: Uruguayan producer awaits six-year approval to sell pasteurised milk
developments.summary: Ademar Martínez has spent six years seeking permission to operate a milk pasteurising and bagging machine imported from Argentina. The equipment remains at the University of the Republic’s Faculty of Veterinary Medicine and is currently used only for teaching.

developments.title: A New Zealand Farmer Changed Four Calving Practices
developments.summary: A New Zealand dairy farmer revised four parts of the spring-calving routine to reduce operational pressure and improve herd welfare. The changes covered farm infrastructure, colostrum handling, staff organisation and responses to mounting workload pressure.

developments.title: Great Britain Produces 3% More Milk With Its Smallest Dairy Herd
developments.summary: Great Britain’s milk production increased by 3% while its dairy herd fell to the lowest level recorded in its history. The herd stood at 1.57 million head as output reached 12,931 million litres.

developments.title: Assam Sets Five-Year Dairy Expansion Plan
developments.summary: Assam has outlined a five-year plan to raise milk output, widen dairy-cooperative participation and increase processing capacity. The state currently produces 33.53 lakh litres of milk a day, while 4.20 lakh litres of additional daily processing capacity is under development.

developments.title: Jammu and Kashmir FDA Prohibits Sale of 10 Ghee Batches
developments.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir Food and Drugs Administration has stopped the sale, storage, distribution and display of 10 identified ghee brands and batches across the Union Territory. Laboratory examinations found foreign vegetable fat and other departures from prescribed food-safety requirements.

developments.title: Woolworths Changes Colby Cheese Slices, Prompting Consumer Debate
developments.summary: Woolworths has changed the pack format of its private-label Colby cheese slices in Australia. The product now contains 30 slices, up from 24, prompting discussion among shoppers about packaging, portions and value.

developments.title: Tesco Northern Ireland Adds Drayne’s Farm Ice Cream
developments.summary: Tesco Northern Ireland has begun selling two Drayne’s Farm ice-cream flavours in 950ml tubs at most of its large stores in the region. The move expands Tesco’s locally sourced range and gives the Lisburn-based family dairy a wider retail presence.

developments.title: Milky Mist reports net profit rising over 1,000% to ₹64.5 crore
developments.summary: Milky Mist’s first-quarter net profit rose by more than 1,000% to ₹64.5 crore, while revenue increased 45%. The company recorded stronger sales in yogurt and ice cream, alongside higher operating margins.

developments.title: Grupo Lala launches the “Échale Un Poquito Más” campaign
developments.summary: Grupo Lala has introduced a national campaign celebrating Mexican cuisine and promoting household use of cream and cheese. The initiative combines culinary traditions with new product formats and recipes aimed at increasing the versatility and frequency of dairy consumption.

developments.title: Wales Seeks Nominations for Outstanding Dairy Service Award
developments.summary: The Farmers’ Union of Wales and NatWest Cymru are accepting nominations for an award recognising an individual’s contribution to the Welsh dairy industry. The recipient will be announced and honoured at the Welsh Dairy Show on October 20, 2026.

developments.title: Invima Has Alerted Colombia to 42 Products Containing Whey Protein
developments.summary: Colombia’s National Food and Drug Surveillance Institute, Invima, has issued a health alert covering 42 products sold in the country. Several are whey-protein formulations marketed with claims associated with sports, nutritional or energy supplements.

developments.title: Woolworths Sparks Consumer Debate Over Changes to Colby Cheese Slices
developments.summary: Woolworths shoppers react to changes in private-label Colby cheese slices as consumers closely track dairy pricing, packaging, and product value.

developments.title: Skim Milk Powder Lights Up Global Dairy Market as Protein Demand Inverts Price Ratio
developments.summary: Demand for milk protein and falling Chinese stocks drive skim milk powder prices above whole milk powder, shifting global dairy trading dynamics.

developments.title: Irish Dairy Companies Poised to Benefit from €11.6B Global Whey Protein Boom
developments.summary: Irish dairy processors set to capture growth as global whey protein market reaches €11.6B by 2030, driven by clinical, sports, and functional demand.

developments.title: Four Things That Changed One Farmer’s Approach to Calving
developments.summary: Practical shifts in calf infrastructure, colostrum protocols, and team scheduling transform the demanding spring calving season for a NZ dairy farmer.

developments.title: Elevating Dairy: Industry Leaders Focus on Adding Value, Sustainability, and Brand Equity
developments.summary: Australian dairy focuses on premium value-add products, sustainability, and on-farm innovation to elevate the sector and strengthen market margins.

developments.title: GlobalDairyTrade Up 0.9%: Who Wins and Who Loses?
developments.summary: The Global Dairy Trade recorded another increase in its price index at Auction No. 411, held on September 1, 2026, with an average winning price of USD 3,910 per metric ton and strong participation from international buyers.

developments.title: The 3 Signals Your Dairy Plant is Ready for Automation
developments.summary: Dairy manufacturers are under constant pressure to protect throughput, safety, and product quality while managing labor availability and tight capital budgets. For many plants, palletizing remains one of the most physically demanding, injury-prone tasks on [Read More ...]

developments.title: Ohio Supreme Court rules in employee safety case on dairy farm
developments.summary: On August 12, the Ohio Supreme Court released its opinion Camara v. Gill Dairy, L.L.C. The majority opinion was written by Justice Brunner and joined by all of the justices, except for one section that Justice Fischer [Read More ...]

developments.title: Tennessee Celebrates Local Dairy Farm Families with New Statewide Campaign
developments.summary: Launches “From Our Farm to Your Family,” honoring the people and communities making an impact on local dairy industry. The Dairy Alliance, a nonprofit organization funded by dairy farm families in the Southeast, in partnership [Read More ...]

developments.title: California Dairy Farmers Work Together to Innovate and Advance Manure Management
developments.summary: Dairy farmers have long paid careful attention to manure management, as it is central to operational efficiency and to supplying nutrients for feed crop production. As science evolves, so has the sector’s understanding of how [Read More ...]

developments.title: Expo en Español Offers Practical Insights for Dairy Professionals
developments.summary: Expo en Español Offers Practical Insights for Dairy Professionals Expo en Español is World Dairy Expo’s educational program created specifically for Spanish-speaking professionals in the dairy industry. Presented entirely in Spanish, these seminars provide practical [Read More ...]

developments.title: Chobani buys back Keurig Dr Pepper’s $800M stake as it invests $1.2B in Pennsylvania plant
developments.summary: Chobani’s $1.2 billion investment will convert a former KDP production facility that initially manufactured La Colombe products into a milk production plant as part of Chobani's multi-billion dollar manufacturing network expansion across the US.

developments.title: Brazil's Condensed-Milk Industry Follows a Precision Process
developments.summary: Brazil is among the world’s largest condensed-milk producers, using a controlled industrial process to preserve the product’s taste, colour and texture. The method combines sugar, vacuum evaporation and controlled crystallisation before the cream is sealed in sterilised cans.

developments.title: A Milk Test Determines Whether It Can Become Cheese in São Paulo
developments.summary: A visual check known as the black-cup test is used before milking proceeds at a farm in São Paulo state. Quality controls continue through cooling, transport and factory processing, while university students in Sorocaba are trained to detect adulteration such as added water or whey.

developments.title: Soprole launches Chile’s first oat-piece yoghurt in an aseptic carton
developments.summary: Soprole has introduced Yoghurt con Avena, described as the first stirred yoghurt with oat pieces sold in Chile in an aseptic carton. The product uses SIG Drinksplus, a technology being applied for the first time in the country.

developments.title: Machine Learning-Based Assessment and Forecasting of Temperature–Humidity Index for Dairy Heat Stress Using Multivariate and Panel Data Approaches in Bihar, India
developments.summary: Heat stress has become a major constraint to dairy production under changing climatic conditions, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions. This study investigated the spatial and temporal dynamics of the Temperature-Humidity Index (THI) and evaluated machine learning approaches for predicting dairy heat stress across five major dairy-producing districts of Biha

developments.title: Uruguay Will Convene Dairy Industry for International Congress
developments.summary: Uruguay’s dairy industry will meet in Nueva Helvecia on October 1st and 2nd for the 11th International Dairy Industry Congress. The programme will cover processing, industrial automation, international trade and changing patterns of dairy consumption.

developments.title: Costa Rica’s Dairy Producers Warn of Competition from CPTPP Accession
developments.summary: Costa Rica’s dairy producers have raised concerns about the possible country’s entry into the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP). They say wider market access could expose domestic suppliers to stronger competition from major exporters, while the government says membership could open markets and attract investment.

developments.title: Canada Proposes Tariffs That Could Affect U.S. Dairy Shipments
developments.summary: U.S. milk production rose 2.2% year over year in July, reaching 20.1bn pounds, while the milking herd grew to 9.71m head. Canada has proposed duties of 15% to 50% on U.S. dairy products, including a 50% rate on fluid milk, cream and whey.

developments.title: Pāmu’s record FY26 result supports its Crown farming role
developments.summary: New Zealand’s state-owned farming enterprise Pāmu reported a 131% rise in net operating profit to $113m for the 2026 financial year. It also recorded a 33% increase in after-tax profit and will pay $40m in dividends to the Crown.

developments.title: What Do Canada’s Tariffs Mean for Your Milk Check?
developments.summary: Proposed Canadian tariffs of up to 50% on $1.3B in U.S. dairy threaten milk checks as rising production and cheese stocks pressure farm margins.

developments.title: Wisconsin Dairy Farmers Leverage Beef-on-Dairy to Connect with Consumers and Boost Farm Margins
developments.summary: Wisconsin dairy farms leverage beef-on-dairy crossbreeding and direct-to-consumer sales to diversify income and connect with local consumers.

developments.title: UK Dairy Sector Navigates New Fairer Contract Regulations to Boost Supply Chain Fairness
developments.summary: UK enforces fairer dairy contract regulations, ensuring transparent pricing and dispute terms between dairy farmers and milk processors.

developments.title: Why This Dairy Farmer Spreads Manure Days Before Corn Harvest
developments.summary: Learn why applying dairy manure days before corn harvest maximizes nitrogen retention, eases fall labor, and boosts cover crop establishment.

developments.title: How Global Events will Impact Ag Markets, Businesses and Farms
developments.summary: Connect with leading experts during interactive webinars. This week’s episodes of The Dairy Signal® from Professional Dairy Producers® (PDP) will take a look at the issues, trends and events shaping the agricultural economy and how [Read More ...]

developments.title: Joseph Gallo Farms Earns Three Awards at World Dairy Expo Championship Dairy Product Contest
developments.summary: Awards recognize excellence in cheese and whey protein concentrate Joseph Gallo Farms earned three awards at the 2026 World Dairy Expo Championship Dairy Product Contest, with results announced Wednesday, recognizing both Joseph Farms cheese [Read More ...]

developments.title: Yili retains world’s most valuable dairy brand title as brand value jumps 29%
developments.summary: Yili retains world’s most valuable dairy brand title as brand value jumps 29%

developments.title: ‘All about health’: Bebop takes dairy-free ice cream across APAC
developments.summary: Bebop is targeting APAC markets with a dairy-free, plant-fat ice cream as it seeks to scale beyond Taiwan.

developments.title: US dairy Foremost Farms to close cheese plant
developments.summary: US dairy cooperative Foremost Farms is planning to shut a facility just as the industry is said to be investing $13bn in production. The post US dairy Foremost Farms to close cheese plant appeared first on Just Food .

developments.title: Abbott launches five-HMO Similac 360 Total Care in America
developments.summary: Abbott launches five-HMO Similac 360 Total Care in America

developments.title: Foremost Farms will close Wisconsin cheese plant
developments.summary: Foremost Farms plans to shut its Marshfield, Wisconsin, cheese facility in December, eliminating 68 jobs. The co-operative will also stop making 40lb block cheese, citing changes in the US dairy market and consumer demand.

developments.title: A Brazilian Bill Seeks to Recognise the Queijista Profession
developments.summary: A bill before Brazil’s Chamber of Deputies would regulate the work of professionals who sell cheese and advise consumers. The proposal defines the role across specialist shops and other food retailers, while the sector is developing training for the occupation.

developments.title: Dairy Farmers Press State as Producer Prices Fall and Retail Costs Rise
developments.summary: Dairy farmers in Mato Grosso do Sul have taken their demands for support to Campo Grande’s municipal council. Their requests include tax relief for milk, better rural electricity, public funding and state purchases of locally produced dairy goods.

developments.title: Reliance enters India’s ice-cream market with Bombay Creamery
developments.summary: Reliance Consumer Products has launched Bombay Creamery, an ice-cream brand made with real dairy cream and priced from ₹10. The company will first sell the products in western India before expanding distribution nationwide.

developments.title: An electric truck begins collecting milk in the Netherlands
developments.summary: Van Der Mierden Transport has added a DAF XD Electric to its fleet for mobile milk collection in the Netherlands. The truck will gather milk from farms along scheduled regional routes before taking it to dairy processors.

developments.title: К вопросу об аспектах использования витамина Е в рационах молочного скота
developments.summary: В статье обобщены современные сведения о роли витамина Е в кормлении крупного рогатого скота, в частности молочных коров: его химическая природа и антиоксидантные свойства, метаболизм у жвачных животных, включая всасывание RRR--токоферола и биодоступность синтетических форм. developments.title: Pasture diversity and regenerative management shape ruminant gut microbiome dynamics within a real multi-year farming system
developments.summary: The ruminant gut microbiome is central to feed conversion efficiency, nutrient utilisation, and animal health, yet how pasture diversity and management shape its composition over time under real, working farm conditions remains poorly understood, as most previous studies have relied on short-term or more tightly controlled comparisons. A multi-year study (2022–2025) investigated gut microbial dyna

developments.title: Bebop Expands Dairy-Free Ice Cream Across Asia-Pacific
developments.summary: GTE Foods has launched Bebop, a dairy-free ice cream brand made entirely from plant fats, in several Asia-Pacific markets. The product aims to offer a healthier alternative for ice cream lovers, using a mix of ingredients like cashew and coconut to replicate traditional textures.

developments.title: Argentina’s Milk Producer Price Lagged Industry Value by 21.4 Points
developments.summary: The price paid to Argentine milk producers trailed the value generated by the dairy industry by 21.4 points during the period analysed. Higher processing, energy, labour and logistics costs absorbed part of the improvement in factory-gate values, while weak domestic purchasing power constrained price increases.

developments.title: Wisconsin Dairy Farmers Expand Beef-on-Dairy Sales
developments.summary: Wisconsin dairy farms are using beef-on-dairy breeding and direct meat sales to diversify revenue as milk prices fluctuate. The approach allows producers to market locally sourced beef through farm businesses and regional outlets while maintaining closer contact with consumers.

developments.title: Moody’s Reaffirms Sigma Alimentos’ Credit Rating
developments.summary: Moody’s has reaffirmed the credit rating of Sigma Alimentos, citing the company’s geographic diversification, resilient cash flow and financial discipline. The Alfa subsidiary operates across Mexico, the United States, Europe and Hispanic America in refrigerated foods, processed meats and dairy products.

developments.title: Amul Becomes the World’s Strongest Dairy Brand in 2026
developments.summary: Amul has taken the top position for dairy-brand strength in Brand Finance’s 2026 ranking, recording a Brand Strength Index score of 93 out of 100. Yili remains the most valuable dairy brand financially, with a brand value of $14.5bn.

developments.title: UK Dairy Rules Set Fairer Supply-Chain Standards
developments.summary: New regulations in the UK dairy sector require processors to use clearer contracts and more transparent pricing arrangements. The rules also introduce formal procedures for resolving disputes between producers and processors.

developments.title: Norco report reveals worsening farmer mental health and food-security threat
developments.summary: A national study by Norco and the Black Dog Institute found that 54% of Australian farmers had felt depressed or down during the past two years. It also found that 41% had considered leaving agriculture, amid reported financial, climate and operating pressures.

developments.title: Drought Cuts Irish Dairy Output and Farm Revenue
developments.summary: Drought conditions reduced Irish dairy farmers’ milk output in late summer, while higher feed costs and lower milk prices put pressure on farm incomes. Average milk yield fell to 20.68kg per cow by late August, and a representative 100-cow herd recorded a monthly revenue shortfall of about €6,745 compared with the previous year.

developments.title: Gulfood Manufacturing 2026 to Take Place in Dubai on November 3–5
developments.summary: Gulfood Manufacturing 2026, an exhibition dedicated to food manufacturing technologies, will take place at the Dubai World Trade Centre on November 3–5. Its main themes will include food security, localisation of production, automation and the expansion of processing capacity in the UAE and other Gulf countries.

developments.title: Dairy Management Inc. opens 2027 product competition
developments.summary: Dairy Management Inc. is inviting US university students to submit dairy-based products for its 2027 New Product Competition. The contest will focus on products designed to provide sustained energy, with entries due by February 1, 2027.

developments.title: Gen Z demand for British dairy rises
developments.summary: Purchase intent for dairy among Gen Z increased by three percentage points between September 2025 and January 2026. AHDB’s Let’s Eat Balanced campaign will run across television, digital media and supermarkets from September 1 to 30, with a target of reaching 80% of main shoppers.

developments.title: Jersey Dairy’s new kefir sells out within two weeks
developments.summary: Jersey Dairy sold its first batch of kefir in less than two weeks, after demand exceeded expectations. The company then bottled a second batch that was twice as large.

developments.title: Rabobank Reports $267bn in Revenue for the World’s 20 Largest Dairy Companies
developments.summary: Rabobank’s Global Dairy Top 20 ranking reports combined revenue of $267bn for the world’s 20 largest dairy companies. Their revenues increased by 5.4% during 2025, while Lactalis retained the leading position and European companies accounted for half of the ranking.

developments.title: Milky Mist Dairy Food, Manali Petrochemicals, Vardhman Textiles and Godrej Agrovet rose
developments.summary: Four Indian stocks advanced on September 1 despite limited movement in the benchmark indices and weakness across most sectors. Milky Mist Dairy Food gained 9.5%, Manali Petrochemicals 8%, Vardhman Textiles 11.7% and Godrej Agrovet 10% during the session.

developments.title: Paneer demand places Milky Mist on a stronger growth track
developments.summary: Milky Mist Dairy Food is making paneer the centre of its next growth phase as demand for packaged dairy products rises in India. The company has capacity for about 150 tonnes of paneer a day, while organised producers account for only 6–7% of the national market.

developments.title: Milky Mist reports an 829% rise in quarterly profit
developments.summary: Milky Mist Dairy Food reported a sharp increase in profit, revenue and EBITDA in the first quarter of FY2026-27. Sales of value-added dairy products, including yogurt, ice cream, cheese, paneer and curd, increased during the quarter.

developments.title: El Niño Cuts Huila Milk Production by 30%
developments.summary: Milk output in Colombia’s Huila department has fallen by about 30% amid high temperatures and reduced access to water and forage. The Huila Cattlemen’s Committee said the region is producing roughly 120,000 fewer litres a day than usual.

developments.title: The Royal Bath & West Dairy Show will return in 2026
developments.summary: The Royal Bath & West Dairy Show is scheduled for October 7, 2026, at the Bath & West Showground. The event will feature livestock competitions, national breed shows, agricultural displays and the return of its AgriForum programme.

developments.title: A Mid Wales Farm Sale Drew a Large Crowd
developments.summary: A dispersal auction at Bryn-y-Maes, near Newtown, attracted a large crowd last Saturday. A 2003 John Deere tractor achieved the highest price at £17,500, while equipment from 20 neighbouring farms was also offered.

developments.title: Hatsun and Kwality Wall’s Show Promoter Holdings Above 60%
developments.summary: Hatsun Agro Products and Kwality Wall’s (India) have promoter ownership of 73.17% and 61.91%, respectively, according to the latest shareholding filings cited in the supplied data. The two listed dairy companies have different business profiles, with Hatsun operating across several dairy categories and Kwality Wall’s focused on ice cream after its demerger from Hindustan Unilever.

developments.title: Two Punjab Sisters Build a 22-Animal Dairy Farm
developments.summary: Jashanpreet and Supandeep Kaur have expanded one buffalo into a 22-animal dairy operation in Fazilka, Punjab. The family enterprise produces about 100kg of milk a day and earns roughly ₹5,000 in daily revenue.

developments.title: Agalep asks Peru’s Constitutional Court to preserve evaporated-milk rules
developments.summary: Agalep has asked Peru’s Constitutional Court to retain the regulation reserving the term “evaporated milk” for products made with fresh milk. The producers’ association said national production had increased by 4.5% a year over the past two years.

developments.title: Alquería Will Change Its CEO After Doubling Colombian Business
developments.summary: Rafael Álvarez will leave Alquería’s chief executive position at the end of November, after seven years leading the Colombian dairy company. The board has begun selecting his successor and says the company’s strategy and day-to-day operations will remain unchanged during the transition.

developments.title: Fonterra Raises Milk Collections as Dairy Demand Shifts
developments.summary: Fonterra has increased its milk intake as global dairy production gradually recovers across major exporting regions. The additional supply is reaching international markets while buyers adjust their purchasing and procurement strategies.

developments.title: A meta-analysis links 50g of yoghurt to 7% lower diabetes risk
developments.summary: A meta-analysis of 483,090 people found that each additional 50 grams of yoghurt consumed daily was associated with a 7% lower risk of developing type 2 diabetes. The finding describes an association rather than proof that yoghurt alone prevents the disease.

developments.title: Dairy Farmers Apply Manure Before Corn Harvest
developments.summary: Some dairy producers are applying liquid manure to standing corn several days before silage chopping or grain harvest. The approach uses drop hoses and toolbar equipment to move nutrient management earlier in the season while preparing fields for subsequent cover-crop establishment.

developments.title: J&K FDA Bans Sale of 10 Ghee Batches
developments.summary: The J&K Food and Drug Administration has prohibited the sale of 10 ghee batches after official laboratory tests found failures against statutory composition requirements. Enforcement teams seized affected stocks and ordered food businesses to recall the batches from the market.

developments.title: Functional Beverage Innovations Drive Consumer Interest and Demand
developments.summary: Functional beverages are gaining popularity as consumers prioritize health benefits. New drinks targeting specific needs such as cognitive support and nutrition are emerging, showcasing brands like BrainFood and H2Pro+ Protein Water. Consumer demand for energy without caffeine and protein-packed options is on the rise.

developments.title: Foreign Tourists Popularized a Banana Flavored Drink in Korea
developments.summary: Foreign tourists have created a popular banana-flavored milk drink in Korea by combining it with hazelnut coffee. Retailers are responding by offering the ingredients as a set at convenience stores.

developments.title: Winston Peters Denies Utu or Corporate Lobbying Behind Dairy Policy Aimed at Fonterra’s Dominance
developments.summary: Winston Peters denies political revenge behind NZ First's plan to lift independent processors' access to Fonterra milk tenfold under DIRA.

developments.title: Fonterra Lifts Milk Collections as Global Dairy Demand Shifts
developments.summary: Fonterra reports higher milk collections as global supply expands, optimizing its product mix amid shifting international demand and trade flows.

developments.title: Milk Production Hit Hard by Drought with Irish Dairy Farm Incomes Falling
developments.summary: Drought reduces Irish milk output to 20.68kg/cow as rising feed costs and lower prices cut monthly cheques by €6,700 for a 100-cow herd.

developments.title: Pāmu’s Record FY26 Result Confirms Logic of Crown Tenure and Operating Model
developments.summary: Pāmu posts record FY26 operating profit of $113M (up 131%), returning $40M in Crown dividends through regional clustering and beef-on-dairy growth.

developments.title: U.S. Dairy Export Council Brings ‘The Great American Cheese Road Trip’ to Melbourne
developments.summary: The U.S. Dairy Export Council (USDEC) will take Australian food and beverage industry guests on a Great American Cheese Road Trip this September, showcasing the diversity, versatility and creativity of U.S. cheese and its place [Read More ...]

developments.title: Dairy Checkoff Seeks Entries For 2027 New Product Competition
developments.summary: Dairy Management Inc. (DMI) is accepting entries for its 2027 New Product Competition, challenging undergraduate and graduate students across the United States to develop innovative dairy-based products for consumers seeking sustained energy. In dairy herds, the disease impairs milking, causes cutaneous lesions and bleeding, and predisposes animals to mastitis. developments.summary: Although parity affects dairy cow physiology, feed intake, productivity and methane emissions, little is known about how it affects rumen microbial symbioses under commercial management. Parity reconfigures the composition and roles of rumen microbes, with measurable consequences on production parameters in Holstein cows. developments.summary: With the rise of vegan diets and increased reports of lactose intolerance, plant-based diets, including plant-based milk products (PBMP), offer an interesting alternative. In addition, PBMP, as a treasure trove of bioactive compounds, is reported to improve human health by promoting food sustainability, reducing environmental pollution, and supporting an eco-friendly approach. developments.summary: Introduction The lactating Xinjiang Junggar camel is a major dairy breed with excellent milk production performance. In northern Xinjiang, camels are mainly reared under traditional grazing, while those in southern Xinjiang are raised under barn feeding due to grassland scarcity. developments.title: Long-term GreenFeed monitoring of enteric methane emissions in lactating buffaloes
developments.summary: The GreenFeed (GF) system is widely regarded as the silver standard for measuring individual enteric methane (CH 4 ) emissions; however, it has not previously been used in dairy buffaloes ( Bubalus bubalis ). developments.summary: To address the impact of changes in dairy cow posture on intelligent body condition scoring, this study proposes a dairy cow body condition scoring model (ME-PointNeXt). developments.title: Three Factors May Pressure Brazilian Milk Producers in Coming Months
developments.summary: Brazilian milk producers face weaker international demand, increased dairy imports and uncertainty over production costs. Imports exceeded 200m litres of milk equivalent from March to July, while an international quotation fell from about US$3,800 to US$3,500 per tonne.

developments.title: U.S.-Mexico Trade Talks Stall Over Cheese Names
developments.summary: U.S. trade officials and dairy-export groups are challenging provisions linked to the EU-Mexico pact that would restrict non-European producers' use of common cheese names. The dispute concerns terms including parmesan, feta and asiago, and has implications for a U.S. cheese market in Mexico worth about $1bn a year.

developments.title: CoBank Says U.S. Dairy Industry Is Raising Milk Protein
developments.summary: The U.S. dairy industry is increasing efforts to raise protein levels in milk as pricing formulas and industry initiatives place greater emphasis on protein. CoBank said protein production began exceeding butterfat production last August, although U.S. milk still has lower protein levels than supplies from the European Union and New Zealand.

developments.title: CARB provisionally approves H2B2’s Bar 20 hydrogen project
developments.summary: California’s Air Resources Board has provisionally approved a project that will convert biogas from methane lagoons at Bar 20 dairy farm into hydrogen for transport fuel. The project received a carbon-intensity score of -1,887.35 grams of CO₂-equivalent per megajoule, the lowest recorded under the state’s Low Carbon Fuel Standard.

developments.title: Brazil's Tax Reform Places Milk and Dairy in an Environmental Dilemma
developments.summary: A study estimates that Brazil's tax reform would increase food-related emissions while reducing the tax burden on milk and other dairy products. Researchers say the reform could raise consumption and emissions unless environmental criteria are included in the tax system.

developments.title: Argentina now sends 29% of dairy output abroad
developments.summary: Argentina is exporting 29% of its dairy production, according to Sebastián Alconada, the national director of dairy farming. He presented the figure at the 119th Rafaela Rural Expo, where he said dairy foreign trade had recorded consecutive records.

developments.title: Irish dairy farmers warn that unstable incomes are causing a succession crisis
developments.summary: The Irish Creamery Milk Suppliers’ Association has urged the government to address highly volatile farm incomes before Budget 2027. Its president, Denis Drennan, said income uncertainty was deterring younger members of farm families from taking over their holdings.

Gene editing of the myostatin (MSTN) gene represents a promising strategy to enhance muscle growth in cattle. developments.title: Sustainable forage crop production systems for fodder security: A review
developments.summary: Livestock farming significantly contributes to India's agricultural sector by supporting rural livelihoods, food and nutritional security, employment and sustainable farming practices. India supports approximately 536.7 million livestock; however, only about 4 % of its cultivable land is devoted to fodder production, resulting in a persistent shortage of quality feed resources. developments.title: Cattle Markets Increase Revenue for U.S. Dairy Farms
developments.summary: Strong prices for culled cows and beef-cross calves are providing U.S. dairy farms with additional income. Low beef-cow numbers, limited slaughter supplies and continuing consumer demand for red meat have increased the value of livestock sales.

developments.title: Argentina’s Dairy Industry Changes Ownership as Companies Advance
developments.summary: Argentina’s dairy industry is undergoing a shift in ownership, with Gloria, MIYM, Arcor and Danone gaining ground. SanCor, ARSA and Verónica are facing crisis, sale or restructuring processes, while companies compete for plants, brands and industrial capacity.

developments.title: Nestlé Will Replace Región Plata with Cono Sur Unit
developments.summary: Nestlé will bring Chile, Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay under a new Cono Sur organisation from January 1st 2027, ending their current arrangement as Región Plata. Rodrigo Camacho, the company’s Chile chief executive, will lead the consolidated operation from Chile.

developments.title: Momchilovtsi Festival Showcases Rhodope Dairy and Bulgarian-Chinese Traditions
developments.summary: The traditional Yogurt Festival in Momchilovtsi presented dairy, farm and craft products from the Rhodopes and elsewhere in Bulgaria. Organised with China’s Bright Dairy, the event also featured a Chinese pavilion, cultural programmes and a EUR 36,000 donation for the village sports ground.

developments.title: Galicia lost 88% of its dairy farms but produces more milk
developments.summary: Galicia now has about 4,800 active dairy farms, down from more than 39,000 in 1999. Annual milk production has nevertheless risen to above 3m tonnes, from less than 2m tonnes two decades ago.

developments.title: Misantla Expands Leche para el Bienestar Coverage for Vulnerable Families
developments.summary: Misantla, Veracruz, held a registration drive for the federal Leche para el Bienestar milk programme in coordination with the municipal DIF and federal agriculture promoters. The initiative is intended to bring subsidised pasteurised milk to vulnerable households in urban neighbourhoods and rural communities.

developments.title: Arla Plans Further Investment as Protein Demand Surges
developments.summary: Arla Foods plans to increase investment in its ingredients business as demand and prices for dairy proteins rise. Arla Foods Ingredients reported first-half revenue of €867 million, up 19.3% from a year earlier.

developments.title: Kenya Expands ANITRAC Livestock Traceability Nationwide
developments.summary: Kenya is extending its Animal Identification and Traceability System across the country for cattle, goats and sheep. The digital programme will link each animal to records covering ownership, health, vaccinations and movements.

developments.title: Scala Projects Revenue Will Exceed R$2bn in 2026
developments.summary: Scala, a Brazilian dairy producer long known mainly to food-service buyers, is expanding its consumer-facing business and industrial footprint. The company expects revenue to surpass R$2bn in 2026, compared with R$1.4bn in 2024.

developments.title: Kenya urges Tharaka Nithi farmers to raise milk output
developments.summary: Kenya’s government has asked dairy farmers in Tharaka Nithi County to increase production as authorities pursue expanded milk processing and value addition. The county produces about 57m litres a year, which Agriculture Cabinet Secretary Mutahi Kagwe said is insufficient to keep a processing plant operating at full capacity.

developments.title: Piracanjuba Expands Capacity and Prepares Plant for Other Products
developments.summary: Piracanjuba has designed its São Jorge d’Oeste plant to process up to 1.2m litres of milk a day, above the project’s initial target. The facility will initially focus on mozzarella, while its layout allows for future whey-protein, powdered-lactose and requeijão production.

developments.title: Drought in Oaxaca Raises Meat, Cheese and Milk Prices
developments.summary: A prolonged drought and high temperatures in Oaxaca have reduced livestock production and pushed up prices for fresh milk, artisanal cheese and beef. Producers are facing higher costs for feed and water, while households in local markets are reducing or changing their purchases.

developments.title: Queso Casín Retains Demand as Production Narrows to Two Producers
developments.summary: Queso Casín, an Asturian cheese protected by a designation of origin, is now made by only two dairies. At the latest cheese fair, about 1,500 units sold quickly, while the traditional production area no longer has dairy farms supplying milk.

developments.title: Kazakhstan Imports 148 Danish Red Cattle
developments.summary: Kazakhstan received 148 heads of Danish Red cattle. The animals underwent a 21-day quarantine before shipment and are currently undergoing veterinary inspection at Aktobe airport.

developments.title: Kazakhstan Signed 25 Agreements Worth 4.4 Trillion Tenge
developments.summary: Since the beginning of 2026, Kazakhstan has formalized 25 investment agreements with a total value of about 4.4 trillion tenge. Since 2021, the number of such agreements has reached 66, and their total amount has exceeded 17.8 trillion tenge.

developments.title: Quesería Ventimiglia's Patagonzola Reaches 10 International Medals
developments.summary: Quesería Ventimiglia's Patagonzola has won a Super Gold at the World Cheese Awards and reached 10 international medals. The producer is expanding its operations in Argentina.

developments.title: Emergency Crews Responded to a Fire at Fonterra’s Clandeboye Factory
developments.summary: Emergency crews and Fonterra’s on-site emergency team responded to a fire at the company’s Clandeboye manufacturing facility in New Zealand’s Timaru District. The fire was contained before it reached the site’s main processing and packaging assets.

developments.title: Danone’s Decision Threatens a Regional Dairy Supply Chain
developments.summary: Danone has reportedly ended direct farmgate milk collections in a regional milk-producing area and told private processors and co-operatives working for it to exclude locally produced skimmed milk from their supplies. The decision has drawn warnings from the FNPL union over its effects on farmers, traditional dairy processing and shared food-safety infrastructure.

developments.title: Zomato bans analogue paneer dishes and urges dairy use
developments.summary: Zomato has introduced a zero-tolerance policy on dishes made with analogue dairy products and removed items that restaurants had identified as containing them. Restaurants must replace the ingredients with natural dairy products or risk being removed from the platform.

developments.title: A2 Milk executives sell vested shares for taxes as directors buy
developments.summary: A2 Milk executives sold part of their newly vested performance rights to meet personal tax liabilities. Independent directors, meanwhile, increased their holdings through on-market purchases.

developments.title: West Bengal board orders Starmilk unit to close over pollution
developments.summary: West Bengal’s Pollution Control Board has directed Starmilk Products to shut its dairy facility in Hooghly district if it does not reduce wastewater pollution by August 31. The company has also been fined ₹3.5 lakh after inspectors found pollutant levels far above regulatory limits.

developments.title: Maite Kungfu Missy Won Argentina’s Dairy Cow Contest
developments.summary: Maite Kungfu Missy produced 157.055kg of milk across four controlled milkings and won the traditional Rafaela Dairy Cow Contest. The cow belongs to La Luisa farm.

developments.title: Punjab bans analogue paneer production and sales for one year
developments.summary: Punjab has prohibited the production, storage, distribution and commercial sale of analogue paneer throughout the state for 12 months. The order covers all food business operators and was issued under India’s Food Safety and Standards Act.

developments.title: Northland Siblings Win 4-H Dairy Goat Championships
developments.summary: Asher and Lilianna Acosta won championship titles in the 2026 4-H dairy goat competition at the Minnesota State Fair. Asher was named Champion Alpine Junior Doe, while Lilianna won Champion Sable Senior Doe with her goat, Gigi.

developments.title: Chile expands Listeria alert and orders recall of two cheese formats
developments.summary: Chile’s Health Ministry has widened a food-safety alert after Listeria was found in two La Rotunda mantecoso cheese formats. The measure covers 300-gram and 500-gram packs from lot T3180726, which the ministry says consumers should not eat.

developments.title: MANMUL Suspended Two Officials over 57-Tonne Milk Powder Case
developments.summary: Food-safety authorities in Karnataka’s Mandya district are investigating the alleged adulteration of about 57 tonnes of skimmed milk powder. The Mandya District Milk Union, known as MANMUL, suspended two officials after inspections linked to the case.

developments.title: Sheep Milk Places Santa Catarina’s Casa Bianchi Among Brazil’s Top Three
developments.summary: Casa Bianchi, a small farm in western Santa Catarina, has shifted from cattle to sheep and now keeps 800–900 animals. It produces 350–400 litres of sheep’s milk a day and, according to its owner, ranks among Brazil’s three largest producers in the segment.

developments.title: France Eases Rules for Seven Protected Cheeses
developments.summary: A shortage of pasture has led France’s government to allow temporary exceptions to feeding rules for cows whose milk is used in Comté, Beaufort and Abondance cheeses. The measure also applies to four other protected varieties.

developments.title: Haryana Dairy Farmers Demand ₹2–3 per Kg More from Vita
developments.summary: Dairy farmers in Haryana have submitted memoranda at Vita cooperative plants, seeking a ₹2–3 per kg increase in raw-milk procurement prices. The Dairy Farmers Association said higher feed, fodder and transport costs had reduced producers’ margins.

developments.title: Chennai Cheesemakers Are Giving Artisanal Cheese an Indian Identity
developments.summary: Chennai cheesemakers are combining Indian milk and local ingredients with European fermentation and ageing methods. Käse has developed cheeses incorporating regional spices and botanicals, while events and gourmet markets are expanding consumer interest in domestic craft cheese.

developments.title: Private Milk Vendors Raise Prices in Coimbatore
developments.summary: Independent milk sellers in Coimbatore have increased retail prices by Rs 6 to Rs 10 per litre. The changes followed a government decision to raise incentives for farmers supplying milk through Aavin cooperative societies, while some private dairies continue to pay farmers Rs 38–48 per litre.

developments.title: Danny McLaughlin Joins the Ulster Farmers’ Union
developments.summary: Danny McLaughlin has joined the Ulster Farmers’ Union as policy officer for dairy and pigs. He will work with the union’s Dairy Committee and the Pork & Bacon Committee, engaging with farmers and stakeholder organisations on issues affecting both sectors.

developments.title: AqAltyn 2026 in Shymkent Discusses Strategies for Maintaining Dairy Industry Profitability Amid Crisis
developments.summary: The IV Central Asian Dairy Congress AqAltyn 2026 will be held in Shymkent from November 30 to December 1. The main theme of the Congress is the development of the Eurasian dairy industry amidst the 2026 crisis.

developments.title: Sainsbury’s launches soy and oat drinks for children
developments.summary: Sainsbury’s has introduced private-label soy and oat drinks for children aged one and over. The products are fortified with several vitamins and minerals and are priced at £1.70 per one-litre carton.

developments.title: Colombia Accounted for 68% of Bolivia’s Dairy Exports
developments.summary: Bolivia’s dairy exports reached $25m in 2025, with Colombia accounting for 68% of the total. External sales amounted to $11m in the first half of 2026.

developments.title: Dairy industry invests heavily to dominate fitness shelves
developments.summary: Dairy manufacturers and retailers are expanding their focus on functional products aimed at consumers interested in health and fitness. The strategy includes broader assortments, dedicated merchandising and loyalty tools such as personalised offers and educational content.

developments.title: Celema Creates a Differentiated A2 Milk Chain in Colombia
developments.summary: Celema is developing a supply chain for A2 milk in Colombia with 11 farms whose herds have been genotyped. The company keeps the A2 milk separate from milking through packaging to preserve the value of investments made by producers.

developments.title: Chile Increased Milk Collection by 6.6% in 2025
developments.summary: Chile collected 6.6% more milk in 2025 than in the previous period. Ten processing companies handled nearly 2.39bn litres during the year.

developments.title: Sri Lanka’s CAA Rejects False Dairy Price-Rise Posts
developments.summary: Sri Lanka’s Consumer Affairs Authority has rejected widely shared social-media claims that prices for several dairy products have increased. The claims concerned milk powder, cultured milk drinks and yoghurt, with specific rises attributed to each product.

developments.title: The Lactose-Free Market Is Entering a New Phase and Challenging Dairies
developments.summary: Lactose-free dairy products are expanding beyond fluid milk into higher-value categories, including yogurts, cheeses, protein drinks and whipping bases. Each product requires separate formulation decisions to manage sweetness, texture, stability and performance.

developments.title: Milky Way Dairy Exhibition Area to Debut at EuroTier 2026
developments.summary: EuroTier 2026, taking place on November 10–13 in Hanover, will introduce the EuroTier Milky Way thematic exhibition area for the first time. It will bring together technologies spanning the entire dairy production chain, from animal breeding and feeding to dairy processing and marketing, according to the German Agricultural Society (DLG).

developments.title: EuroTier 2026 to Address Dairy Farm Biosecurity and Livestock Disease Prevention
developments.summary: EuroTier 2026, taking place on November 10–13 in Hanover, will feature a dedicated expert stage on biosecurity and feed safety. The programme will cover infectious disease prevention, livestock housing hygiene and herd health management, according to the German Agricultural Society (DLG).

developments.title: Nestlé and Coca-Cola Lead 2026 Most Valuable Food and Beverage Brands
developments.summary: Brand Finance has named Nestlé and Coca-Cola as the most valuable food and non-alcoholic drinks brands for 2026. Nestlé's brand value increased by 23% to $24.6 billion, while Coca-Cola retains its top position despite a slight decrease in brand value.

developments.summary: Vicia sativa is a leguminous forage crop with important ecological and feeding value, and its nutritional quality is closely influenced by its growing environment. ECF vaccines and chemical treatments are regarded as expensive by small-holder farmers. The aims of this study were to clarify the epidemiology of ECF and to evaluate the efficacy of ethnoveterinary medicine, Synadenium cupulare on T. parva infection. developments.title: New England dairy farmers use data to time silage harvest
developments.summary: Dairy farmers across New England are using portable laboratory tests to identify when corn silage should be harvested. The testing measures moisture, plant maturity and nutritional potential, giving farms a narrower harvesting window for feed intended for their cows.

developments.title: $13 Billion in Dairy Processing Investment Reshapes U.S. Industry, Says NMPF
developments.summary: NMPF CEO Gregg Doud highlights a historic $13B investment wave in U.S. dairy processing, expanding capacity while creating new supply chain challenges.

developments.title: Cull Cow Checks Grow as Market Peaks, Prompting Expansion in LRP Risk Protection
developments.summary: Cull cow prices near historic highs prompt dairy farmers to secure downside revenue using expanded 52-week Livestock Risk Protection (LRP) policies.

developments.title: 2026 Dairy Top 100: DFA Retains Top Spot as Lactalis USA Surges to Third on Yogurt Deal
developments.summary: DFA retains the No. 1 spot with $23.1B in the 2026 Dairy Top 100, while Lactalis USA jumps to No. 3 and The Magnum Ice Cream Co. debuts at No. 5.

developments.title: Co-evolution of plants, livestock and farming practices during dairy farm transformation to agroecology: an in-depth case study in France
developments.summary: Agriculture contributes to and is impacted by global changes. Agroecology is recommended as a framework for transforming farming systems to address these challenges. However, research has not extensively documented transformations to agroecology, which could limit adoption by farmers. developments.summary: The Automatic Milking System (AMS) has significantly improved dairy farming efficiency. developments.title: New York Opens Applications for $8.5m Dairy Grants
developments.summary: New York has opened the second application round of its Dairy Modernization Grant Program, offering $8.5 million to dairy farmers and organisations. The funding is intended for projects including expanded milk storage and upgraded transport systems.

developments.title: USDA Reports New H5N1 Detections in Poultry and Dairy Cattle
developments.summary: The USDA’s Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service has confirmed new H5N1 avian-flu detections in commercial poultry and dairy cattle after nearly 30 days without updates. Three dairy herds and several poultry flocks were recorded among the latest cases.

developments.title: Ash Grove Dairy Began Making Renewable Gas from Manure, Producing up to 480,000 Gallon-Equivalents
developments.summary: Ash Grove Dairy in Minnesota began sending renewable natural gas into interstate pipelines in 2024. The facility processes manure from more than 2,000 milking cows and is expected to produce up to 480,000 gasoline-gallon equivalents annually at full capacity.

developments.title: M&S backs AI-powered herd monitoring as part of dairy welfare drive
developments.summary: M&S backs AI-powered herd monitoring as part of dairy welfare drive

developments.title: NZ dairy group Synlait to end year in red
developments.summary: Synlait, the New Zealand dairy group, expects to report an annual loss when the company files its full-year numbers next month. The post NZ dairy group Synlait to end year in red appeared first on Just Food .

developments.summary: There is an increased interest among dairy farmers in management systems allowing cow–calf contact (CCC). This study evaluated maternal protective behaviour in dairy cows using Qualitative Behaviour Assessment (QBA) in combination with categorical behavioural scoring systems, selected objective recordings from the automatic milking system (AMS) and computer-controlled smart gates (SG). developments.title: Fonterra Drops to 10th in Global Dairy Rankings Following Consumer Business Divestment to Lactalis
developments.summary: Fonterra drops to 10th in Rabobank’s Global Dairy Top 20 after selling its consumer unit to Lactalis, pivoting toward B2B ingredients and foodservice.

developments.title: Ausnutria Dairy Swings to H1 Loss as Declining Chinese Birth Rate and Channel Adjustments Hit Revenue
developments.summary: Ausnutria Dairy posts an 18.6% revenue drop and H1 loss as China's falling birth rate and Kabrita channel adjustments pressure infant formula sales.

developments.title: FSAI Issues Recall Warning for Macroom Buffalo Cheese Batches Over Listeria Concerns
developments.summary: FSAI issues a recall for Macroom Buffalo Cheese mozzarella, bocconcini, and burrata batches over Listeria monocytogenes contamination concerns.

developments.title: Small-intestinal microbiota patterns in growing Hu sheep fed low-protein diets with rumen-protected lysine and methionine
developments.summary: Dietary crude protein reduction and supplementation with rumen-protected amino acids may improve nitrogen utilisation in sheep; however, their effects on different small-intestinal sites remain unknown.This study investigated the digesta microbiota in paired duodenal and jejunal samples from 38 growing male Hu sheep fed one of four experimental diets: a conventional protein control diet, a low-pro
developments.sourceName: Journal of Animal and Feed Sciences

developments.summary: Abstract The objectives of these two studies were to evaluate the impact of excess Met (methionine) supplementation during late gestation on intake, body weight (BW), average daily gain (ADG), reproductive performance, and subsequent calf performance in artificially inseminated heifers and naturally bred cows. In Exp. 1, a 3-yr study used 38 pregnant Black Angus crossbred heifers/yr (n = 113) in a

developments.title: Uruguay Increased Milk Production 11.4%; August Shows Signs of a Slowdown
developments.summary: Uruguay’s milk production rose by 11.4%, while deliveries to processors reached 213.3m litres in July. The increase marked a fifth consecutive month of double-digit year-on-year growth, although August showed signs of moderation.

developments.title: Cull Cow Prices Rise as LRP Coverage Expands
developments.summary: Cull cow prices have moved higher alongside the broader United States beef market, while advisers point to Livestock Risk Protection policies as a way for producers to protect expected revenue. The USDA has extended the maximum coverage period for cull cows from 13 weeks to 52 weeks.

developments.title: Revival Animal Health Recalls Feline Milk Replacers Over Nutrient Variations
developments.summary: Revival Animal Health has voluntarily recalled selected feline milk replacers after testing found inconsistent and potentially low concentrations of several essential nutrients. The products, sold nationwide under the Breeder’s Edge and Shelter’s Choice brands, are being investigated alongside nine complaints involving possible gastrointestinal and bone-development problems.

developments.title: Ausnutria Dairy Reports H1 Loss as Revenue Falls
developments.summary: Ausnutria Dairy said consolidated revenue fell by 18.6% year on year in the first half of 2026, while the company moved from a profit to a net loss attributable to equity holders. The goat and infant-formula producer cited distribution changes, lower Chinese birth rates and weaker Kabrita sales in China.

developments.title: TasteAtlas ranked two Indian ghee products sixth
developments.summary: GirOrganic A2 Gir Cow Ghee and Amul Pure Ghee both took sixth place in TasteAtlas’s list of the world’s best and iconic butter products. The ranking included entries from established dairy markets across Europe, North America, Oceania and Asia.

developments.title: Conseleite projects Rio Grande do Sul milk price at R$2.48 in August
developments.summary: The reference price for milk in Rio Grande do Sul is projected to decline to R$2.48 per litre in August, according to Conseleite/RS. The estimate is R$0.03 below July’s figure, a monthly decrease of 1.01%.

developments.title: Young Consumers Use Whey Protein Without Knowing Its Dairy Origin
developments.summary: A 2025 Embrapa survey identified 21 protein dairy-drink brands available in Brazil, while household sales of the category rose by 10.7% in 2024. The products are part of a wider shift in how younger consumers obtain milk and protein.

developments.title: Matrizes do Amanhã Identifies 1,000 Girolando Heifers in Ceará
developments.summary: The Matrizes do Amanhã project has individually identified 1,000 Girolando heifers in Ceará. The Faec/Senar initiative, carried out with the Ceará government, is intended to support small dairy farmers and improve the genetic quality of the state’s herds.

developments.title: Amul Continues Verghese Kurien’s Dairy Legacy
developments.summary: Verghese Kurien helped turn a cooperative in Anand into the foundation of Amul and a nationwide dairy movement. His work linked farmer ownership with processing, technology and organised marketing, while Operation Flood extended the model across India.

developments.title: Gadolando will award its Supreme Breeder title at Expointer
developments.summary: The Association of Holstein Cattle Breeders of Rio Grande do Sul will present its highest distinction to seven producers and a cooperative-owned dairy farm. The award recognises farms that combine registered Holstein herds with official production and conformation records.

developments.title: Private-label dairy products gain ground in Spain
developments.summary: Private-label goods are taking a larger share of Spanish household shopping, with dairy products among the categories affected. More than 75% of Spanish consumers say supermarket brands offer good value for money, while one in three reports increasing their consumption of them over the past year.

developments.title: IDFA Opens Nominations for 2027 Dairy Industry Leadership Awards
developments.summary: The International Dairy Foods Association has opened nominations for its 2027 awards programme. The awards will recognise achievements in dairy leadership, food safety, farm innovation and workplace culture ahead of Dairy Forum 2027 in Orlando.

developments.title: EU Dairy Prices Diverge as Butter and WMP Rise
developments.summary: EU dairy commodity prices moved in different directions in the latest European Commission report. Butter rose 21% year on year and whole milk powder (WMP) increased 70%, while skimmed milk powder (SMP), whey powder and several cheeses recorded declines.

developments.title: Brazilian startup Zeit presents milk analyser with 35-second results
developments.summary: Zeit presented the Paraná pre-launch of its portable milk-quality analyser at an event in Cascavel, with support from Coopavel. The device connects to a mobile phone, works without internet and produces readings in about 35 seconds.

developments.title: Family reaches 100 litres of milk, 70 sweets daily on 16 hectares
developments.summary: A family-run agro-industry in Bonito, Mato Grosso do Sul, produces 100 litres of milk and up to 70 pots of sweets a day on 16 hectares. Its five ARTE seals allow the business to sell its sweets throughout Brazil.

developments.title: Grupo Lala Calls Mexico to Drink One Glass Daily
developments.summary: Grupo Lala has launched the “One Glass of Lala a Day” challenge, inviting adults across Mexico to add at least one serving of milk to their daily routine. The campaign presents milk as suitable for breakfast, coffee, smoothies and post-exercise recovery, rather than as a food intended only for children.

developments.title: Milkfood plans ₹20 crore Patiala plant for premium dairy
developments.summary: Milkfood is rolling out premium dairy products as part of its strategy for FY2026-27. The company is investing ₹20 crore at its Patiala facility and expects about ₹30 crore in revenue from third-party contract manufacturing during the financial year.

developments.title: A report found nearly 90% of Delhi dairies unauthorised and waste-generating
developments.summary: A government assessment found that 500 of Delhi’s 557 evaluated dairy units were unauthorised. The units housed more than 120,000 cattle and produced an estimated 1,500 metric tonnes of dairy waste each day.

developments.title: Moacyr de Carvalho Dias Introduced Bagged Milk and Danone to Brazil
developments.summary: Moacyr de Carvalho Dias began collecting milk with two carts in Poços de Caldas before developing new ways to sell dairy products. He introduced milk in plastic bags, helped bring Danone to Brazil and changed the presentation of requeijão by putting it in glass cups.

developments.title: Mumbai wholesale milk prices will rise to ₹102
developments.summary: The Bombay Milk Producers Association has announced a ₹9-per-litre increase in wholesale milk prices across Mumbai and adjoining supply networks. The new rate of ₹102 will take effect on September 1, 2026, and remain in force until February 28, 2027.

developments.title: β-Hydroxybutyrate-induced mitochondrial dysfunction and oxidative stress in BMSCs are ameliorated by mitophagy activation
developments.summary: Ketosis is a common metabolic disorder in periparturient dairy cows and is characterized by elevated circulating BHBA concentrations. Although the effects of ketosis on hepatic metabolism have been extensively studied, its impact on skeletal muscle remains poorly understood. developments.sourceName: Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology

developments.summary: Abstract Introduction Mastitis is one of the most economically significant diseases in dairy cattle, and its causation by atypical environmental pathogens is gaining attention. The study investigated the involvement of Serratia marcescens in intramammary infections occurring in a dairy herd and evaluated the bacterium’s antimicrobial resistance profile. developments.summary: In closed cattle-fattening barns, the indoor climate and herd growth are mutually interdependent. developments.title: Wisconsin Judge Sends Ridge Breeze Permit Back to DNR
developments.summary: Administrative Law Judge Angela Chaput Foy ruled that Wisconsin’s permit for Ridge Breeze Dairy’s planned expansion does not adequately protect groundwater. She returned the approval to the Department of Natural Resources, requiring enforceable monitoring safeguards before the operation can expand from about 1,700 to 6,500 cows.

developments.title: Maryam Nawaz Pursues China Partnership for Punjab Dairy Project
developments.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz visited Tyren Wisdom Dairy Works in Xinjiang and discussed a China-backed milk and dairy-processing project. A separate Punjab delegation examined China’s national big-data pilot zone and identified possible areas for digital cooperation.

developments.title: California Dairy Faces New Canadian Tariffs as Wine Industry Feels Pressure
developments.summary: California dairy and wine exporters are facing renewed disruption as trade tensions between the United States and Canada intensify. Washington has imposed 50% tariffs on Canadian goods, while Ottawa is preparing matching duties on US farm products and processed foods.

developments.title: Uruguay’s farm-gate milk price falls to $0.41 per litre
developments.summary: The average price paid to milk producers in Uruguay declined to $0.41 per litre in July, its lowest dollar-denominated level since December 2024. Conaprole said it would keep its producer price unchanged in August and September as spring production approaches.

developments.title: Mexico’s Government Buys Domestic Milk for 7.7m Beneficiaries
developments.summary: Mexico’s government is purchasing milk directly from domestic cattle farmers under its Guarantee Prices scheme. The programme combines farm-gate or collection-centre payments with subsidised distribution, including a lower price in more than 500 highly marginalised municipalities.

developments.title: Wisconsin Licensed Dairy Herds Drop Below 5,000 for First Time in Modern History
developments.summary: Wisconsin's licensed dairy herds drop below 5,000 for the first time to 4,991, while milk per cow hits 25,599 lbs to keep output resilient.

developments.title: California Dairy Hit by New Canadian Tariffs as Wine Industry Continues to Feel Pinch
developments.summary: California dairy and wine producers face export headwinds as escalating U.S.-Canada tariffs threaten key cross-border agricultural trade channels.

developments.title: Lighter Placements Improve Beef-on-Dairy Feedlot Performance and Value, Study Shows
developments.summary: Ohio State research shows placing beef-on-dairy calves in feedlots at lighter weights improves feed efficiency, gain rates, and carcass value.

developments.title: France to Relax Strict AOP Cheese Rules as Severe Drought Scorches Grazing Pastures
developments.summary: France temporarily eases AOP rules for Comté, Beaufort, and Abondance as historic drought scorches pastures and threatens milk supplies.

developments.title: Wisconsin Judge Rules Ridge Breeze CAFO Permit Fails to Protect Groundwater, Sends Approval Back to DNR
developments.summary: Wisconsin judge sends Ridge Breeze Dairy's CAFO permit back to DNR, ruling it lacks essential groundwater monitoring to protect local drinking wells.

developments.title: Canada strikes back at US with retaliatory tariffs as trade war escalates
developments.summary: Canada struck back at the United States on Tuesday with retaliatory tariffs on about $20 billion worth of American goods, including steel, dairy products, appliances and farm equipment, as the trade war between the once-friendly neighbors escalated sharply. The confrontation [Read More ...]

developments.title: The Evolving Economics of Dairy Markets
developments.summary: Dairy is having its moment as dairy demand stands at an all-time high. As this takes place, dairy protein demand is having an unprecedented run. However, with more protein comes more butterfat, which means the [Read More ...]

developments.title: Does Your Child Drink Whole Milk? Milk Taps John Morgan to Partner for Satirical Commercial
developments.summary: Whole Milk’s Zombie-Attracting Brain Benefits The tongue-in-cheek spot claims the healthy fats in dairy milk are making kids’ brains extra appetizing to zombies this back-to-school season. John Morgan of Morgan & Morgan today announced via [Read More ...]

developments.title: Berglandmilch in talks over “merger” with Austrian rival
developments.summary: Berglandmilch is in negotiations over a possible “merger” with fellow Austrian dairy group Obersteirische Molkerei. The post Berglandmilch in talks over “merger” with Austrian rival appeared first on Just Food .

developments.title: Arla plans more ingredients capex amid “super high” demand for protein
developments.summary: Arla will “invest significantly” in its ingredients business, the dairy giant’s CEO has said, as demand for – and the prices of – protein ingredients surges. The post Arla plans more ingredients capex amid “super high” demand for protein appeared first on Just Food .

developments.summary: Continuous identity output of individual dairy cows is a prerequisite for quantifying feeding duration, feeding frequency, and other behaviour-linked health indicators. developments.summary: High somatic cell count (SCC) is a critical indicator of udder health and milk quality in buffalo milk production. However, in many low-income regions, SCC monitoring is often underemphasized, allowing a proportion of high-SCC buffalo milk to enter the food chain and potentially compromising food safety and public health. developments.title: FDA Authorizes Generic Ivermectin to Prevent Screwworm in Cattle
developments.summary: The US Food and Drug Administration has issued an emergency-use authorization for Bimectin, an ivermectin injection, to help prevent New World screwworm infestations in cattle. The authorization applies when the drug is given within 24 hours of birth, during castration or when an animal develops a wound.

However, evidence on nutritional, genetic, and management strategies remains fragmented across disciplines.
