developments.title: Effects of dietary lipid supplementation on enteric methane emissions and feed efficiency in ruminants: A review
developments.summary: Enteric methane emissions from ruminant livestock represent a major environmental challenge and a significant loss of dietary energy, thereby reducing feed efficiency and animal productivity. This review examines the effects of dietary lipid supplementation on enteric methane production and feed efficiency in ruminants. Methane formation is closely linked to rumen fermentation processes, hydrogen

developments.title: Sudamericana Lácteos Resumed Production at Its Santa Fe Plant
developments.summary: Sudamericana Lácteos has restarted operations at its facility in Díaz, Santa Fe, producing bar cheese under an administration led by Pablo González. The plant will initially process about 100,000 litres of milk a day and retain 78 jobs.

developments.title: Wisconsin's Licensed Dairy Herd Count Falls Below 5,000
developments.summary: Wisconsin recorded 4,991 licensed dairy herds on August 1, 2026, the first time the figure has fallen below 5,000. The state had 5,222 herds a year earlier, while average milk production per cow reached 25,599 pounds in 2025.

developments.title: Studies compare Jersey and Holstein performance and farmer well-being
developments.summary: Two studies in the Journal of Dairy Science examined breed performance in dairy cattle and the well-being of farmers in Canada. One assessed production and feed-use measures in Jersey and Holstein cows, while the other surveyed stress, working conditions and social support among 115 farmers.

developments.title: Rondônia’s Milk Output Falls as Sector Seeks ICMS Review
developments.summary: Milk production in Rondônia has declined from 4m litres a day in 2012 to 1.5m litres, according to figures presented at a sector meeting. Industry representatives are calling for changes to ICMS rules and the management of Pró-Leite funds.

developments.title: M&S expands AI welfare monitoring across dairy farms
developments.summary: Marks & Spencer is introducing artificial-intelligence monitoring across its entire Milk Pool, covering 46 British dairy farms. Camera footage will be analysed by an algorithm developed with veterinary input to track cows’ welfare and health indicators in real time.

developments.title: France Eases AOP Cheese Rules Amid Severe Drought
developments.summary: France and INAO have temporarily loosened feed requirements for several protected cheeses after drought and heat reduced available pasture. Farmers producing Comté, Beaufort and Abondance may use outside fodder and grain in cattle rations under the exemptions.

developments.title: Danone wins approval to expand Macroom operations and add 230 jobs
developments.summary: Danone has received planning permission for a new medical-nutrition facility beside its existing site in Macroom, County Cork. The project is due to begin operating in stages, with up to 230 jobs planned and total site employment expected to reach about 460.

developments.title: Arla’s nutrition brands powered a strong first half
developments.summary: Arla reported group revenue of €7.6bn and net profit of €213m for the six months ended 30 June. Growth in branded sales, including Arla Protein and Arla Skyr, offset the effect of a 24% decline in the company’s performance price for milk.

developments.title: Milk Prices Have Recovered but Producers Say Margins Remain Tight
developments.summary: The value of milk has recovered in recent months, according to José Luis Volando, vice-president of Argentina’s Agrarian Federation. He said producers continue to face pressure from costs, the need to operate at scale and investment requirements.

developments.title: Food Production in Russia Decreased in July
developments.summary: In July, food production in Russia decreased by 1.8% compared to June, while beverage production increased by 1.3%. Year-on-year, food production grew by 3.9%, whereas beverage production fell by 2.4%, according to Rosstat.

developments.title: Sedarpa Delivers Specialized Milk Transport to 70 Veracruz Farmers
developments.summary: Veracruz’s Secretariat of Agricultural, Rural and Fisheries Development has supplied 70 dairy farmers with tanker units and insulated stainless-steel tanks. The equipment is intended to support milk collection, protect refrigeration during transport and reduce logistics costs.

developments.title: Tere Jiménez reaffirmed support for Aguascalientes farmers
developments.summary: Aguascalientes Governor Tere Jiménez met more than 120 farmers, agribusiness owners and representatives of the state’s food chains. She highlighted government assistance reaching over 2,500 productive units and restated her administration’s commitment to rural financing and development.

developments.title: European Dairy Commodity Prices Rise as Supplies Tighten
developments.summary: Butter, whole milk powder and skim milk powder all became more expensive at the latest Dutch Dairy Board auction. Summer drought conditions have reduced milk availability, adding pressure to European dairy supplies.

developments.title: Farmers are urged to improve dairy margins as prices fluctuate
developments.summary: Dairy farmers are being advised to manage feed use and milk composition more closely as volatile farmgate prices weigh on profitability. Chris Bartram of Mole Valley Farmers said improvements in forage quality, concentrate selection and young-stock nutrition could raise returns.

developments.title: Milk Production in Galicia Will Cost Up to 5 Cents More per Litre
developments.summary: Unións Agrarias has warned that milk-production costs in Galicia will rise by between 4 and 5 cents per litre. It is calling on the dairy industry to reflect the increase in contracts due for renewal in November.

developments.title: Nestlé India Targets Top-Five Global Position Through Dairy, Nutrition and Premiumisation
developments.summary: Nestlé India is seeking to become one of its parent company’s five largest operating markets worldwide. The company is expanding capacity and focusing on dairy, nutrition, premium products and wider distribution in India.

developments.title: Himachal Pradesh Bans Mislabelled Analogue Paneer
developments.summary: Himachal Pradesh has prohibited the manufacture, storage, transport, supply and sale of non-dairy analogue paneer when it is presented as genuine dairy paneer. The one-year order, effective immediately, also covers restaurants and catering businesses and requires clear disclosure when non-dairy substitutes are used.

developments.title: FoodMaster to Invest 8.2 Billion Tenge in Upgrading Plants in Kazakhstan
developments.summary: JSC "FoodMaster", part of the French dairy group Lactalis, will allocate 8.2 billion tenge for projects to modernize production in Kazakhstan. The sole shareholder of the company made the decision on the distribution of accumulated profits for the year 2025.

developments.title: Ireland recalls dairy products over Listeria concerns
developments.summary: Macroom Buffalo Cheese Products Ltd. is recalling selected batches of mozzarella, bocconcini and burrata sold in Irish supermarkets. The Food Safety Authority of Ireland said the products may contain Listeria monocytogenes and advised consumers not to eat them.

developments.title: Chile Targets Indonesia to Open a Dairy Market
developments.summary: Chile’s dairy industry is seeking government support to secure the permits needed for trade with Indonesia. Fedeleche says the market could provide an outlet for premium, higher-value products while Chile also promotes domestic dairy consumption.

developments.title: RCDF Told High Court Informal Channels Handle 80% of Rajasthan’s Marketable Milk
developments.summary: The Rajasthan Cooperative Dairy Federation told the High Court that its remit covers only a limited share of the state’s commercial milk market. Data presented for RCDF said informal channels handle about 80% of Rajasthan’s marketable milk, while organised operators handle the remainder.

developments.title: OMFED Is Ready to Scale Paneer Output Amid Odisha Dairy Scare
developments.summary: Odisha’s dairy cooperative OMFED says it can increase paneer production as authorities investigate suspected adulteration in the state. The cooperative produces about one tonne a day normally and can raise output to nearly three tonnes during festive periods.

developments.title: A Brazilian Ranking Identifies Five Leading Dairy Brands in 2026
developments.summary: A ranking of dairy brands places Italac, Piracanjuba, Itambé, Elegê and Nestlé among the names most frequently bought by Brazilian consumers. Italac ranked sixth overall and was the most purchased dairy brand for the tenth consecutive year, while the other four recorded different movements from the previous year.

developments.title: Central Lechera Asturiana Leads Asturias Brand Ranking
developments.summary: Central Lechera Asturiana ranked as the most chosen brand in Asturias in the 2026 Brand Footprint report. The dairy company recorded 6.7m consumer contacts, ahead of Campofrío, ElPozo, Coca-Cola and Danone.

developments.title: U.S. Butter Exports Increased Significantly in 2026
developments.summary: In 2026, U.S. butter exports more than doubled in just a few months compared to the same period in 2025. This growth was driven by increased domestic production, competitive pricing, and high international demand.

developments.title: Punjab department holds milk testing camp at school
developments.summary: Punjab’s Dairy Development Department held an awareness and milk-testing camp at Saragarhi Memorial Meritorious School in Hakam Singh Wala, Ferozepur. Officials discussed milk’s nutritional value, warned against excessive sugary soft-drink consumption and said all student-provided samples met state purity and composition requirements.

developments.title: ANFAŞ Food Product and Hotel Equipment Exhibitions to Take Place in Antalya in January 2027
developments.summary: The international ANFAŞ Food Product and ANFAŞ Hotel Equipment exhibitions will take place from January 12 to 15, 2027, at the ANFAŞ Expo Center in Antalya, Türkiye.

developments.title: Aavin cleared 300 tonnes of accumulated waste at Madurai plant
developments.summary: Tamil Nadu’s state dairy cooperative, Aavin, removed more than 300 tonnes of legacy waste from land behind its milk-processing facility on Sivagangai Road in Madurai. The five-day operation involved about 150 truckloads of non-hazardous refuse.

developments.title: Russia Plans to Enhance Cooperation with APEC in the Agricultural Sector
developments.summary: Russia has expressed its intention to strengthen cooperation with the Asia-Pacific economies in agriculture and food security. These topics were discussed at the 11th APEC Food Security Ministerial Meeting held in China.

developments.title: Geopolitical pressures are reshaping US dairy strategies
developments.summary: US dairy processors and producers are facing greater exposure to trade disputes, transport disruptions and labour shortages as export markets expand. The review of the US-Mexico-Canada Agreement and a new US-EU dairy deal are central developments for the industry.

developments.title: China’s Dairy Imports Fell as Self-Sufficiency Rose
developments.summary: China’s dairy imports dropped sharply in July 2026, while the country’s domestic milk production continued to cover more of its market. Imports also declined across the first seven months of the year, including several major product categories.

developments.title: Lactalis Retains Top Position in Global Dairy Ranking
developments.summary: Lactalis remained the largest dairy company in the latest RaboResearch Global Dairy Top 20. The 20 companies recorded combined turnover of $267bn in 2025, up 5.4% from the previous year.

developments.title: Uruguay Produces More Milk with Fewer Producers as Brazil Buys
developments.summary: Uruguay sent 1.025bn litres of milk to processors in the first half of 2026, up 10.3% from a year earlier. Brazil was one of the country’s two leading dairy markets in 2025, alongside Algeria, accounting together for more than 60% of exports.

developments.title: Canada imposes tariffs on US dairy and seafood
developments.summary: Canada will impose counter-tariffs covering C$27.6bn of US imports, including dairy and seafood. The measures will begin on 8 September and match US tariff rates of 15%, 25% and 50% on selected products.

developments.title: Global dairy giants shift towards nutrition, protein and functional products
developments.summary: Rabobank says nutrition, protein ingredients and functional dairy products are becoming increasingly important growth areas for the global dairy industry. The 20 largest dairy companies increased their combined turnover by 5.4% to $267 billion in 2025.

developments.title: Leche para el Bienestar and INAFED Formalise Nationwide Milk Agreement
developments.summary: Mexico’s Leche para el Bienestar and the National Institute for Federalism and Municipal Development have signed a co-ordination agreement covering the country’s 2,477 municipalities and territorial districts. The arrangement is intended to speed the opening of subsidised milk distribution points, with priority given to areas facing high socioeconomic deprivation.

developments.title: Global Dairy Giants Bet on Nutrition, Protein and Functional Products in $267B Push
developments.summary: Rabobank's Top 20 report shows the 20 largest dairy giants hit $267B turnover, pivoting toward protein, specialized nutrition, and functional products.

developments.title: Dairy Sector Acts as Economic Lifeblood of New Zealand Regions Delivering $28.8B in Exports and 51,000 Jobs
developments.summary: A Sense Partners study shows dairy powers NZ's regions, generating $28.8B in exports, $10.7B in direct GDP, and over 51,000 jobs nationwide.

developments.title: Royal A-ware Moves to Acquire LaBan Foods to Expand Butter Specialties Portfolio
developments.summary: Dutch dairy major Royal A-ware moves to acquire LaBan Foods, adding specialized butter products and expanding its portfolio pending ACM approval.

developments.title: Maui Milk Backs Sheep Dairy Farmers with $17.18/kg MS Payout to Accelerate Network Expansion
developments.summary: Maui Sheep Milk raises supplier payout to $17.18/kg MS and overhauls pricing to recruit North Island farmers as China demand surges.

developments.title: Mexican ranchers prepare to resume livestock sales to US under tight controls over screwworm risk
developments.summary: At daybreak, rancher Martín Alfonso Ibarra takes advantage of the cooler hours in northern Mexico’s desert to oversee the milking of his cows and tend to 16 prized calves. Soon, he hopes, they will be [Read More ...]

developments.title: New York’s Largest Holstein Dairy Cattle Show in Nearly a Decade is Coming to The Great New York State Fair
developments.summary: The Holstein Dairy Cattle Will Be Back at the Toyota Coliseum New York Agriculture Takes Center Stage with More Animals, a New FFA Building, Local Potatoes, the Big Cheese, the Return of Grape Day and [Read More ...]

developments.title: Drought sparks fears for organic dairy herds and farm profits across Great Britain
developments.summary: Drought sparks fears for organic dairy herds and farm profits across Great Britain

developments.title: US dairy’s $13bn bet on the future
developments.summary: Why are dairy processors in the US willing to bet billions of dollars on new capacity right now? The post US dairy’s $13bn bet on the future appeared first on Just Food .

developments.title: Brownes Dairy starts search for buyer
developments.summary: Brownes Dairy is on the block, with the start of the process to sell the Australia-based dairy business. The post Brownes Dairy starts search for buyer appeared first on Just Food .

developments.title: São Paulo Farm Negotiates New Heifer Export to Senegal
developments.summary: Agropecuária Puro da Fazenda in São Paulo hosted a Senegalese delegation on August 19 to discuss another shipment of Girolando heifers. The proposed consignment could leave for Senegal in November 2026, following the sale of 315 animals last year.

developments.title: Brazil accounts for 78% of Latin America's agtechs, Embrapa reports
developments.summary: A study by Embrapa and the Inter-American Institute for Cooperation on Agriculture identified 2,656 agritech startups across 23 Latin American and Caribbean countries. Brazil accounted for 2,075 of them, or 78% of the regional total.

developments.title: A Galician Dairy Farm Uses Technology and Cheese-Making for Succession
developments.summary: At Puluán SC in Monforte de Lemos, 27-year-old veterinarian Lucía López Sobrado has returned to her family’s dairy farm and taken responsibility for production, cheese-making and agrotourism. The farm uses digital tools and artificial intelligence while considering robotic milking as part of its approach to reducing labour demands.

developments.title: FirstFarms lowers its 2026 profit outlook as pig prices weaken
developments.summary: FirstFarms reported sharply lower first-half 2026 EBITDA and EBIT despite higher revenue. The Danish agriculture company cut its full-year outlook after drought in Slovakia and weak pig and milk prices affected results.

developments.title: Nestlé and Mexico Expand Youth Employment Alliance
developments.summary: Nestlé and Mexico’s government have formalised an expanded strategic cooperation agreement under the Initiative for Young People. The programme covers Mexico and the other Pacific Alliance members—Colombia, Peru and Chile—and is intended to provide young people with technical training, work placements and formal employment opportunities.

developments.title: Gloria Takes Peruvian Milk Labelling Dispute to Constitutional Court
developments.summary: Leche Gloria has challenged Peru’s rules on what may be labelled evaporated milk, and the case has been sent to the full bench of the Constitutional Court. The dispute concerns whether reconstituted powdered milk can be used in a product sold under that name.

developments.title: Greek Yoghurt Ice Cream Gains Ground in Mexico City
developments.summary: Artisanal Greek yoghurt ice cream is attracting consumers in Mexico City through concepts such as Mika, which combine dense texture, generous servings and natural toppings. The product is being positioned as a form of “functional indulgence” for customers seeking a dessert aligned with their wellbeing goals.

developments.title: Extreme Summer Heat Puts Swiss Farms Under Financial Strain
developments.summary: Swiss farmers are dealing with feed shortages, animal illness, weak milk prices and parched grasslands after an exceptionally hot, dry summer. Farming representatives say the full financial impact may emerge later, when stored feed reserves become depleted and some farms face a higher risk of closure.

developments.title: Experts Say Some Dairy Remains Safe After Printed Dates
developments.summary: Food-safety experts say printed dates generally indicate quality rather than an automatic need to discard dairy products. Properly refrigerated milk, hard cheese and unopened yogurt may remain acceptable beyond those dates, while spoilage signs require caution.

developments.title: eDairy News and EDA will expand dairy-sector communication
developments.summary: eDairy News and the European Dairy Association have formed a partnership to broaden the international distribution of information from Europe’s dairy industry. The arrangement will give EDA a channel for sharing press releases, reports, events, policy updates and institutional news with eDairy News’s global audience.

developments.title: Prevalence of bovine mastitis and antibiotic susceptibility patterns of bacterial isolates in the Jaffna District, Sri Lanka
developments.summary: Background Bovine mastitis is one of the most economically important infectious diseases affecting the global dairy industry. In the Jaffna district of Northern Sri Lanka, information on mastitis prevalence, bacterial aetiology, and antimicrobial resistance remains limited, constraining evidence-based disease management. developments.institution: South Eastern University of Sri Lanka

developments.title: Dissecting the genetics of forage quality traits in soft red winter wheat in the U.S. southeast region
developments.summary: Winter wheat plays a viable role in agriculture, not only as a primary grain crop but also as a valuable forage source that bridges fall-spring forage gaps in many regions, including the southeastern (SE) U.S. Despite its nutritive potential, genetic basis of forage-quality traits remains insufficiently understood, limiting breeding efforts for dual-purpose cultivars. This study aimed to dissect t

developments.title: Silvopastoral systems enhance sustainability in the Yucatán Peninsula by improving ecosystem health and animal welfare
developments.summary: Cattle production based on monoculture pastures can increase greenhouse gas emissions, degrade soils, reduce biodiversity, and compromise animal welfare, limiting sustainability and resilience to climate change. Silvopastoral systems integrate livestock with trees, shrubs, and grasses and have been proposed as a more sustainable alternative. Here we show that silvopastoral systems in the Yucatán P
developments.institution: Universidad Autónoma de la Ciudad de México

developments.title: First detection and molecular characterization of influenza D virus in livestock from Kazakhstan reveals circulation of the D/Yama2019 lineage
developments.summary: Influenza D virus (IDV) is an emerging Orthomyxovirus primarily associated with cattle and increasingly recognized as a pathogen of veterinary and zoonotic relevance. Despite growing evidence of its circulation across Asia, Europe, and North America, no data have previously been available from Kazakhstan or Central Asia. This study investigated the presence of IDV in domestic livestock samples col
developments.institution: National Research Institute for Veterinary Virology and Microbiology of Russia

developments.title: Genetic characterization of natural resistance to ticks and babesiosis in cattle: Implications for safer food production
developments.summary: Background: Tick-borne hemoparasitic diseases remain a major limiting factor affecting livestock productivity. They affect animal health, productivity, and the safety of animal-derived products. Excessive use of antiparasitic agents may result in the accumulation of drug residues in animal-derived products, which may compromise food safety. Therefore, discovering genetic basis of the natural resis
developments.sourceName: Bioactive Compounds in Health and Disease - Online ISSN 2574-0334 Print ISSN 2769-2426

developments.title: A new report says dairy supports New Zealand’s economy
developments.summary: An analysis by Sense Partners says New Zealand’s dairy sector remains the country’s largest goods-export earner and directly supports more than 51,000 jobs. Dairy exports reached $28.8bn in the year to December 2025, while the sector’s economic effects extend through regional communities and other industries.

developments.title: Kansas Dairy Growth Depends on Immigrant Workers
developments.summary: Kansas has expanded its dairy industry over the past two decades, particularly in the western part of the state. Dairy operators and agricultural groups say immigrant workers are central to the industry, which also supports employment and population growth in rural communities.

developments.title: A Promise Made, A Promise Kept: America’s Dairy Industry Delivers on Second School Nutrition Commitment
developments.summary: As the 2026–2027 school year begins, dairy processors have delivered on back-to-back voluntary pledges to improve school meals—first reducing added sugars in flavored school milk and now eliminating certified artificial colors from school milk, [Read More ...]

developments.title: Wisconsin Dairy Group Calls for Farm Support Policies
developments.summary: The Dairy Business Association is urging elected officials to adopt policies supporting Wisconsin farms and efficiency improvements. Dairy farmer Travis Speirs said milk prices alone are not sufficient for profitability and backed measures involving loans, immigration and rural infrastructure.

developments.title: Maui Milk Raises Sheep-Farmer Payout to $17.18/kg MS
developments.summary: Maui Sheep Milk has increased its average supplier payment to $17.18 per kilogram of milk solids and changed how transport costs are allocated. The New Zealand processor is also seeking additional North Island farms as Chinese demand grows for sheep-milk nutrition products.

developments.title: Royal A-ware Moves to Acquire LaBan Foods for Butter Expansion
developments.summary: Royal A-ware is moving to acquire LaBan Foods, a South Holland producer of branded and private-label butter specialties. The transaction would bring LaBan Foods’ manufacturing capabilities and product range into Royal A-ware’s processing network.

developments.title: The Dairy Roadmap Sets New UK Dairy Targets
developments.summary: The Dairy Roadmap has published new environmental targets for Britain’s dairy-processing industry. The programme covers emissions and energy, water management, and plastics and packaging, with several deadlines running to 2030 and 2027.

developments.title: Northern Ireland Farmers Can Join £60m Bovine Genetics Scheme
developments.summary: Northern Ireland’s Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs has opened registration for a scheme supporting cattle genotyping. The programme will pay eligible farm businesses £13 for each submitted genotype.

developments.title: Herd management practices associated with bulk tank somatic cell count on dairy farms in Western Türkiye
developments.summary: The objective of this study was to determine the associations between bulk tank somatic cell count (BTSCC) and herd management practices on dairy farms in Western Trkiye. The material of the study consisted of 81 registered dairy farms. The farms were visited at approximately one-month intervals. Somatic cell count was determined electronically in the milk samples. According to the average BTSCC v

developments.title: Application of paracrine effect of fallopian tube stem cells derived from Holstein cattle to bovine mastitis
developments.summary: OBJECTIVE: Mastitis in dairy cows is a major cause of economic loss, and conventional antibiotic treatments often result in antimicrobial resistance and increased milk discard. This study aimed to evaluate bovine fallopian tube-derived stem cells as a novel source of mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) and to investigate the therapeutic potential of their conditioned medium (C-DPBS) in mastitis treatmen
developments.sourceName: Taiwanese Journal of Obstetrics and Gynecology
developments.institution: National Pingtung University of Science and Technology

developments.title: Nasal Carriage of Mycoplasma spp. and Mycoplasma bovis in Healthy Calves
developments.summary: Mycoplasma spp., particularly Mycoplasma bovis, are important pathogens of bovine respiratory disease and can colonize both clinically affected and healthy calves subclinically. This highlights the importance of detecting these agents in healthy herds to prevent silent transmission within the herd. This study aimed to investigate the presence of Mycoplasma spp. in the nasal flora of clinically hea

developments.title: Production and chemical composition of sesame forage at three harvest ages
developments.summary: ABSTRACT The phenological stage of plants affects forage production and nutritional quality. The objective of this study was to compare the production and chemical composition of sesame forage (Sesamum indicum L.) at three harvest ages in the dry tropics of Mexico. Dry forage yields (DFY) and chemical composition of sesame forage harvested at 58 (A58), 65 (A65), and 72 (A72) days of age were deter

developments.title: Coated trace minerals improved carcass characteristics and meat quality in growing sheep in association with enhanced antioxidant status and shifts in the rumen microbiota
developments.summary: Introduction Trace minerals (TM) are essential for maintaining normal rumen microbial function; however, excessive levels may exert toxic effects on rumen microorganisms and impair fiber digestion. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of coated trace minerals (CTM) on rumen fermentation, immune function, antioxidant status, slaughter performance, and meat quality in sheep, and to identify key

developments.title: Genetic associations of INHBE gene variants with milk production traits in dairy cattle
developments.summary: The inhibin subunit beta E ( INHBE ) gene encodes activin E, a hepatokine belonging to the TGF-β superfamily, and plays important roles in regulating lipid metabolism, energy homeostasis and immune responses. Our previous study identified INHBE as a potential candidate gene for milk traits through liver transcriptome analysis of Holstein cows. Herein, we systematically evaluated the genetic effect

developments.title: Combining Dense Longitudinal Records from Robotic Milking with Dense On-Farm Meteorological Data to Assess Heat Stress Effects in Dairy Cows
developments.summary: Climate change is increasing the frequency of heat stress events in dairy farming, adversely affecting milk production, milk composition, cow behavior, and animal health. However, many previous studies relied on distant weather-station data and low-frequency milk recording systems, limiting the assessment of short-term and delayed heat stress responses. Therefore, the aim of this study was to comb

developments.title: Morocco’s Dairy Farmers Face Higher Costs for Imported Cattle
developments.summary: Moroccan dairy farmers and cooperatives are encountering higher costs and limited availability when sourcing cattle from abroad. Import restrictions affecting some European countries have further constrained supply, while authorities are expected to ease procedures for certain countries in October.

developments.title: The EEC Sets Import Quotas for Meat and Whey in 2027
developments.summary: The Board of the Eurasian Economic Commission has determined tariff quotas for the import of meat and dairy whey into the EAEU in 2027. The quotas are distributed among Armenia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and Russia for specific product categories.

developments.title: SPACE 2026 presents 12 dairy-farming innovations
developments.summary: SPACE 2026 in Rennes is featuring 12 technologies for cattle and dairy production among 32 Innov’Space award recipients. The selected products cover animal health, reproduction, nutrition, hygiene, housing and digital farm management.

developments.title: Southwest Dairy Day Will Take Place in Dalhart on September 2, 2026
developments.summary: Southwest Dairy Day is scheduled for September 2 at the Rita Blanca Coliseum in Dalhart, Texas. The free public event will examine the dairy industry from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m.

developments.title: Modi and Gujarat Speaker Discuss Dairy and Agriculture
developments.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Shankar Chaudhary, the speaker of Gujarat’s Legislative Assembly and chairman of Banas Dairy, in New Delhi on Tuesday. Their discussions covered agriculture, dairy co-operatives, livestock farmers, rural communities and the GOBARdhan scheme, which Chaudhary said has an investment of more than Rs 23,000 crore.

developments.title: Haryana bans analogue paneer for one year after testing
developments.summary: The Haryana government has prohibited analogue and non-dairy paneer throughout the state for 12 months. The order follows testing in which nearly 70% of examined paneer and dairy-like samples reportedly failed to meet prescribed standards.

developments.title: UP Women Lead a ₹5,716 Crore Dairy Network
developments.summary: A dairy network in Uttar Pradesh connects more than 388,000 women shareholders across 6,603 villages in 31 districts. Its enterprises collect about 1.25 million litres of raw milk each day and pay members directly into their bank accounts.

developments.title: Cargill Opens Punjab Dairy-Feed Plant
developments.summary: Cargill Animal Nutrition & Health has inaugurated a dairy-feed manufacturing plant in Wazirabad, Punjab, with an investment of Rs 300 crore. The facility will produce 400,000 metric tonnes a year and is expected to create more than 1,000 direct and indirect jobs.

developments.title: Maharashtra FDA Seizes Adulterated Milk in Navi Mumbai
developments.summary: Maharashtra’s Food and Drugs Administration, working with local police, raided suspected milk-adulteration sites in Navi Mumbai and seized more than 1,000 litres of altered milk. Authorities also confiscated sealing equipment and packaging materials, while several suspects were taken into custody.

developments.title: Madhya Pradesh FDA Intensifies Dairy Checks Ahead of Festivals
developments.summary: Food-safety teams in Bhopal seized 316kg of suspected adulterated milk products during inspections at two major transit points. The consignments, valued at about ₹78,000, had arrived by bus cargo from Nagpur in neighbouring Maharashtra.

developments.title: INALE faces funding pressure after Uruguay lawmakers reject plan
developments.summary: Uruguay’s Chamber of Representatives rejected a proposed change to the financing of the National Milk Institute (INALE). The institute’s producer representatives say its available resources extend only through the end of 2026, while the bill now moves to the Senate.

developments.title: U.S. Dairy Processors Commit $13 Billion to Protein Products
developments.summary: U.S. dairy processors are investing $13 billion in facilities designed to produce higher-value products, including cheese, milk, yogurt and powders. The investment covers new and upgraded plants across major milk-producing states.

developments.title: Strong Cream Returns and Dairy Exports Lift Noumi Ahead of $737M Privatization Deal
developments.summary: Noumi posts 8.8% revenue growth to $648.4M in FY26 as surging bulk cream prices and long-life dairy exports lift earnings ahead of going private.

developments.title: 77% of Tirlán Suppliers Face Winter Fodder Shortage as Severe Drought Parches Southeast Ireland
developments.summary: A Tirlán survey reveals 77% of suppliers face winter fodder deficits as severe drought in southeast Ireland forces early silage feeding.

developments.title: Taranaki Herd Home Pays Off for Cows and Waterways with 30,000kg Milk Solids Gain
developments.summary: Taranaki dairy farmer Paul Kuriger lifts milk solids by 30,000kg and protects waterways with a $500K herd home shelter for 360 cows.

developments.title: Brownes Dairy Put Up for Sale by McGrathNicol as High-Protein Boom Fuels Oceania Dairy M&A Wave
developments.summary: WA's Brownes Dairy is officially up for sale via McGrathNicol as a boom in high-protein dairy fuels active M&A and revenue reaches $288M.

developments.title: U.S. Milk Production Hits 20.1 Billion Pounds in July as Dairy Herd Expands by 199,000 Head
developments.summary: U.S. milk production reached 20.1B lbs in July, up 2.2% year-over-year as the national dairy herd expanded by 199,000 cows to 9.71M head.

developments.title: $13 Billion Bet: Why U.S. Dairy Processors Are All-In on America’s Protein Future
developments.summary: U.S. dairy processors commit $13B across 19 states to expand cheese and protein capacity, preparing for 15B lbs more milk by 2030.

developments.title: NMPF Statement on Plan to Increase Beef Imports
developments.summary: NMPF is concerned by the Trump Administration’s decision to increase imports of foreign-raised beef, which will have unintended consequences for U.S. cattle and dairy producers alike. Cull cow and calf sales are a key economic [Read More ...]

developments.title: Governor Hochul, the Coca-Cola Company and Fairlife Celebrate Ramp Up at $650 Million, State-of-the-Art Dairy Production Facility in Monroe County
developments.summary: Facility Will Provide Support to Local Dairy Farmers, Has Created Approximately 380 New Full-Time Jobs. Governor Kathy Hochul, The Coca-Cola Company and fairlife today celebrated the initial ramp up of production at the new, $650 [Read More ...]

developments.title: Treasure Cave® Cheese Line of Products Now Available at Tops Friendly Markets
developments.summary: Buy One, Get One Free on Blue Cheese Dips & Spreads Aug. 22-27, in Celebration of National Buffalo Wing Festival. Treasure Cave cheese, America’s original cave-aged blue cheese, continues its expansion in the Northeast with [Read More ...]

developments.title: Capturing the Feedlot Value of Beef-on-Dairy Cattle
developments.summary: Key Takeaways With a historically small traditional beef herd and tight feeder cattle supplies, beef-on-dairy cattle, or dairy cows bred with beef cattle genetics, have become an increasingly important source of fed beef. Kansas State [Read More ...]

developments.title: Royal A-ware buys Dutch butter business
developments.summary: Dutch dairy group Royal A-ware has struck a deal to acquire local butter producer LaBan Foods. The post Royal A-ware buys Dutch butter business appeared first on Just Food .

developments.title: Western Australia's Brownes Dairy enters formal sale process with $288m revenue
developments.summary: McGrathNicol has begun a formal sale process for Western Australian milk processor Brownes Dairy after China Mengniu consolidated its ownership at parent level. The business is forecasting annual revenue of A$288m, compared with A$270m in the previous 12-month period.

developments.title: Bega Group spent A$2m pursuing Fonterra’s Mainland Group
developments.summary: Bega Group spent A$2m assessing and pursuing Fonterra’s Mainland Group, but Lactalis won the sale. The French dairy company acquired the entire business for $4.2 billion after negotiations involving the Bega brand and a legal dispute.

developments.title: US Tariffs on Canadian Dairy Could Aid New Zealand Exporters
developments.summary: A trade dispute between the United States and Canada is disrupting North American dairy commerce after Washington imposed 50% tariffs on selected Canadian goods. An analysis cited by NZ Herald said the changes could create openings for New Zealand suppliers of cheese, butterfat and dairy ingredients.

developments.title: U.S. Dairy Industry Backs Trump Administration in Escalating Canada Tariffs Dispute
developments.summary: NMPF and USDEC back Trump's 50% tariffs on Canadian goods, demanding an end to USMCA dairy market access loopholes and TRQ workarounds.

developments.title: Holstein Dairy Cattle Competition Returns to the Great New York State Fair with Largest Showing in a Decade
developments.summary: The Holstein Dairy Cattle Competition returns to the Great New York State Fair on Aug 30 with its largest showing in nearly a decade.

developments.title: Governor Hochul Announces $8.5 Million Available to Boost the Dairy Industry
developments.summary: Round 2 of the Dairy Modernization Grant Program Additional $12.75 Million Dedicated to Round 3 in FY 2026-27 Enacted Budget, Bringing Total Committed to Dairy Infrastructure Projects Under the Governor’s Leadership to $42.85 Million Application [Read More ...]

developments.title: Argentina's milk output rose 9%, while farmers' income fell 10.8%
developments.summary: Argentina produced about 9% more milk from January through July 2026 than in the same period of 2025. The increase did not offset lower milk prices: average producer revenue fell 10.8% in real terms and 6.1% in dollar terms.

developments.title: Santa Catarina creates a new route for small dairies to sell beyond municipalities
developments.summary: A new Susaf-SC certification gives small dairies in Santa Catarina a possible route beyond the municipal market. Municipal participation will be voluntary, and the system cannot operate fully until the state publishes additional sanitary rules.

developments.title: BRQfoods Restructures Operations After Selling the Matilat Brand
developments.summary: BRQfoods has made the Matilat brand transaction a central part of a broader reorganisation by Grupo BRQ. The company is directing investment towards three dairy plants in southern Brazil, with emphasis on capacity, technology and industrial production for other food brands.

developments.title: Drought is putting organic dairy farmers under severe pressure
developments.summary: A 2026 survey found that drought has left organic dairy farms concerned about forage, winter feed, stock levels and profitability. Many surveyed farms are reducing herd sizes, while a charity is preparing £2,000 grants for eligible farmers facing household financial pressure.

developments.title: British Farming Awards names 2026 dairy farmer finalists
developments.summary: The British Farming Awards has selected finalists for its 2026 Dairy Farmer of the Year award, sponsored by Asterra. The nominees are Wallhope Farm in Gloucestershire, Dowsons Dairies in Lancashire and F & M Mounty & Sons in Somerset.

developments.title: The 2026 Holstein show returns with its largest entry in nearly a decade
developments.summary: The Holstein Dairy Cattle Competition will be held at the 2026 Great New York State Fair on August 30. Organisers expect the event to attract its largest registered showing in nearly a decade, alongside new programmes focused on young dairy exhibitors.

developments.title: Aviação, With More Than R$600m Revenue, Projects 10% Growth in 2026
developments.summary: Brazilian dairy company Laticínios Aviação expects revenue to increase by 10% in 2026, following annual growth of about 8% in recent years. The Minas Gerais-based business is expanding through collaborations that place its butter flavour in products made by other brands.

developments.title: Yeast Supplementation Raised Milk Solids Output in Dairy Cows
developments.summary: Studies cited in a report found that yeast culture improved rumen conditions and was associated with higher milk, fat and protein yields. A Brazilian trial recorded an additional 1.26kg of milk and higher daily solids production among cows receiving the supplement.

developments.title: Granja Morelos expands with A2 milk and kosher cheeses
developments.summary: Granja Morelos has expanded its dairy operations in Aguascalientes by producing A2 milk and a range of Mexican and international cheeses. The company combines verified A2A2 cattle genetics with KMD certification under the Jalab Israel standard.

developments.title: DAERA invites Northern Irish farmers on Wexford and Louth study tour
developments.summary: Northern Ireland’s Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs has opened applications for a dairy-farming study tour to counties Wexford and Louth in the Republic of Ireland. The visit, scheduled for October 13–15, will examine methods and technologies for improving nutrient use on farms.

developments.title: A Castro Farm Increased Output from Six Cows to 64,000 Litres
developments.summary: A dairy farm in Castro expanded production from six cows to 64,000 litres. The account attributes the operation’s development to feed production, equipment management, workforce practices and cooperation among local producers.

developments.title: Brazilian UHT Milk Prices Rose Across All Regions in July
developments.summary: The price of UHT milk in Brazil increased by 4.1% in July, even as several other food items became cheaper. The rise was recorded in every region covered by Neogrid’s retail-price survey.

developments.title: General Mills Ends Häagen-Dazs Distribution in Brazil
developments.summary: General Mills has stopped distributing Häagen-Dazs ice cream in Brazil, removing the premium brand from the company’s local retail network. The decision forms part of a global portfolio revision announced by the American food company in March 2026.

developments.title: Chile set a historic milk-production record after 5.9% growth in 2025
developments.summary: Chile’s dairy sector recorded its highest-ever milk reception in 2025, rising 5.9% year on year to 2.5462bn litres. The figure covered both large and small dairy processors and marked the second consecutive year of expansion, according to the Centre for Dairy Information.

developments.title: Emmi Schweiz deploys three electric refrigerated trailers
developments.summary: Swiss dairy producer Emmi Schweiz AG has put three battery-powered refrigerated trailers into service on commercial delivery routes. The trailers run their refrigeration equipment without diesel and are being monitored for reliability, uptime and operating performance.

developments.title: Fristam Pumps India opens on-site service station at Milky Mist
developments.summary: Fristam Pumps India has opened a service station at Milky Mist’s premises to support dairy-processing equipment. The facility will provide round-the-clock technical assistance and faster responses for the more than 650 Fristam hygienic pumps installed across Milky Mist’s operations.

developments.title: Shibuya Hoppmann offers an ESL and dairy filling system
developments.summary: Shibuya Hoppmann is offering a filling platform for dairy, plant-based and extended-shelf-life beverages. The system supports multiple products, package formats and sterilisation methods while collecting filling and capping data for production monitoring.

developments.title: Preparation of Herbal Disinfectans: Effective Formulations and Application Method for Teat Cleaning
developments.summary: Objective: Mastitis is a common infection in dairy cattle which leads to significant economic losses due to reduced milk yield and quality. The main causative agents are Staphylococcus, Streptococcus and coliform bacteria. Contact with faeces under farm conditions encourages bacterial growth and udder tissue inflammation. Therefore, cleaning the teats before milking is essential for maintaining mi
developments.sourceName: Süleyman Demirel Üniversitesi Sağlık Bilimleri Dergisi

developments.title: From Genome to Phenome: Genotype × Environment Interactions in Organic and Conventional Dairy Systems and the Emergence of Genomically Optimized Organic Dairy (GOOD)
developments.summary: Organic dairy farming has expanded rapidly over the past three decades, driven by regulatory reforms, consumer demand, and growing recognition of its environmental, animal welfare, and potential human health benefits. Despite this growth, evidence comparing organic and conventional dairy systems remains fragmented across genetics, phenomics, animal health, and human health outcomes. This review sy

developments.title: Fonterra explores biomass fermentation for high-value dairy proteins
developments.summary: Fonterra is working with US food-technology company Superbrewed Food to use lactose permeate in biomass fermentation. The partners aim to develop non-GMO, allergen-free cultured protein ingredients for food and nutrition applications.

developments.title: Kenya's dairy programme will train 1,500 farmers
developments.summary: A dairy capacity-building initiative will support about 1,500 farmers at 10 training sites in seven Kenyan counties. The programme is part of the seven-year Pathways to Prosperity Coffee Project, which is funded by the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs and implemented by Solidaridad Eastern and Central Africa.

developments.title: Crystal Rivers Farm Increased Milk Solids After a $500,000 Herd-Home Investment
developments.summary: Crystal Rivers dairy farm in Taranaki increased annual milk-solids production by 30,000 kilograms after building a $500,000 covered herd home. The facility also enabled the 360-cow operation to continue milking for an additional month.

developments.title: Yogi Government Pursues Anti-Adulteration Enforcement and Dairy Expansion
developments.summary: Uttar Pradesh has combined intensified food-safety enforcement with programmes to expand its dairy sector. Official figures record extensive inspections and raids, while the state reported milk production of more than 388 lakh metric tonnes in FY2024–25.

developments.title: Tamil Nadu dairy farmers protest for higher prices and loan relief
developments.summary: Dairy farmers in Salem district blocked the Salem–Chennai National Highway near Attur for more than two hours on Monday. They called for higher milk procurement prices and a waiver of outstanding farm loans.

developments.title: A Market Review Identifies Five Under-the-Radar Indian Dairy Stocks
developments.summary: A market review has shortlisted Hatsun Agro Product, Parag Milk Foods, Dodla Dairy, Heritage Foods and Prabhat Dairy among India’s less prominent listed dairy companies. The comparison uses publicly available figures dated 23 August 2026, including market capitalisation, share price, valuation, returns on equity and leverage.

developments.title: Dairy Producers Are Shifting Net-Zero Focus to Efficiency
developments.summary: The dairy industry is broadening its net-zero strategy beyond methane-reduction technologies to include feed efficiency, herd productivity, manure treatment and carbon sequestration. An analysis by dairy nutrition specialist Alvaro Garcia identifies the efficiency of cows and farms as a central consideration in reducing the climate impact of milk production.

developments.title: Cow, Goat and Sheep Cheeses Differ in Taste
developments.summary: Cheeses made from cow, goat and sheep milk differ in texture, aroma and flavour because the underlying milk has different compositions. Production methods and maturation also shape the final product, while digestive responses vary according to the cheese and the consumer.

developments.title: Western Australia’s Iconic Brownes Dairy Enters Formal Sale Process Backed by $288M Revenue Momentum
developments.summary: WA's Brownes Dairy is officially up for sale via McGrathNicol, backed by strong momentum and $288M forecast revenue from 150M litres of milk.

developments.title: NZ Dairy Positioned to Benefit as US–Canada Trade War Escalates Over Cheese and Tariffs
developments.summary: NZ Herald analyzes how the US-Canada trade war and 50% tariffs on Canadian dairy create new export opportunities for New Zealand dairy producers.

developments.title: Taranaki Dairy Farm Lifts Milk Solids by 30,000kg and Extends Milking Season with $500K Herd Home
developments.summary: Taranaki dairy farm Crystal Rivers lifts milk solids by 30,000kg and extends milking by a month after investing $500K in a herd home.

developments.title: Fonterra Bets on Biomass Fermentation to Convert Dairy Lactose into High-Value Functional Proteins
developments.summary: Fonterra partners with Superbrewed Food to convert dairy lactose permeate into high-value biomass protein via advanced fermentation.

developments.title: USDA Dairy Market News Weekly Review: August 17–21, 2026
developments.summary: USDA Dairy Market News for Aug 17–21, 2026: NDM rises to $1.80/lb, butter and blocks soften, and Sept Class I base price drops to $17.04/cwt.

developments.title: Canadian Dairy Sector Urges Ottawa to Reject U.S. Demands and Hold Firm on Supply Management
developments.summary: Canadian dairy groups urge Ottawa to reject U.S. trade concessions, citing a $600M+ trade imbalance favoring the U.S. and national food sovereignty.

developments.title: IDFA Opens Nominations for Annual Industry Awards
developments.summary: Honoring Dairy Industry’s Top Leaders Nominations now open for 2027 IDFA Laureate, Innovative Dairy Farmer of the Year, Food Safety Leadership, and Workplace of the Year. The International Dairy Foods Association (IDFA) is seeking nominations [Read More ...]

developments.title: Strategies after Silage Harvest, Optimizing Reproduction
developments.summary: This week’s episodes of The Dairy Signal® from Professional Dairy Producers® (PDP) will feature timely conversations for making the most of your crop and herd productivity. Tune in on Tuesday for strategies to position crops [Read More ...]

developments.title: USDA raised its estimate of June milk production: More Cows Equals More Milk
developments.summary: The T.C. Jacoby Weekly Market Report Week Ending August 21, 2026 Dairy producers just keep adding cows. After surveying producers, USDA revised its estimate of the June milk-cow herd upward by an astounding 33,000 head, [Read More ...]

developments.title: Emily Yeiser Stepp Joins Holstein Foundation Board of Trustees
developments.summary: The Holstein Foundation welcomed Emily Yeiser Stepp of Leesburg, Virginia, to the Holstein Foundation Board of Trustees. The trustees oversee the direction of the Holstein Foundation’s youth and young adult education and leadership development programs. [Read More ...]

developments.title: Recording Now Available: Practical Tips for Implementing Biosecurity Practices on Your Farm
developments.summary: Thanks to those of you who joined us for yesterday’s “All Things Dairy” conference call! The recording is now available. With shifting weather patterns as we transition from summer to fall, our panelists shared a refresher on biosecurity [Read More ...]

developments.title: US dairy industry backs Trump in Canada tariffs row
developments.summary: Two US dairy-industry bodies have praised President Trump for "standing up" for the sector in the trade dispute between the country and Canada. The post US dairy industry backs Trump in Canada tariffs row appeared first on Just Food .

developments.title: New Zealand Dairy Farmers Invest More in Animal Housing
developments.summary: New Zealand dairy farmers are expanding their use of covered barns, enclosed housing and composting facilities. The systems are being adopted to protect pastures, manage nutrients, support cow welfare and improve farm efficiency amid environmental requirements, changing weather and improved milk payouts.

developments.title: Waikato Dairy Farms Attract Buyers as Rural Market Rebounds
developments.summary: Demand for dairy farms in New Zealand’s Waikato region has increased as milk payouts remain strong and rural borrowing conditions stabilise. Producers and investors are showing renewed interest in properties with productive land, modern dairy facilities and established environmental consents.

developments.title: Trump Hits Back at Canada Over Tariffs as Mark Carney Vows ‘Dollar-for-Dollar’ Retaliation Targeting U.S. Dairy and Steel
developments.summary: Trump hits back as Canada's PM Mark Carney announces dollar-for-dollar retaliatory tariffs on U.S. dairy and steel following a 50% tariff showdown.

developments.title: Canadian Farmers Face Renewed Uncertainty as Bilateral Canada-U.S. Trade Talks Conclude Without Agreement
developments.summary: Canadian farmers face fresh uncertainty after Canada-U.S. trade talks end without a deal, leaving dairy and agricultural sectors facing tariff threats.

developments.title: Scottish Dairy Producer Rowan Glen Invests £1M to Modernise Palnure Factory and Expand into Cottage Cheese
developments.summary: Rowan Glen invests £1M in its Palnure plant with Scottish Government support to modernize operations and expand into cottage cheese production.

developments.title: ‘Becoming With’ on the Dairy Farm: A Post‐Humanist Inquiry Into More‐Than‐Human Socialisation and Agency
developments.summary: ABSTRACT Literature has described dairy cows as both passive objects and active participants in the milk production process. This study explores how this passivity and activity co‐exist through an inquiry into dairy cow agency within a post‐anthropocentric conceptualisation of socialisation theories. Thereto, the dairy farm is framed as an anthroparchal total institution (ATI). Observations and vi

developments.title: Chile imported 472.8m litres equivalent as cheese gained ground
developments.summary: Chile’s dairy imports reached the equivalent of 472.8m litres in the first seven months of 2026, up 6.7% from a year earlier. Cheese imports increased while purchases of whole and skimmed milk powder declined.

developments.title: Heavy rains slowed milk deliveries to Conaprole
developments.summary: Excessive rainfall reduced milk production and disrupted collection in some parts of Uruguay. Conaprole’s milk intake still remained above its August 2025 level, while the cooperative reported more favourable signals from international markets.

developments.title: Drought threatens Spanish milk output with declines of up to 30%
developments.summary: Drought, heatwaves and higher feed costs are putting pressure on dairy farms in northern Spain. COAG says heat stress can reduce individual cows’ milk production by as much as 30%, while forage maize losses in Galicia and Asturias exceed 60%.

developments.title: Rowan Glen invests £1m to modernise factory and expand into cottage cheese
developments.summary: Scottish dairy producer Rowan Glen is committing more than £1m to upgrade its Palnure plant in Dumfries & Galloway. The project, supported by a £400,000 Scottish government grant, will add cottage-cheese production alongside the company’s yoghurt business.

developments.title: Nossa Santa targets R$2.5m revenue from blue cheese
developments.summary: Nossa Santa, an artisanal dairy in Ceará, has increased production since launching in 2023 and now reports monthly sales of more than four tonnes of cheese. The company is targeting a 50% increase in output and revenue of about R$2.5m in 2026.

developments.title: A Floating Dairy Farm Operates Without Pasture or Land
developments.summary: A floating dairy farm in Rotterdam uses urban food and agricultural by-products instead of pasture or distant imported inputs. It also processes milk on site and combines automated manure collection, rainwater treatment and solar power.

developments.title: New Technology Helps the Dairy Industry Reduce Losses
developments.summary: Companies presented technologies for measurement, packaging and automation at Fispal Tecnologia 2026. Emil displayed a packaging system that can cut material use by up to 70%, while Taimak showed equipment for continuous bottle feeding and pallet wrapping.

developments.title: Arla Denmark launches a lactose-free milk drink for children
developments.summary: Arla Denmark has introduced a new milk drink designed for children and young people who may choose other beverages in portable eating situations. The lactose-free product contains no added sugar and is sold in banana and raspberry flavours.

developments.title: Google reports growing Brazilian interest in protein and vitamin B12
developments.summary: Vitamin B12 ranked as the second most searched nutrient in Brazil, with 207,000 searches over the past 12 months, while protein placed third with 149,000. Searches for foods that support muscle gain led nutrition-related goals, reaching 222,000.

developments.title: Twenty-One Colombian Dairy Farmers Join to Improve Milk Prices
developments.summary: Twenty-one farmers in Fusagasugá, Colombia, have formed a collective marketing group to sell milk in larger volumes and reduce their reliance on intermediaries. Their association has received a 2,500-litre cooling tank and plans to begin collecting 700–900 litres a day.

developments.title: CCGL Raises Milk Solids’ Share of Payments to 40%
developments.summary: CCGL has revised its milk-payment formula for deliveries from associated producers, effective from early August. The Mais Sólidos, Mais Valor programme now assigns 40% of the total milk payment to fat and protein, up from 30%.

developments.title: Milk Prices Rose 11% in El Salvador
developments.summary: Milk prices in El Salvador increased by 11% between June 2025 and June 2026, according to an analysis by the Consumer Defence Centre. The rise exceeded the increases recorded for meat and eggs and was above the average annual growth of the urban basic food basket.

developments.title: NZ First’s policy will not lower supermarket prices or improve competition
developments.summary: NZ First’s “Use It Or Lose It” dairy proposal would expand access to raw milk for independent processors, but its stated framework would not reduce the cost of milk supplied to consumer markets. Analysts say the measure would be directed mainly towards export-oriented manufacturing rather than competition on New Zealand supermarket shelves.

developments.title: GEA Launches CowScout Cloud for Australian Dairy Herds
developments.summary: GEA Farm Technologies has introduced CowScout Cloud in Australia, adding cloud-based analysis to its herd-monitoring platform. The system combines continuous behavioural tracking with web and mobile access for farmers and veterinary advisers.

developments.title: Aguascalientes Seeks Federal Backing for Irrigation, Dairy and Livestock Projects
developments.summary: Aguascalientes has asked Mexico’s federal agriculture authorities to support the completion of irrigation upgrades, a milk collection centre and stronger cattle traceability. The agenda was presented by Governor Tere Jiménez during a meeting with Agriculture Secretary Columba Jazmín López Gutiérrez.

developments.title: Switzerland’s Reconstituted Milk Market Is Set to Grow
developments.summary: Switzerland’s reconstituted milk market is projected to expand steadily through 2035, according to a market analysis of the country’s dairy sector. Annual revenue is estimated at CHF 180m–230m, while volume growth is forecast at about 2–3% a year between 2026 and 2035.

developments.title: Soledad’s Dairy Production Declines Under a Long-Standing Sanitary Ban
developments.summary: Dairy farming in Soledad de Graciano Sánchez, San Luis Potosí, has contracted as a 40-year zoosanitary restriction, animal-disease risks and weak farm-gate prices affect producers. Most remaining farmers keep only small herds and are moving from liquid milk sales into artisanal cheese-making.

developments.title: Northern Veracruz dairy production will not regain pre-pandemic levels before 2029
developments.summary: Dairy farms in northern Veracruz have recovered about 20% of the output lost during the most severe phase of the Covid-19 crisis. Producers report that drought, water shortages and a smaller cattle herd have left many farms operating at roughly half their historical capacity.

developments.title: Pijijiapan will attempt to reclaim the Guinness record for largest quesillo
developments.summary: Pijijiapan, Chiapas, will seek to regain the Guinness World Records title for the largest quesillo, or string cheese, on August 29th 2026. Producers will try to exceed the current mark of 636.2kg, held by Reyes Etla in Oaxaca.

developments.title: Bihar’s Dairy Cooperatives Perform Strongly on Payments and Development
developments.summary: Bihar’s dairy cooperatives have been recognised as strong performers in using Direct Benefit Transfer for milk-procurement payments and in meeting targets under the Dairy Through Cooperatives project. The assessment was presented by Shirshat Kapil Ashok, a state government secretary, at a workshop on cooperative-led dairy development in eastern India.

developments.title: Bloor’s Dairy Improves Herd Health and Productivity with Brett Martin’s Marlon CST Heatguard
developments.summary: Bloor’s Farm in Cheshire has fitted a refurbished milking shed with Brett Martin’s Marlon CST Heatguard roofing. The polycarbonate sheets have increased daylight, reduced energy use and supported reported improvements in livestock welfare, milk yield and calving efficiency.

developments.title: Karnataka bans non-dairy paneer products for one year
developments.summary: Karnataka’s Food Safety and Drugs Administration has prohibited analogue and non-dairy paneer products across the state for one year. The order covers their manufacture, sale, distribution and use where non-dairy ingredients replace milk components or products are presented as paneer.

developments.title: India’s dairy shift could add 3.5 crore litres daily
developments.summary: A 5% annual movement from loose milk to packaged and branded dairy products could bring about 3.5 crore litres of milk a day into India’s formal sector, Jayen Mehta, managing director of Amul, said. He compared the potential increase with adding another Amul-sized business to the market each year.

developments.title: DN AGRAR reported a 49% fall in net profit
developments.summary: Romanian agrifood group DN AGRAR recorded RON 13.7 million in net profit in the first half of 2026, while turnover reached RON 90.3 million. EBITDA was RON 36 million, as lower milk prices and foreign-exchange losses affected profitability.

developments.title: Pottamlodi builds a self-sustaining community dairy model
developments.summary: Fifty families in Pottamlodi, Telangana, jointly manage about 240 indigenous cattle and share the milk they produce. The hamlet does not buy milk from commercial suppliers or sell its output to outside markets, while using cattle waste in organic farming.

developments.title: Gujarat Authorities Detain Man Over Suspected Adulterated Milk
developments.summary: Authorities in Gujarat detained a man after a raid in Porbandar district uncovered about 30 litres of milk suspected to have been adulterated. Officials also seized skimmed milk powder, palmolein and other materials, while food-safety officers collected samples for laboratory testing.

developments.title: EPSRR and Axton Capital Plan to Develop Restaurant Concepts in Sri Lanka and Oman
developments.summary: Indian investment company EPSRR Holdings Private Limited and UK-based Axton Capital have signed a memorandum of understanding to jointly develop food service projects in Sri Lanka and Oman.

developments.title: Plaintiffs Expand Claims Against Kraft Heinz, Lactalis and BelGioioso in Dispute Over Polly-O’s Heritage
developments.summary: A proposed amended complaint containing 370 paragraphs has been submitted in the legal dispute over historical assets associated with the U.S. cheese brand Polly-O. A second plaintiff has joined the case, and the family is now represented by the law firm KOR Law LLP.

developments.title: NZ First’s ‘Use It or Lose It’ Dairy Policy Will Not Lower Supermarket Prices or Fix Consumer Competition
developments.summary: Economic analysis reveals NZ First's 'Use It or Lose It' dairy policy targeting 500M litres of Fonterra milk will not lower grocery prices for consumers.

developments.title: New Zealand Dairy Farmers Accelerate Capital Investment in Animal Housing to Protect Pastures and Boost Production
developments.summary: New Zealand dairy farmers invest in animal housing and composting barns to protect wet pastures, lift milk solids, and improve herd welfare.

developments.title: UK Cheese Exports Reach All-Time High in Q2 2026 as Powders Gain but Overall Dairy Shipments Drop 25%
developments.summary: UK cheese exports hit an all-time high (+15.3%) and powders rose 22% in Q2 2026, but total dairy export volume fell 25% to 277,800 tonnes, reports AHDB.

developments.title: Dairy Farms in Hot Demand Across Waikato as Rural Real Estate Market Surges
developments.summary: Waikato dairy farms see surging demand and active buyer competition as strong milk payouts and stable interest rates revive NZ rural property sales.

developments.title: Open-Set Cattle Muzzle Identification: A Leakage-Controlled Benchmark and Evaluation Protocol
developments.summary: Reliable individual cattle identification supports disease surveillance, vaccination records, breeding management, and livestock insurance. Although the bovine muzzle provides a stable, non-contact biometric, existing muzzle-recognition systems largely assume a closed set of enrolled animals, limiting their practical deployment. developments.summary: Oxidative stress and the inflammation associated with it play key roles in the development of many chronic diseases. As alternatives to synthetic antioxidants, plant-derived materials with potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties—such as olive leaves (Olea europaea), thyme (Thymus vulgaris) and green walnut husks (Juglans regia)—have attracted increasing scientific interest. developments.title: Argentina's Mozzarella Production Sends 60% to Pizzerias
developments.summary: Argentina produced an estimated 108,000–110,000 tonnes of mozzarella in 2023, up from about 95,000 tonnes in 2019. Pizzerias accounted for roughly 60% of demand, with food manufacturers taking 25% and households 15%.

developments.title: Pedigree dairy sale reaches a top price of 3,650gns
developments.summary: The August Border and Lakeland club sale in Carlisle recorded a highest price of 3,650gns for a pedigree heifer. The 113 lots averaged £3,054 each, with 59 selling for at least £3,000.

developments.title: A Dairy Farm Raised Per-Cow Output to 16.5 Litres
developments.summary: A dairy farm that was largely unused for more than 15 years now produces 16.5 litres of milk per cow each day, compared with 8–10 litres when the project began in 2023. Its operator, Meneses, tracks production, reproduction, stocking, costs and profitability while changing pasture management and herd genetics.

developments.title: A Chilean study compares yoghurt and whey protein
developments.summary: A study by Chilean universities compared yoghurt with whey protein in sedentary older adults completing eight weeks of strength training. Both groups showed similar gains in muscle-related measures, while the yoghurt group recorded specific changes in gut microbiota.

developments.title: Effect of Baijiu bottom pot water on the chemical composition, microbial community and in vitro ruminal fermentation of king grass silage
developments.summary: Bottom pot water (BPW), a distillation by-product from the Baijiu industry, is rich in organic compounds but poses a disposal challenge. This study investigated the effects of BPW and Lentilactobacillus buchneri , on fermentation quality, chemical profiles, and bacterial community dynamics during king grass ensiling, as well as the subsequent in vitro ruminal fermentation performance of the result

developments.title: Growth performance, feed utilization, and immunity of Damascus growing goats fed different levels of Azolla
developments.summary: Abstract Background Azolla has gained increasing interest as a sustainable alternative to conventional feed resources due to its nutrients and bioactive substances. This study evaluated the effect of the replacement of traditional concentrate feed mixture (CFM) with dried Azolla pinnata (AZ) on feed utilization, rumen fermentation, blood metabolites, immunity, and growth of growing Damascus kids.

developments.summary: This article provides a critical, integrated analysis of the role of salt (NaCl) in the microbial ecology of salted food matrices, including meat, dairy, fish, and vegetable products, with particular emphasis on the emerging technologies capable of reconciling sodium reduction with microbiological safety. developments.summary: One-day workshops set for Oct. 14, 15 in Wausau, Fennimore A lifetime of good health and productivity starts on a dairy calf’s first day. The 2026 Calf Care Connection workshop® presented by Professional [Read More ...]

developments.title: Manfrey expands its robotic dairy operation in Córdoba
developments.summary: Manfrey’s robotic dairy facility in Freyre, Córdoba, began operating in March 2023 and now houses about 268 cows, close to its planned capacity of 280. The cooperative is building a second shed of similar size while adapting the system to production, animal care and working hours.

developments.title: UNL develops calcium- and vitamin-fortified rice pudding
developments.summary: The National University of the Litoral has developed a rice-pudding product made with powdered milk and fortified with calcium and vitamins. Its official presentation is scheduled for August 25 at the Dr Orlando Alassia Children’s Hospital in Santa Fe.

developments.title: Milla Expresses Interest in Starting Dairy Production in Tashkent
developments.summary: Azerbaijani dairy company Milla is considering establishing production in Tashkent, Uzbekistan’s investment minister said at a regional forum. The proposal was discussed as part of wider economic co-operation between Uzbekistan and Azerbaijan.

developments.title: A Documentary Takes Ecuador’s Chonero Cheese Tradition to an International Contest
developments.summary: “Stories and Secrets of Chonero Cheese” has received an award at Food Film Menu 2026, an international competition organised by the International Institute of Gastronomy, Culture, Arts and Tourism. The Ecuadorian short film is now competing with 13 other winners for the audience award, with voting open until August 30th 2026.

developments.title: Rising Sugar Prices May Reduce Durga Puja Sweet Variety
developments.summary: Confectioners in Kolkata say higher sugar costs could narrow the range of sweets offered during Durga Puja. Sellers say they cannot fully pass the increase to customers while milk prices and commercial cooking-gas costs are also rising.

developments.title: Cheese holes can be harmless or signal contamination
developments.summary: Small openings in cheese can result from normal maturation, trapped air or contamination. Renata Dinnies Santos Salem of the State University of Ponta Grossa says their shape, distribution and the cheese’s other characteristics can help distinguish among these causes.

developments.title: Meta-clustering of milk mid-infrared spectra identifies dairy cow groups associated with negative energy balance in early lactation
developments.summary: Clustering methods have been used to identify distinct groups of milk samples, cows, or herds. Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy, particularly mid-infrared (MIR) spectroscopy, has been applied to individual cow milk samples to predict various milk traits. Applying clustering directly to MIR spectral data may reveal latent groups of cows associated with milk traits or health disorders

developments.title: Antibiotic susceptibility of mastitis pathogens in Finnish dairy cows in 2022–2023: concerning changes in the penicillin susceptibility of Streptococcus uberis
developments.summary: Abstract Background Intramammary infections are the most common reason for antibiotic use in dairy cattle. A multiplex PCR has become the mainstay in determining the causative mastitis pathogens in Finland. developments.title: Rumen-host crosstalk: an amplifier of systemic pathology in heat-stressed ruminants
developments.summary: Heat stress (HS) is a primary environmental constraint threatening ruminant production, welfare and reproductive efficiency amid global warming. Current studies mostly focus on either systemic physiological damage or local ruminal dysfunction separately, while the bidirectional crosstalk between the rumen and host, as well as its amplifying effect on systemic pathology, remains to be systematicall

developments.title: Effect of in Ovo Bovine Colostrum Powder Administration on Embryonic Growth, Yolk Sac Resorption, and Blood Biochemical Profiles in Anadolu-T Broiler Chickens
developments.summary: This study evaluated embryonic responses to in ovo administration of bovine colostrum powder (Cp) during late incubation in broiler embryos. A total of 450 fertilized Anadolu-T broiler eggs were randomly allocated to six groups as a non-injected control (NC), a saline-injected control (PC), and groups receiving 1, 2, 3, or 4 mg of Cp per egg. developments.title: Faecal microbiota composition associates with systemic inflammatory marker and cytokine profiles in periparturient dairy cattle
developments.summary: The period around calving is challenging for dairy cattle, as many diseases and metabolic issues manifest, alongside major endocrine changes. A plethora of physiological modifications have been described at this time, including hormonal, metabolic, immunological and even gut microbiota-related changes. developments.summary: This study evaluated whey protein isolate nanoparticles loaded with chicory extract as a functional ingredient for fermented milk, such as Rayeb. Chicory aerial parts were extracted by ultrasound-assisted extraction (20 kHz, 50% amplitude, and 10 s on/5 s off), and the extracts were encapsulated in whey protein isolate nanoparticles using the desolvation method. developments.title: Tumor necrosis factor alpha triggers mitochondrial dysfunction and ROS-driven cytokine amplification in bovine fibroblast-like synoviocytes
developments.summary: Lameness in dairy cattle, driven by joint inflammation, involves fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLS) that produce inflammatory mediators and reactive oxygen species (ROS). Tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF- α ) has been proposed as an early systemic inflammatory marker that precedes and accompanies the development of lameness in transition cows.
