developments.title: Perk Farm brings a cow-birthing center to the fair
developments.summary: Perk Farm Organic Dairy has installed a birthing center at the fair in Fair Lea, West Virginia, with cows bred to calve around the event. The farm has recorded 21 calves this year, although no birth had taken place at the fair when the report was published.

developments.title: Visitors to Toft’s Dairy face 49 ice-cream choices
developments.summary: Toft’s Dairy in Sandusky, Ohio, has operated for more than a century and remains locally owned. Its ice-cream parlour offers 49 flavours, alongside food, coffee and dairy products.

developments.title: UK dairy exports declined as cheese and powder volumes rose
developments.summary: UK dairy exports fell year on year in the second quarter of 2026, according to the Agricultural and Horticultural Development Board. Higher shipments of cheese and milk powders did not offset declines in milk, cream, yogurt, whey and butter.

developments.title: Santa Fe Dairy Producers Report Severe Financial Distress
developments.summary: Alfredo Trionfini, a dairy farmer and leader of the Confederation of Rural Associations of Santa Fe, said producers of all sizes were facing serious economic difficulties. He cited stagnant milk prices, limited access to credit, debt, infrastructure problems and rising costs, while reports of productive cattle and entire dairies being sold have emerged.

developments.title: MIYM Acquires San Ignacio and Reaches Three Argentine Dairy Businesses
developments.summary: The Mexican group MIYM has acquired San Ignacio, a long-established dairy producer based in Santa Fe. The transaction brings its total number of dairy businesses in Argentina to three, following purchases of Lácteos Aurora and Lácteos Karina.

developments.title: Fairlife opens its $650m Webster milk-processing plant
developments.summary: Fairlife has opened a $650m milk-processing plant in Webster, New York, at a ceremonial event attended by Chief Executive Becca Kerr, Governor Kathy Hochul and local officials. The facility has created about 380 full-time jobs, exceeding the company’s initial target of 250.

developments.title: The U.S. challenges Canada’s cheese quota rules
developments.summary: The United States is pressing Canada to let grocery retailers obtain cheese-import quotas directly, rather than relying mainly on domestic processors and distributors. The dispute has resurfaced during bilateral talks linked to tariff threats and existing CUSMA rulings on Canada’s quota system.

developments.title: Status on the 2027 American Cheese Society (ACS) Annual Conference
developments.summary: We know the road to Conference 2027 has included a few unexpected turns, and we sincerely appreciate your patience and continued enthusiasm. Planning is underway, and we’re excited about what is taking shape. While we’re [Read More ...]

developments.title: Knowledge Nook Puts Dairy Innovation in the Spotlight at World Dairy Expo
developments.summary: Discover what’s new in dairy at World Dairy Expo’s Knowledge Nook, where companies, researchers and producers take the stage to share the latest products, services, technologies and research shaping the global dairy industry. Held in [Read More ...]

developments.title: NMPF latest Regulatory Register
developments.summary: The National Milk Producers Federation’s latest Regulatory Register outlines emerging and ongoing regulatory issues affecting American dairy farmers and their cooperatives in the areas of: Animal health Sustainability & environment Nutrition, labeling & food safety [Read More ...]

developments.title: DFA Statement on Section 338 Tariffs
developments.summary: The Trump Administration has announced a three-day pause on the Section 338 tariffs that were slated to go into effect on August 19 on certain imports from Canada, including dairy products. Michael Dykes, D.V.M., president [Read More ...]

developments.title: Dairy Leaders of Tomorrow Program Impacts 40,000+ Students
developments.summary: Free Courses & Curriculum Available The Dairy Leaders of Tomorrow Program is Free for High School Teachers and Students. To prepare high school students to pursue careers in the dairy industry, the Dairy Leaders of [Read More ...]

developments.title: Physicians group sues USDA and HHS over Dietary Guidelines for Americans
developments.summary: The PCRM is suing the USDA and HHS, alleging a "secret panel" of meat and dairy industry insiders illegally influenced the 2025 Dietary Guidelines.

developments.title: New Zealand First proposes expanded access to Fonterra milk
developments.summary: New Zealand First has proposed a policy that would give qualifying domestic dairy processors access to as much as 500m litres of Fonterra-supplied milk each year. The proposed entitlement would support new processing operations for up to a decade under amendments to the Dairy Industry Restructuring Act.

developments.title: Global dairy quotations rise as milk-powder demand firms
developments.summary: International demand for whole and skimmed milk powder has strengthened, while export availability remains limited. Recent quotations on the Global Dairy Trade platform and other wholesale markets have risen, supporting prices for butterfat products and cheese.

developments.title: Abbott Reaches $670m Settlement Over Premature-Baby Formulas
developments.summary: Abbott Laboratories has reached an estimated $670m settlement to resolve hundreds of US lawsuits involving milk-based formulas and fortifiers for premature infants. The families bringing the claims alleged that the products did not carry sufficient warnings about necrotising enterocolitis, or NEC.

developments.title: China's dairy demand creates opportunities for Pakistani exporters
developments.summary: China imported dairy products worth $12.78 billion in 2025, creating a larger market for Pakistani suppliers. Pakistan's trade authorities and dairy industry representatives discussed market access, regulations and distribution channels at a webinar on August 18.

developments.title: Skellerup reported record FY26 profit as global dairy demand surged
developments.summary: Skellerup Holdings reported an 18% rise in normalised net profit to NZ$54.2m for the financial year ended June 30, 2026. Higher international sales of dairy consumables, particularly milking liners, supported the result, with the United States and Europe identified as the main markets driving growth.

developments.title: New Zealand High Court clears GDX liquidators to recover millions
developments.summary: The High Court in Hamilton has ruled that payments made to 96 farmers for cattle supplied to GDX can be reclaimed as voidable transactions. Liquidators will seek about $9m, plus statutory interest, from suppliers who were paid before Genetic Development (NZ) Exports entered liquidation.

developments.title: Fairlife Celebrates Opening of $650M Webster Processing Plant, Largest Dairy Facility in Northeast U.S.
developments.summary: Fairlife opens its $650M milk processing plant in Webster, NY, creating 380 jobs in the largest dairy production facility in the Northeast U.S.

developments.title: Why the U.S. Is Fighting Canada’s Cheese Import Rules: The Battle Over Retailer Quota Access
developments.summary: BNN Bloomberg analysis: U.S. demands for direct retail cheese access in Canada threaten domestic processors and challenge CUSMA dispute rulings.

developments.title: September Class I Base Milk Price Drops to $17.04/cwt as Easing Butterfat Values Offset Skim Strength
developments.summary: September FMMO Class I base milk price drops to $17.04/cwt as lower butter and cheese prices pull down advanced pricing factors.

developments.title: Freshways Lifts Standard Milk Price by 6ppl to 38ppl for October as UK Milk Supplies Tighten
developments.summary: Freshways raises its UK milk price by 6p/L to 38ppl from October 1, 2026, responding to tightening domestic milk supply and forage challenges.

developments.title: U.S. dairy exports rise 9% in the first half
developments.summary: Robust gains in cheese, butterfat and low-protein whey keep U.S. dairy exports on a record pace. This follow-up to the June post takes a closer look at first-half trends, growth, and challenges that might lie [Read More ...]

developments.summary: Investors in Europe are increasingly backing livestock climate technologies that reduce emissions and improve farm economics, with significant funding going to solutions like EcoNomad’s BioNomad® system for small farms, methane-reducing feed additives from companies like Volta Greentech, and animal monitoring tools such as Hoofcount’s automated dairy footbath. developments.title: Genomic and phenotypic characterization of mcr-9 carrying Enterobacter oligotrophicus recovered from bovine mastitis
developments.summary: Bovine mastitis (BM) is a leading cause of economic loss in the dairy industry, driven by decreased milk yields, involuntary culling, and substantial veterinary costs. A single Gram-negative isolate recovered from BM was characterized in this study. For this, antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST) was performed using the Neg-Urine-Combo 98 panel. Whole-genome sequencing (WGS) was employed to i
developments.sourceName: Comparative Immunology Microbiology and Infectious Diseases

developments.title: Genome-wide association study reveals key genomic regions underlying colostrability in Italian Holstein cattle
developments.summary: BACKGROUND: Colostrum yield (CY, L) and concentration of immunoglobulin G (IgG, g/L) are important phenotypes to monitor in dairy farms because of their association with the risk of failure of the passive transfer of immunity in the newborn calf. This can occur when the CY of the parturient cow is insufficient or when the IgG concentration is low. Given that both of these traits are heritable, the

developments.title: Phenotypic determinants of milk yield and reproductive performance of stud British Alpine goats across agro-ecological zones in South Africa
developments.summary: Phenotypic determinants of milk production, reproductive performance, and dairy value of stud British Alpine dairy goats across South African agro-ecological zones (AEZs) were evaluated using 2422 performance records from 3037 pedigreed animals spanning 1960–2024, extracted from the national Integrated Registration and Genetic Information System (INTERGIS). Data were analysed using a restricted ma

developments.title: Evaluation of rumen undegradable protein supplementation on racing dromedary camel performance
developments.summary: Racing camels are a symbol of Emirati heritage and hold modern economic importance. While the benefits of rumen undegradable protein (RUP) are well-established in cattle, a significant research gap exists for RUP requirements in dromedary camels. This study examined effects of increased dietary RUP on racing performance and serology in UAE racing camels. Twelve racing camels (~1.5 years) underwent
developments.sourceName: Emirates Journal of Food and Agriculture

developments.title: In utero hyperthermia impacts the histological and transcriptomic signature of the mammary fat pad of newborn heifers
developments.summary: Abstract Development of the mammary gland begins in utero and requires coordinated interactions between the epithelial rich parenchyma and the surrounding mammary fat pad (mFP). In this study we investigated how maternal heat stress (HS) during gestation impacts the development of the offspring mFP. Mammary fat pad tissue was collected from Holstein heifers at birth that were gestated under either

developments.title: In-silico characterization of HspBP1 gene for identification of SNPs associated with silent estrus behavior in buffalo
developments.summary: Silent estrus behavior in buffalo is a great challenge to the sustainability of the dairy sector in Pakistan. To deal with reproductive failure, selection of animals with good estrus signs is crucial at the time of breeding. The current study analyzed the heat shock binding protein 1 ( HspBP1 ) to identify the single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) that may interfere with the normal expression of

developments.title: Plant-based dairy innovation is being driven by functionality and flexitarian diets
developments.summary: The global plant-based dairy market was valued at $22.7bn in 2025, with milk alternatives accounting for the largest share. Companies are developing products around protein, gut health, new flavours and improved sensory performance as labelling and affordability remain industry issues.

developments.title: Malaysia Approves Molfino and Arla Plants for Dairy Exports
developments.summary: Malaysia has approved three establishments in Argentina to export dairy products. The authorization covers cheese, milk powder, butter, proteins and whey derivatives, while Malaysia imported $1.393 billion of dairy products in 2025.

developments.title: September Class I Milk Price Fell to $17.04 per cwt
developments.summary: The Federal Milk Marketing Order base Class I milk price for September 2026 fell to $17.04 per hundredweight. Lower butter and cheese benchmarks outweighed stronger nonfat dry milk pricing in the factors used to set regulated fluid-milk prices.

developments.title: Brazil’s Government Approves Mutumilk Tax Incentive Through July 2029
developments.summary: Brazil’s Federal Revenue Service has granted Laticínios Mutumilk definitive access to the Mais Leite Saudável programme. The approval allows the dairy company to use specified tax credits while it carries out a three-year investment plan in the milk supply chain.

developments.title: Alejandro Armenta Plans to Revive Puebla Milk Collection Centres
developments.summary: Puebla governor Alejandro Armenta announced a plan to restore and modernise former Liconsa milk collection centres across the state. The project is intended to reconnect small and medium-sized dairy farmers with formal collection, processing and institutional distribution channels while supporting fair prices.

developments.title: Brazil’s Dairy Market Divides as Consumption Declines
developments.summary: Brazil’s dairy market recorded a 4.6% fall in real revenue and a 3.8% decline in sales volume in the first seven months of 2026 from a year earlier. The overall figures masked growth in several categories, including cheese, condensed milk, milk powder and yoghurt.

developments.title: Freshways raises standard milk price to 38ppl for October
developments.summary: Freshways will increase its standard farmgate milk price by 6 pence per litre from October 1, 2026, taking it from 32ppl to 38ppl. The British processor said the change followed shifts in milk supply and demand and tightening domestic collections.

developments.title: Francisco André’s Family Increased Milk Output Tenfold
developments.summary: A family farm in Brazil’s Mato Grosso do Sul state raised its daily milk production from 70 litres to 700 litres. The change followed technical assistance, adjustments to feeding and milking, and investment in farm equipment.

developments.title: Angus on Dairy turns dairy cattle into an extra income source
developments.summary: The Angus on Dairy programme uses beef-focused genetics in selected dairy-breeding decisions to produce calves suited to higher-value beef markets. It is presented as a way for dairy farms to add revenue while continuing their main milk-production activity.

developments.title: A man received over seven years for stealing 47,000 litres of milk
developments.summary: A court in Durango, Mexico, sentenced Jorge Armando Carlos Esquivel to more than seven years in prison for the aggravated theft of 47,520 litres of milk and dairy inputs. He was also ordered to pay nearly 500,000 pesos in fines and compensation to Comercializadora de Lácteos.

developments.title: Fat content determines whether cream becomes whipped cream
developments.summary: Cream intended for cooking and cream intended for whipping serve different purposes, and their fat content is a key distinction. A lower-fat product may thicken when beaten but is unlikely to develop the volume and stability associated with whipped cream.

developments.title: Association between animal welfare indicators and mastitis pathogens in bulk tank milk: the reality of small- and medium-scale dairy cattle farms in Italy
developments.summary: Introduction Animal welfare is increasingly recognized as a key determinant of dairy herd health, yet its relationship with the presence of mastitis pathogens at the herd level remains insufficiently explored. This study aimed to evaluate the association between animal welfare indicators and the presence of major mastitis pathogens in bulk tank milk (BTM) from dairy cattle herds in the Aosta Valle
developments.institution: Istituto Zooprofilattico Sperimentale del Piemonte Liguria e Valle d'Aosta

developments.title: Influence of sugar beet (Beta vulgaris) pulp on in vitro fermentation kinetics, methanogenesis, and total gas production of wheat straw in buffalo (Bubalus bubalis)
developments.summary: Introduction Wheat straw (WS) is one of the major crop residues and valuable feed resources for livestock reared by the resource-poor farmers of many Asian countries. Sugar beet ( Beta vulgaris L.) is a cash crop produced all over the world for sugar production by the industries. Strategic supplementation of sugar beet pulp (SBP) to a WS-based diet could modulate rumen fermentation by supplying hi
developments.institution: Central Institute for Research on Buffaloes

developments.title: Müller UK & Ireland reports £2.66bn revenue as profits more than double
developments.summary: Müller UK & Ireland recorded revenue of £2.66bn in the year ending 31 December 2025, up from £2.45bn. Profit before distributions to members increased from £34.3m to £70.7m, according to newly filed accounts.

developments.title: India’s buffalo-meat exports crossed $5.1bn in FY2025-26
developments.summary: India’s buffalo-meat exports rose by 25.6% to $5.1bn in FY2025-26. Farmers can receive about ₹50,000 for each culled buffalo, providing funds to replace animals and maintain milk production.

developments.title: Shade River Dairy transforms operations through full cost visibility
developments.summary: Shade River Dairy in Western Australia has used benchmarking and advisory programmes to build a detailed view of its production costs. The family-run farm manages about 300 cows and supplies more than 60,000 litres of milk each week to local Italian artisan cheesemakers.

developments.title: Bega Group returned to profit with FY26 statutory PAT of $54.8m
developments.summary: Bega Group reported statutory profit after tax of $54.8m for FY26 as manufacturing changes supported its earnings recovery. Normalised EBITDA rose in both the Branded and Bulk ingredients divisions.

developments.title: Dairy farmers can enter the 2026 Gold Cup competition
developments.summary: Dairy farmers have until 11 September to enter the 2026 RABDF NMR Gold Cup, which recognises performance in areas including herd health, efficiency, management and innovation. The competition is open to several production systems, with the overall winner due to be announced at Dairy-Tech on 3 February 2027.

developments.title: Bhopal Milk Union Raises Procurement by 38%
developments.summary: The Bhopal Milk Union increased daily milk procurement by about 38% over the past year, from 2.76 lakh kg to 3.81 lakh kg. The wider cooperative organisation that markets Sanchi milk in Madhya Pradesh also recorded growth, reaching 10.50 lakh kg per day from 8.73 lakh kg.

developments.title: Noida food-safety officials intensify paneer and khoya inspections
developments.summary: Food-safety teams in Noida collected paneer and khoya samples from a dairy establishment and a retail vendor during an intensified surveillance campaign. The samples were sent to accredited government laboratories, while authorities said enforcement action would depend on the test results.

developments.title: Study links faecal microbiota to inflammatory responses in dairy cows
developments.summary: A study of 411 dairy cows on 25 farms examined links between gut microbiota and immune responses around calving. Researchers identified four cytokine profiles and found that some individual inflammatory markers were associated with particular microbial taxa.

developments.title: Punjab and Haryana High Court Grants Bail to Security Guard in Modern Dairies Milk Theft Case
developments.summary: The Punjab and Haryana High Court granted regular bail to a security guard accused in the alleged theft of 9,110kg of milk worth ₹7.68 lakh from Modern Dairies’ facility in Haryana. Justice Manisha Batra cited the principle that bail is the rule and imprisonment is an exception after the guard had spent about eight months in custody.

developments.title: Lácteos Verónica filed for creditor proceedings with debts above $15.9bn
developments.summary: Argentine dairy company Lácteos Verónica has entered preventive creditor proceedings at a commercial court, reporting financial-system liabilities of more than $15.9bn. Its three plants in Santa Fe have remained idle or operated at minimal levels.

developments.title: Brazil Reviews Raw-Milk Cheese Rules as Debate Reaches Uruguay
developments.summary: Brazil is considering changes to rules governing artisanal cheeses made with unpasteurised milk, including Minas Gerais’s Canastra cheese. The discussion is linked to the Mercosur-European Union trade agreement and has prompted debate in Uruguay about regional standards, safety controls and market access.

developments.title: Algeria is developing Baladna’s $3.5bn Sahara dairy complex
developments.summary: Algeria is developing a dairy complex in Adrar with Baladna, the Qatari company, at an estimated cost of $3.5bn. The project is planned across about 117,000 hectares and is expected by the company to produce enough milk powder to cover roughly half of Algeria’s market needs once fully developed.

developments.title: U.S. Milk Production Tests Processing Capacity as Demand Expands
developments.summary: The USDA expects U.S. milk production to reach 236.6 billion pounds in 2026, an increase of 5.9 billion pounds from the previous year. Dairy exports were more than 25% higher in the first half of 2026 than in the same period of 2025, while processors expanded protein-focused products and cold-chain infrastructure faced greater pressure.

developments.title: U.S. and Canada Move Closer to Trade Pact but Leave Dairy Access Unresolved
developments.summary: The United States and Canada postponed threatened 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian imports as negotiators worked towards a bilateral trade agreement. Dairy-market access and Canada’s supply-management system remained unsettled, despite competing claims about the treatment of agricultural goods.

developments.title: NZ First Launches ‘Use It or Lose It’ Dairy Policy to Mandate 500M Litres of Fonterra Milk for Value-Add Processors
developments.summary: NZ First proposes lifting DIRA regulated milk access tenfold to 500M litres/yr to drive industrial-scale value-added dairy manufacturing in NZ.

developments.title: Manufacturing Rationalisation Drives Bega Group Back to Profit with FY26 Statutory PAT of $54.8 Million
developments.summary: Bega Group posts FY26 statutory profit of $54.8M as two years of manufacturing rationalisation and cheese consolidation lift revenue to $3.77B.

developments.title: Skellerup Delivers Record FY26 Results as Global Dairy Consumables and Export Demand Surge
developments.summary: Skellerup reports record FY26 profit of $54.2M (+18%), driven by a 15% surge in global dairy consumables and milking liners across the US and Europe.

developments.title: High Court Clears Way for GDX Liquidators to Claw Back Millions from NZ Cattle Farmers
developments.summary: NZ High Court allows GDX liquidators to claw back ~$9M from 96 farmers over the failed 2022 Ocean Ute live export shipment.

developments.title: Federated Farmers Urges Scrutiny of Milk Price Frequency, GDT Reliance, and Collection Security in DIRA Review
developments.summary: Federated Farmers urges DIRA review to scrutinize Fonterra's milk price review frequency, GDT reliance, and collection security for dairy farmers.

developments.title: Unmasking the internal structure of casein micelles through enzymatic hydrolysis: A SAXS study
developments.summary: Casein micelles, one of the most studied natural association colloids, are supramolecular assemblies of caseins and colloidal calcium phosphate that constitute the fundamental building blocks of dairy matrices. Despite extensive investigation, the internal structure of casein micelles remains debated. While $κ$-casein is known to ensure colloidal stability of casein micelle suspension, the spatial

developments.title: Trump Administration Faces Lawsuit Over Meat and Dairy Influence in Dietary Guidelines
developments.summary: The Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine has sued the US government over the 2025–30 dietary guidelines, alleging that industry-linked advisers improperly shaped the recommendations. The group is asking a federal court to withdraw the guidance and bar agencies from relying on it until a new process complies with federal advisory rules.

developments.title: Families Sue Over Deaths of Four Colorado Dairy Workers
developments.summary: Relatives of four workers killed at a Colorado dairy farm have filed a wrongful-death lawsuit against the farm owner and two companies. The complaint alleges that a ruptured manure pipe released hydrogen sulfide and that the site lacked essential safety equipment.

developments.title: U.S. and Canada Move Closer to Trade Pact, but Dairy Access and Supply Management Friction Remain Unresolved
developments.summary: U.S. and Canada near trade deal to avert 50% tariffs, but dairy access and Canada's supply-management system remain key points of contention.

developments.title: Nonfat Dry Milk Gains at CME While Butter and Dry Whey Soften in Midweek Trade
developments.summary: Nonfat dry milk rose 3 cents to $1.81/lb at the CME on Wednesday, while butter fell to $1.43/lb and 40-lb cheese blocks dipped to $1.575/lb.

developments.title: Wrongful Death Lawsuit Filed One Year After Toxic Hydrogen Sulfide Gas Kills Six at Colorado Dairy
developments.summary: Families file a wrongful death lawsuit against Prospect Ranch in Colorado after six workers died from toxic hydrogen sulfide gas in a manure pit.

developments.title: Why Ottawa Shouldn’t Mess with Quebec’s Milk: Defending Supply Management in a Volatile Trade Climate
developments.summary: Opinion piece in the Toronto Star argues Ottawa must protect Quebec's dairy supply-management system against U.S. trade pressure and tariff threats.

developments.title: Development and field validation of a large-volume bag-based whole-blood collection method in donor dairy cows
developments.summary: Obtaining sterile anticoagulated whole-blood units is a key prerequisite for downstream laboratory and clinical applications involving blood-derived products. In bovine medicine, however, published information on blood collection into bags is mainly embedded in transfusion-oriented references or broader downstream studies, while formal validation of donor-oriented collection methods remains limite

developments.title: Paratuberculosis vaccination induces a phenotype consistent with trained immunity in bovine neutrophils
developments.summary: Vaccination decreases bacterial shedding and reduces the incidence and severity of infection by Mycobacterium avium subsp. paratuberculosis (Map), the causative agent of paratuberculosis (PTB), a chronic granulomatous enteritis that economically impacts the dairy industry. An inactivated Map vaccine exhibits features suggestive of trained immunity in cattle, along with enhanced neutrophil (PMN) ac

developments.title: Antibacterial Efficacy of 6‐Gingerol Alone and in Combination With Enrofloxacin Against Multidrug‐Resistant Staphylococcus aureus Isolated From Goats
developments.summary: BACKGROUND: Goat mastitis is an economically important disease that reduces milk yield and quality while also posing a public health risk due to antimicrobial-resistant pathogens. OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to evaluate mastitis diagnostic techniques, isolate Staphylococcus aureus, detect methicillin-resistant S. aureus (MRSA) and assess the antibacterial potential of 6-gingerol alone and in comb

developments.title: Analysis of the incidence of Holstein cow mastitis and the effectiveness of the treatment regimens used
developments.summary: Mastitis remains one of the main causes of economic losses in dairy farming due to reduced productivity, deterioration of milk quality and premature culling of cows. The analysis of the prevalence of mastitis in Holstein cows in a high-tech complex was carried out and the effectiveness of the stepwise treatment regimen used was assessed. The study was conducted in 2025 on a population (n=2743) of

developments.title: Determination of the concentration of inflammatory and anti-inflammatory interleukines in dairy cows with infectious mastitis of staphylococcal etiology
developments.summary: The etiology of mastitis is associated with a high percentage (90 %) of isolation of bacteria of the genus Staphylococcus. According to statistics, the problem of mastitis in lactating cows is relevant, since it is associated with the economic costs of treatment and diagnosis. Modern diagnosis of infectious mastitis, based on biomarkers (interleukins) of the inflammatory process, will allow assess

developments.title: Effects of capsaicin on rumen fermentation under normal and acidosis pH conditions: A comparative Rusitec study with monensin
developments.summary: Capsaicin (CAP), the pungent component of chili peppers, possesses antimicrobial activity against a broad range of bacteria. This study evaluated the in vitro effects of CAP on ruminal fermentation under normal and acidic (SARA) pH conditions using the Rusitec system, in comparison with monensin (MON). By isolating pure capsaicin and applying a controlled dual-pH design, this study addresses uncer

developments.title: Polymorphism of the CSN3 gene and its association with the blood biochemical profile in Holstein cattle
developments.summary: Molecular genetic markers, such as the polymorphism of the kappa-casein gene (CSN3), are a important tool for increasing the efficiency of dairy cattle breeding. The aim of this study was to investigate CSN3 polymorphism in a Holstein cattle population and to assess its associations with blood biochemical parameters reflecting the animals’ metabolic status. In the studied herd (146 animals), allel
developments.institution: Tatar Scientific Research Institute of Agriculture

developments.title: Intrinsic and extrinsic factors associated with in vitro embryo production efficiency in bovines under tropical conditions in Colombia
developments.summary: This work aimed to evaluate intrinsic and extrinsic factors influencing in vitro embryo production (IVEP) efficiency in bovines under tropical conditions in Colombia. Retrospective data from 1 443 ovum pick-up (OPU) sessions conducted between 2020 and 2021 involving Brahman, Gyr, and Holstein cattle breeds were analyzed. Variables assessed included oocyte viability, cleavage rate, blastocyst yield

developments.title: Impact of adding filtered whole-genome sequencing variants on genomic prediction accuracy in Chinese Holstein cattle
developments.summary: Genomic prediction based on medium-density SNP chips is widely used in dairy cattle breeding; however, causal variants may be missing or insufficiently tagged, potentially limiting prediction accuracy. The increasing availability of imputed whole-genome sequence (WGS) -level variants provide an opportunity to prioritize informative variants, yet the optimal strategy for integrating GWAS-selected v

developments.title: Technical note: Micromanipulation flicking technique for embryo biopsy in bovine embryos
developments.summary: Embryo biopsy is widely used in human assisted reproduction for preimplantation genetic testing, but its application in bovine in vitro fertilization (IVF) programs remains limited, largely due to the cost and complexity of laser-based systems. Here we describe a micromanipulation method for laser-free embryo biopsy in bovine embryos that relies on a mechanical separation technique to collect embr

developments.title: α-Ketoglutarate enhances milk protein yield in dairy cows accompanied by increased rumen microbial protein synthesis and improved dietary crude protein digestibility.
developments.summary: Alpha-ketoglutarate (AKG), a key intermediate in the tricarboxylic acid cycle, has been demonstrated to exert multiple physiological benefits, including promoting growth, enhancing nitrogen utilization, improving immunity, and optimizing intestinal health in monogastric livestock and aquatic animals. However, studies investigating its effects in ruminants remain limited. This study systematically

developments.title: Influence of extrusion of white lupines on ruminal biohydrogenation of polyunsaturated fatty acids and milk fat composition in dairy cows.
developments.summary: The objective was to evaluate the effects of extrusion with or without reducing sugars before extrusion of white lupines on the ruminal biohydrogenation (RBH) of dietary polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFA), their transfer rates into milk and the milk fatty acid (FA) profile in dairy cows. Sixteen multiparous Holstein cows were assigned to 2 separate replicated 4 × 4 Latin-square design experiments

developments.title: Toward improved calf health in French dairy cattle breeds: Genetic parameters for calf survival across key periods.
developments.summary: Shifts in the dairy cattle industry have placed greater emphasis on breeding healthier animals. While adult cow health-related traits have historically been more studied than calf health-related traits, largely due to greater data availability, the significant impact of the latter on dairy production, especially calf survival, has gained increased attention. Several countries have already assessed

developments.title: Evaluating the performance of metabolic profiling for dairy cattle lameness classification: Biofluid and cross-farm comparisons.
developments.summary: Lameness has an unsustainably high prevalence in dairy cattle, causing a major welfare problem for the dairy industry that requires early detection and, ideally, prevention to reduce prevalence. Timely treatment not only improves animal welfare through better treatment outcomes but also reduces production and economic losses, thereby improving the sustainability of dairy herds. Novel methods for c
developments.institution: School of Veterinary Medicine and Science

developments.title: Researchers detected a novel Shamonda virus in French dairy cattle
developments.summary: Veterinarians reported fever, diarrhoea, lethargy and sharply lower milk production among dairy cattle in eastern France in June 2026. Nanopore metagenomic sequencing identified a previously undescribed Simbu serogroup orthobunyavirus, provisionally named European Shamonda Virus.

developments.title: Fazenda da Vovó targets 14,000 litres of milk a day for Danone
developments.summary: Fazenda da Vovó, a three-hectare dairy farm in Minas Gerais, plans to raise daily milk output to 14,000 litres while keeping its current footprint. Its production reached 8,700 litres a day in July 2026, up from about 2,900 litres in 2021.

developments.title: ABCZ brings PMGZ Leite to ExpoGenética for first time
developments.summary: The 19th ExpoGenética has created a dedicated place for dairy cattle, marking the first appearance of the PMGZ Leite programme at the event. Two pavilions display 36 animals from the Sindi, Girolando, Guzerá and Guzolando Max breeds.

developments.title: Farmers Weekly visits Chris Knowles’s dairy farm
developments.summary: Farmers Weekly toured Trink Farm, a 263-hectare dairy holding near St Ives in Cornwall. Chris Knowles runs 280 Jersey-cross Friesian milkers with his family and staff, combining farm machinery with contractors in a coastal environment affected by salt, slurry and granite.

developments.title: Conagua allocates 16m pesos to Coahuila farmers
developments.summary: Mexico’s National Water Commission, Conagua, is directing 16m pesos in federal support to farmers and producers in Coahuila. The funds will finance repairs and upgrades to agricultural water infrastructure, including wells, canals, gates and pumping equipment.

developments.title: Navarra's Dairy Model Combines Music with Lower Herd Density
developments.summary: Dairy farmers in Navarra use calm music alongside controlled herd sizes as part of a production system aimed at limiting animal stress and maintaining milk quality. Lacturale has reported internal gains of up to 5 litres of milk per cow per day, while a University of Leicester study found an increase of about 3% with slow, harmonious melodies.

developments.title: ICAR: India Must Reduce Food Losses During Storage and Processing to 5% by 2047
developments.summary: India needs to reduce food losses during storage, processing and transportation from the current 15–20% to approximately 5% by 2047. This target was outlined by Dr. Rajbir Singh, Deputy Director General for Agricultural Extension at the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR).

developments.title: Peru’s ProLácteos supports artisanal cheese production with 2,099 producers
developments.summary: Peru’s ProLácteos programme involves 2,099 milk producers and 87 artisanal cheese plants. Led by the Ministry of Agrarian Development and Irrigation and implemented by Agromercado, it operates in five regions.

developments.title: A free programme helps Goiás milk producers earn more
developments.summary: A financial-management programme in Goiás has helped rural producers revise pricing and reorganise their accounts. Maria Márcia Faria de Oliveira Pimenta, who produces canned meat in Firminópolis, reported a 15% to 20% rise in revenue after joining the initiative.

developments.title: Müller Yogurts & Desserts installs automated CIP system
developments.summary: Sycamore Process Engineering has completed an automated Clean-in-Place system for a Müller Yogurts & Desserts facility in the UK. The single-channel installation cleans stainless-steel mobile tanks and includes a docking station for 16 tanks.

developments.title: Yakult reports 38m daily consumers of its fermented milk
developments.summary: Yakult says more than 38m people worldwide consume its fermented milk every day. The figure was disclosed by Atsushi Nemoto, president of Yakult Brazil, in an interview with Folha.

developments.title: Nonfat Dry Milk Rose as Butter and Whey Fell
developments.summary: Nonfat dry milk strengthened at the CME, while butter and dry whey moved lower during the session. Cheese prices were mixed: 40-pound blocks eased, whereas 500-pound barrels were unchanged.

developments.title: Inspectors found non-permitted colours and expired dairy at Karnataka stations
developments.summary: Food-safety officials inspected 112 establishments across 36 railway stations in Karnataka and reported suspected use of non-permitted colours, expired dairy products and unhygienic food preparation. The inspection also identified fungal growth in vegetables and unsuitable plastic containers used for chutney storage.

developments.title: Chile's Dairy Processing Grew as Seven Categories Rose
developments.summary: Chile's dairy-processing activity increased during the first six months of 2026. Seven of 12 product categories ended the period higher, supported by greater milk intake.

developments.title: Halter Replaces Virtual Fencing Collars and Compensates Dairy Farmers
developments.summary: New Zealand agritech company Halter is replacing early-generation virtual-fencing and monitoring collars on dairy farms nationwide after battery and hardware failures disrupted winter operations. The company is also offering commercial support and labour concessions to affected farmers under its subscription model.

developments.title: Australian Dairy Processors Shift Towards Higher-Value Protein Products
developments.summary: Australia’s dairy processors are moving away from growth based mainly on larger milk volumes, according to a Rabobank report. The report identifies high-protein dairy, whey processing and premium export markets as areas receiving greater attention as domestic milk supplies remain constrained.

developments.title: Cuba’s inflation rose as oil and powdered milk prices increased
developments.summary: Cuba’s consumer-price index climbed 2.56% in July, taking the increase since January to 15.12% and the annual rate to 20.70%. Food and non-alcoholic drinks accounted for 63.18% of the monthly rise, with bottled oil and powdered milk among the most expensive items.

developments.title: An Offaly dairy farm extends grazing with Lely Grazeway
developments.summary: Aisling and Bernard Heavey now keep their 133 spring-calving cows outdoors for about an additional month after installing robotic milking and a Lely Grazeway. The system directs cows between three grazing areas on their farm near Tullamore, which supplies Lakeland Dairies.

developments.title: Tamil Nadu raises procurement price to ₹41 and announces ₹360 crore support
developments.summary: Tamil Nadu will increase the milk procurement price paid to producers from ₹38 to ₹41 per litre under Rule 110. The government will also raise its incentive from ₹3 to ₹5 per litre, with more than 3.16 lakh producers expected to benefit.

developments.title: Parag Milk Foods approves ₹105 crore capex to double cheese capacity to 120 MT/day
developments.summary: Parag Milk Foods has approved ₹105 crore in brownfield capital expenditure to raise its cheese-making capacity to 120 tonnes per day. The expansion will support its Go Cheese brand and increase output for retail, online and institutional customers.

developments.title: Gujarat’s women-led dairy cooperatives expand 21% as turnover tops ₹6,000 crore
developments.summary: The number of women-led primary dairy cooperatives in Gujarat has risen by 21% over five years to 4,562. The cooperatives now collect about 5.7m litres of milk a day, while their annual turnover has exceeded ₹6,000 crore.

developments.title: Hyderabad Police Seize 36 Tonnes of Synthetic Ghee
developments.summary: A joint task force in Hyderabad seized 36 tonnes of synthetic and adulterated ghee products made with palm oil, vanaspati and chemical flavourings. Police said the material was presented as genuine dairy ghee and distributed through commercial food businesses in Telangana and neighbouring states.

developments.title: BioCheese launches Australia’s first high-protein dairy-free cheese
developments.summary: Australian plant-based brand BioCheese has introduced Cheddar Shred with Protein, a dairy-free product containing 10g of pea protein per 100g. The product is available nationwide through Coles supermarkets and independent grocery stores.

developments.title: Milky Mist Dairy Food shares fall after post-listing rally
developments.summary: Milky Mist Dairy Food shares fell as much as 4.21% on Thursday after rising 42% over the previous two trading sessions. The decline followed the company’s debut at an 18% premium to its initial public offering price.

developments.title: Whipping Cream and Cooking Cream Serve Different Purposes
developments.summary: Whipping cream is formulated to incorporate and retain air, while cooking cream is intended to add texture, richness and flavour to hot dishes. Fat content is central to the distinction: stable whipped cream generally requires about 30% fat or more, and Argentina permits the label “Whipping Cream” for ultrapasteurised cream above 35% fat.

developments.title: Martín Berasategui says good mozzarella should smell milky
developments.summary: Spanish chef Martín Berasategui says a good mozzarella should have a gentle aroma of fresh milk, butter, yoghurt and cream. Fresh mozzarella should also remain moist and tender, with its preservation liquid retained until the cheese is used.

developments.title: Heritage Foods launches Nourish High Protein Curd
developments.summary: Heritage Foods has added Nourish High Protein Curd to its Nourish range in India. The launch expands the company’s protein-focused dairy offering as Indian consumers show greater interest in nutrition-oriented foods.

developments.title: Three Crowns Milk supported women at Imo event
developments.summary: Three Crowns Milk reaffirmed its support for women’s well-being and healthier living at the 2026 August Meeting in Owerri, Imo State. The FrieslandCampina WAMCO Nigeria brand provided health, finance and agriculture education, and gave equipment to 30 underserved women to start businesses.

developments.title: New York Dairy and Agricultural Producers Face Final Deadline for $30m Tariff Relief
developments.summary: New York’s dairy and agricultural producers face the final deadline for applications to a $30 million tariff-resiliency relief fund. Payments range from $1,000 to $25,000 per eligible legal farm business entity, with dairy operations covered under a separate funding track.

developments.title: Australian Dairy Pivots from Volume Processing to Protein Value-Addition as Milk Pool Constrains Cheese Model
developments.summary: Rabobank report shows Australian dairy shifting from volume to high-value protein and whey optimization as raw milk pool constraints cap cheese margins.

developments.title: Long-Term Breeding Persistence Lifts Victorian Dairy Herds to Top Spots in August ABV Rankings
developments.summary: DataGene’s August ABV release sees Victorian breeders top national rankings, led by Stuart Tracy’s No. 1 HWI Holstein herd and Parish family Jerseys.

developments.title: Halter Replaces Early-Model Virtual Fencing Collars and Compensates NZ Dairy Farmers for Hardware Disruptions
developments.summary: Halter replaces early-model virtual fencing collars and compensates NZ farmers for swap labor following battery issues during winter grazing.

developments.title: Henning Cheese Brings Home 2026 Wisconsin Grand Master Cheesemaker Title
developments.summary: State Fair Dairy Products Contest A century-old family tradition has reached another milestone as Henning Cheese has been named the 2026 Wisconsin Grand Master Cheesemaker, with fourth-generation cheesemaker and Henning’s co-owner Joshua Henning earning the [Read More ...]

developments.title: Treasure Cave Cheese Expands Distribution of Signature Blue Cheese to Wegmans Food Markets
developments.summary: Treasure Cave cheese, America’s original cave-aged blue cheese, is now available at select Wegmans Food Markets across the Northeast. The 5-ounce Treasure Cave Crumbled Blue Cheese and 8-ounce Treasure Cave Blue Cheese Dip & [Read More ...]

developments.title: Dairy Farm Families Invited to Next-Level Transition Planning Workshop on November 12
developments.summary: The Interactive Workshop Will Go Beyond the Basics With Transition Planning It’s never too early or too late to start thinking about “passing the torch” and finding someone in line to transition ownership of your [Read More ...]

developments.title: Cargill invites support to make an Original Impact at World Dairy Expo
developments.summary: Cargill knows true Originals don’t just show up, they give back. As part of its presence at World Dairy Expo 2026, Cargill is featuring three organizations whose impact extends far beyond the farm. The company is inviting dairy enthusiasts to help select a $5,000 donation winner in their booth during World Dairy Expo this year. “World Dairy Expo is an opportunity to celebrate the [Read More ...]

developments.title: CNY Feeds To Break Ground on New Dairy Feed Mill in Avon, N.Y.
developments.summary: The Northeast’s Largest Independent Dairy Feed Mill Makes Its First Expansion in Company History and Largest Capital Investment to Date. CNY Feeds, the largest independent dairy feed mill in New York, has broken ground on [Read More ...]

developments.title: More UK milk diverted to cheese and yogurt as liquid consumption continues to fall
developments.summary: More UK milk diverted to cheese and yogurt as liquid consumption continues to fall

developments.title: US pauses 50% tariffs on Canada
developments.summary: The US has delayed the introduction of a 50% tariff on a range of Canadian goods including alcohol and dairy. The post US pauses 50% tariffs on Canada appeared first on Just Food .

developments.title: Arla Foods Ingredients invests in Videbæk emissions reduction
developments.summary: Arla Foods Ingredients has completed an €8.3m heating-system project at its Danmark Protein plant in Videbæk. The upgrade is expected to cut carbon-dioxide emissions by 2,500 tonnes a year at production tower 4.

developments.title: Nestlé México launches practical nutrition-label guide
developments.summary: Nestlé México has introduced a guide to help consumers interpret labels on pre-packaged food and drinks. The initiative explains portions, energy content, ingredients and nutrient reference values alongside Mexico’s front-of-pack warning labels.

developments.title: Dr Meenesh Shah is appointed chair of IRMA School’s Executive Board
developments.summary: Dr Meenesh Shah, chairman of India’s National Dairy Development Board, has been appointed chairperson of the Executive Board of IRMA School. The appointment was made at the board’s first meeting on 8 July 2026 for a three-year term.

developments.title: Food-security loans rose 10.4% in 2024
developments.summary: Loans for food-security projects reached about 14.34bn riyals in 2024, up from 12.94bn riyals a year earlier. Lending to egg-producing chicken projects recorded the fastest growth, rising 219% to nearly 623.8m riyals.

developments.title: Richard Takáč will brief Slovakia’s government on drought and milk prices
developments.summary: Slovakia’s agriculture minister, Richard Takáč, said he would brief the cabinet on drought, low milk prices and other pressures facing the farming sector. He also named Klaudia Halaszova as the new chair of the ministry’s advisory board.

developments.title: A specialist explains how daily yogurt affects the body
developments.summary: Daily yogurt consumption is increasingly included in nutritional recommendations, but its effects vary according to the product’s composition and the consumer’s health. A nutritionist highlights possible links with digestive, muscular, bone and metabolic outcomes while stressing that much of the evidence is observational.

developments.title: Trump Delays Additional Duties on Canadian Goods by Three Days
developments.summary: President Donald Trump moved the effective date of additional US duties on certain Canadian imports from August 19 to August 22, 2026. The three-day suspension covers alcoholic beverages, dairy products and motor vehicles while US-Canada negotiations continue.

developments.title: Farm Bureau examines feedlot value of beef-on-dairy cattle
developments.summary: Beef-on-dairy cattle now represent more than one-fifth of animals entering US feedlots, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation. New Kansas State University research indicates that their performance is strongest when they enter feedlots at lighter weights.

developments.title: Beyond the Numbers, Facilitating Conversations That Matter
developments.summary: When creating transition, financial, or business plans with dairy farm families, facilitating those discussions can feel like a balancing act. How do you go beyond the numbers to facilitate conversations that actually help dairy farm [Read More ...]

developments.summary: Global specialty cheese market set to reach $40bn by 2031

developments.summary: BACKGROUND: Buffalo can efficiently convert fibrous materials into energy and produce milk and meat in harsh conditions that other ruminants cannot survive. OBJECTIVES: This study was conducted to investigate the effect of olive pomace (OP) on the quality of buffalo milk and yogurt and to improve its characteristics for human health. developments.title: Mastitis-Associated Antimicrobial Resistance in Sheep and Goats: A review of Risk Factors, and Environmental Transmission Pathway
developments.summary: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a global health threat affecting both human and animal sectors. Resistance occurs when microorganisms, such as bacteria, viruses, fungi, or parasites, become insensitive to antimicrobial agents to which they were previously sensitive at the recommended dosage, often due to misuse. Pathogens transfer resistance genes among themselves via transformation, conjugation

developments.title: A family cluster of brucellosis in an underserved urban community in Guayaquil city, Ecuador
developments.summary: Brucellosis is a neglected bacterial zoonosis caused by Brucella spp. with worldwide distribution. Infection typically occurs through direct contact with infected animals or consumption of unpasteurized dairy products, and the global burden of brucellosis is estimated over two million cases per year. In Latin America, brucellosis remains endemic, with important public health and economic consequen

developments.title: Indiana dairy farms face ongoing regulatory challenges
developments.summary: Indiana dairy producers continue to deal with regulatory uncertainty, according to Patrick Hash of the American Dairy Association Indiana. He said compliance costs and administrative requirements affect farms differently, while the same rules apply to operations of varying sizes.

developments.title: Dairy Checkoff strengthens SNA alliance to increase milk and breakfast participation
developments.summary: The U.S. Dairy Checkoff reinforced its partnership with the School Nutrition Association at the group’s Annual National Conference. The National Dairy Council presented chef-developed recipes and resources for school food professionals, including materials supporting the use of whole milk.

developments.title: Fazenda Limoeiro built Goldy’s award-winning Jersey dairy business
developments.summary: Fazenda Limoeiro in Itu, São Paulo, shifted from coffee production to Jersey cattle after a severe frost damaged its crops in 1978. Its milk now supplies Goldy Alimentos Premium, whose cheeses and other products won Super Gold, Gold and Silver medals at Brazil’s World Cheese competitions in 2024 and 2026.

developments.title: Humahuaca Restricts Sales of Dairy Products of Uncertain Origin
developments.summary: The municipality of Humahuaca in Jujuy has tightened checks on milk, cheese and meat lacking traceability after two positive brucellosis cases were detected in the province. Authorities recommend consuming only pasteurised dairy products and goods carrying sanitary identification.

developments.title: Rio Grande do Sul Court Sentences Milk-Adulteration Operator to 13 Years
developments.summary: A court in Rio Grande do Sul has sentenced an operator linked to a milk-adulteration scheme to 13 years and six months in prison, plus a fine. The ruling, issued on August 13, follows an investigation launched in 2013 under Operation Leite Compen$ado I.

developments.title: Paraná Opens Legal Path for Artisanal Raw-Milk Cheeses
developments.summary: Paraná has issued rules for producing artisanal cheeses made with raw milk. The framework requires certified milk suppliers, official inspection registration and documented controls covering production, water quality, traceability and transport.

developments.title: World Biogas Association gives Meenesh Shah inaugural global biogas leadership award
developments.summary: The World Biogas Association presented its inaugural “Strategic Leadership in the Global Biogas Sector” award to Dr Meenesh Shah, chairman of India’s National Dairy Development Board. The award was given at the AD & Biogas Industry Awards 2026 in Birmingham on 8 July.

developments.title: Academy Farm Integrates Water Buffalo with Robotic Milking and Residential Training
developments.summary: Academy Farm in British Columbia is using automated milking technology for a herd of water buffalo while operating within the John Volken Academy’s residential training programme. The farm also processes part of its milk into artisanal cheese and runs agritourism and retail activities.

developments.title: COAPAR raises R$8.7m for a milk-powder plant in São Paulo
developments.summary: COAPAR, a family-farming co-operative in São Paulo state, has raised R$8.784m from 643 investors through the CRA Cooperativas MST 16 offering. The funds are intended to support construction of its own milk-powder factory, working capital and purchases of inputs.

developments.title: Expointer 2026 will bring consumers closer to milk producers
developments.summary: Expointer 2026 will hold a dairy-focused programme from August 29th to September 6th in Esteio, in Rio Grande do Sul. Two initiatives will present the history of local cheese and the work of dairy farmers to visitors.

developments.title: The State Dairy Cow Contest in Coita rewarded Chiapas’s top dairy cows
developments.summary: A state dairy cow competition in Ocozocoautla, known as Coita, recognised animals for milk volume and consistent daily milking performance. The event highlighted tropical-adapted breeds and crossbreeds used in Chiapas’s dairy and dual-purpose cattle sector.

developments.title: Dr Meenesh Shah received the Visionary Leadership Award 2025
developments.summary: Dr Meenesh Shah, chairman of the National Dairy Development Board, received the Visionary Leadership Award 2025 at the 16th Agriculture Leadership Conclave in New Delhi. The award recognised his stated contributions to India’s agricultural economy, rural development and the dairy sector.

developments.title: Chiapas dairy farmers celebrate high yields as livestock potential consolidates
developments.summary: Producer groups in Chiapas have highlighted strong productivity across the state’s main milk-producing areas. The reported gains are associated with tropical-adapted cattle, genetic selection and improved pasture management, while higher volumes of raw milk are reaching collection centres and formal processing plants.

developments.title: India extends Dr Meenesh Shah’s NDDB tenure by three and a half years
developments.summary: The Government of India has extended Dr Meenesh Shah’s term as chairman of the National Dairy Development Board for three and a half years. The decision was announced on 2 January 2026 in Anand.

developments.title: NDDB and IDF agree to host 2027 World Dairy Summit in India
developments.summary: India will host the IDF World Dairy Summit from 16 to 19 November 2027 at Mumbai’s Jio World Convention Centre. The hosting agreement was exchanged in New Delhi by NDDB chairman Meenesh Shah and IDF director general Laurence Rycken.

developments.title: India’s 2026–27 Budget boosts dairy cooperatives toward Viksit Bharat 2047
developments.summary: Dr Meenesh Shah, chairman of the National Dairy Development Board, welcomed India’s Union Budget for 2026–27, which raises funding for animal husbandry by 16% to Rs 6,153.46 crore. The budget also sets aside Rs 500 crore for an entrepreneurship scheme covering livestock and dairy enterprises.

developments.title: Amit Shah inaugurates Ladakh Milk Federation initiatives
developments.summary: India’s Home and Cooperation Minister, Amit Shah, inaugurated a series of initiatives run by the NDDB-managed Ladakh Milk Federation on 1 May in Leh. The programme included a new dairy plant for Kargil, additional products at the Leh facility and a national digital milk-collection system.

developments.title: Saudi Arabia’s Livestock Exports Exceeded 8.4bn Riyals
developments.summary: Saudi Arabia’s livestock exports rose to 8.416bn riyals in 2024, up 11.53% from the previous year. Dairy products, eggs, honey and other edible animal products formed the largest category, while meat exports recorded a 29.02% increase.

developments.title: Lechetón Puebla 2026 sets a 150,000-litre milk target
developments.summary: Lechetón Puebla 2026 has begun in Mexico’s Puebla state, with a goal of collecting 150,000 litres of packaged milk. The campaign brings together the Cáritas Puebla Food Bank, local DIF systems, universities, business groups and civic organisations to supply vulnerable households.

developments.title: Paola Ruiz sustains Puebla fortified-milk programme for vulnerable communities
developments.summary: Paola Ruiz has led a three-year community initiative in Puebla that provides fortified milk at low cost to families facing socioeconomic vulnerability and food insecurity. The programme distributes pasteurised and ultra-pasteurised milk through neighbourhood delivery points and direct local campaigns.

developments.title: NDDB Foundation for Nutrition held national CSR conclave on nutrition security in New Delhi
developments.summary: The NDDB Foundation for Nutrition held a national conclave in New Delhi on January 6 on corporate social responsibility, nutrition security and malnutrition mitigation. Two nutrition programmes were launched, targeting about 7,000 children in Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh.

developments.title: Manipur Governor launches Manipur Dairy’s new brand and products
developments.summary: Ajay Kumar Bhalla, the governor of Manipur, unveiled the new name and logo of the NDDB-managed Manipur Milk Producers’ Co-operative Union on September 17, 2025. The cooperative will operate under the brand Manipur Dairy and has introduced new milk varieties and value-added dairy products.

developments.title: An IDF symposium on non-bovine milk begins in Anand
developments.summary: The ninth International Dairy Federation symposium on sheep, goat, camel and other non-bovine milk opened at the National Dairy Development Board in Anand on February 9th. More than 90 delegates are attending the three-day event, which includes seven technical sessions, poster presentations and exhibitors.

developments.title: Agrone agrees to buy Latvia’s largest dairy processor
developments.summary: Falber Investments OÜ, the parent company of Estonia’s Agrone, has agreed to acquire the group behind AS Rīgas piena kombināts, Latvia’s largest dairy-processing company. The companies have not disclosed the purchase price, and the transaction remains subject to regulatory approval.

developments.title: France’s Top 10 Dairy Suppliers Serve B2B Buyers
developments.summary: France has around 42,000 dairy farms and approximately 731 milk-processing sites, making it one of Europe’s largest and most diverse dairy markets. Its leading suppliers range from multinational manufacturers and cooperatives to specialist cheese, private-label and dairy-ingredient businesses.

developments.title: U.S. Holstein Breeders Align With Australia on Functional Cows
developments.summary: The latest Australian Breeding Values release places ABS Australia among the leading providers of proven Holstein sires, with seven of the top 14. The results coincide with greater attention in the United States and Australia to health, fertility and productive life rather than extreme body size.

developments.title: West Wales farmers are urged to attend Bluetongue meeting
developments.summary: The Agriculture and Horticulture Development Board will hold a Bluetongue meeting for farmers in Carmarthen as cases of BTV-3 continue to rise. Its tracker recorded 456 confirmed cases across the UK in the 2026-27 season by August 17, including 13 in Wales.

developments.title: Inflation has made plant-based foods cheaper than meat and dairy
developments.summary: Plant-based versions of six staple foods were cheaper than their animal-based equivalents at all nine Dutch supermarket chains surveyed by ProVeg in late April. The six-item basket cost about 18% less on average, although prices varied sharply by product and retailer.

developments.title: Calves are teaching Maine classrooms about dairy farming
developments.summary: Sixth graders at Reeds Brook Middle School in Hampden will join Discover Dairy’s free Adopt a Cow programme in October. Participating classes will follow calves through photographs, progress reports and, for some pupils, visits to the animals.

developments.title: Japanese Engineers Convert Manure into Organic Fertilizer
developments.summary: Kohshin Engineering offers Kazakhstani farmers equipment for aerobic composting of manure and poultry droppings. The installations process from 4.4 to 70 tons of raw material per day, with the finished fertilizer ready in approximately 30-40 days.

developments.title: India remains the world’s largest goat-milk producer
developments.summary: India produces about 30% of the world’s goat milk, according to Food and Agriculture Organization and national livestock data. Goat milk accounts for 3.32% of the country’s domestic milk supply and supports smallholder and landless farming households.

developments.title: Kerala launches Onam milk testing and 24/7 border screening
developments.summary: Kerala’s Dairy Development Department has begun a district-wide milk inspection campaign in Thiruvananthapuram ahead of the Onam festival. The operation combines free laboratory testing at Pattom with continuous screening of interstate consignments at the Parassala border checkpoint.

developments.title: Bombay High Court orders Maharashtra FDA to pay ₹5 lakh to Pune retailer
developments.summary: The Bombay High Court cancelled the operating-licence suspension imposed on Gurunanak Dairy & Sweets in Pune and ordered Maharashtra’s Food and Drugs Administration to pay ₹5 lakh. The court acted after a follow-up inspection recorded 98% compliance at the dairy and sweets shop.

developments.title: USDEC Sees Long-Term Dairy Opportunities in Sub-Saharan Africa
developments.summary: The U.S. Dairy Export Council is exploring long-term opportunities for American dairy suppliers in Kenya, Ghana, Côte d’Ivoire and Senegal, according to USDEC President and CEO Krysta Harden.

developments.title: Aavin Relaunches Automated Milk Vending in Nilgiris
developments.summary: Tamil Nadu dairy cooperative Aavin has restarted its automated milk vending service near Ooty’s Uzhavar Sandhai in the Nilgiris district. The pilot allows customers to buy milk in reusable containers, while supporting cashless payments and digital monitoring.

developments.title: Cattle Care launches AI-powered OmniFeed platform
developments.summary: Cattle Care has launched OmniFeed, a platform that uses artificial intelligence, computer vision and GPS data to monitor dairy-feed operations. It tracks activities from ingredient loading through delivery and records information on ration accuracy, inventory and feeder performance.

developments.title: Arla Foods Ingredients Invests €8.3 Million to Reduce Emissions at Danmark Protein Plant
developments.summary: Arla Foods Ingredients has completed an upgrade of the heating system in Production Tower 4 at the Danmark Protein plant in Videbæk, Denmark. The company invested approximately €8.3 million in the project, according to its press release.

developments.title: FDA authorizes CLiK Extra to prevent screwworm in sheep, cattle, goats and swine
developments.summary: The US Food and Drug Administration has issued an Emergency Use Authorization for Elanco’s CLiK Extra wound spray to help prevent New World screwworm infestations in several livestock species. The authorization also covers camelids and specified captive or captured wildlife, including deer, elk, bison and bighorn sheep.

developments.title: ATILRA Issues a Statement on SanCor’s Delayed Liquidation
developments.summary: Argentina’s dairy workers’ union ATILRA said the bankruptcy process involving former cooperative SanCor CUL had yet to reach a final ruling. The union called for marches, demonstrations and legal union actions over unpaid wages, job losses and delays affecting creditors.

developments.title: DFA retains top spot as Lactalis USA reaches third
developments.summary: Dairy Farmers of America remained the largest company in the 2026 Dairy Top 100, while Lactalis USA climbed from seventh to third after acquiring General Mills’ US yoghurt business. The ranking also listed The Magnum Ice Cream Co. at No. 5 after its separation from Unilever.

developments.title: Containerized Folding Solar Solves Off-Peak Power Dilemma for Australian Dairy Farm
developments.summary: A Victorian dairy installs a 105 kW folding container solar array with 241 kWh storage, offsetting 90% of grid power and securing milking operations.

developments.title: Fonterra and KMR Partnership Accelerates Catchment Remediation Across 149 Northland and Auckland Dairy Farms
developments.summary: Fonterra and KMR partner across 149 dairy farms, funding 350+ km of fencing and 202,000 native plants to protect the Kaipara Moana catchment.

developments.title: Global Dairy Breeding Convergence: U.S. Industry Adopts Australian Focus on Moderate Stature and Functional Longevity
developments.summary: U.S. and Australian dairy breeding converge on moderate cow stature and health traits as ABS Australia posts top ABV Holstein and polled rankings.

developments.title: GlobalDairyTrade: Price Index Rises 2.3% in Auction 410
developments.summary: At its 410th event, held on August 18, 2026, Global Dairy Trade (GDT) recorded a 2.3% increase in its price index compared to the previous auction, with an average winning price of USD 3,873 per metric ton. The New Zealand platform thus confirmed an upward trend that is reigniting expectations in the international dairy sector heading into the second half of the year.

developments.title: 2026 Dairy Top 100: DFA Holds Top Spot as Lactalis USA Surges into Top Three
developments.summary: DFA retains No. 1 with $23.1B in the 2026 Dairy Top 100, while Lactalis USA surges to No. 3 following its $1.2B General Mills yogurt acquisition.

developments.title: Canadian Dairy Sector Demands Federal Defense of Supply Management and Food Sovereignty Ahead of U.S. Tariff Deadlines
developments.summary: Canadian dairy groups urge Ottawa to defend supply management and reject new U.S. trade concessions amid CUSMA review and tariff threats.

developments.title: North Dakota Grassroots Groups Challenge State Dismissal Over 500,000 Gallon-per-Day Mega-Dairy Water Permit
developments.summary: North Dakota groups petition regulators to reconsider a 500,000 gal/day water sale to Riverview Dairy's 12,000-cow CAFO amid aquifer concerns.

developments.title: Incentive Programs Are Essential to Planet-Smart Dairy Leadership
developments.summary: Through public partnership, California dairy farmers have made world-leading progress, but more funding is needed to achieve goals and ensure long-term success. California’s dairy farms operate under the highest standards for food safety, labor, and [Read More ...]

developments.title: Cadbury breaks category boundaries with beauty launch
developments.summary: Cadbury owner Mondelēz International has partnered with Australian beauty brand MCoBeauty to launch a Dairy Milk Watermelon chocolate bar and matching cosmetics collection, highlighting the growing trend for cross-category collaborations between confectionery and beauty brands.

developments.title: The United States Threatens Canada with Up to 50% Additional Tariffs
developments.summary: The United States has threatened additional tariffs of up to 50% on a range of goods imported from Canada. The warning has renewed disputes over market access, regulation and trade protections within the North American trade framework.

developments.title: Arctic Coffee owner sees hit to revenue after tough year for dairy sector
developments.summary: Arctic Coffee owner sees hit to revenue after tough year for dairy sector
