developments.title: Select Sires graduates Holstein, Jersey, Ayrshire and Brown Swiss sires to daughter-proven lineups
developments.summary: Select Sires Inc. is excited to announce the addition of 13 newly daughter-proven sires to its lineup, highlighting health and wellness leaders, genetic diversity and economically important traits that drive genetic progress. The August additions [Read More ...]

developments.title: Associations between serum gamma-glutamyl transferase activity, sensor-derived traits, and blood biochemical markers in clinically healthy fresh dairy cows
developments.summary: Gamma-glutamyl transferase (GGT) is routinely used as a biomarker of hepatobiliary function in dairy cows, but its association with sensor-derived production traits and metabolic adaptation during early lactation remains poorly understood. This study investigated relationships between serum GGT activity, automated monitoring data, and blood biochemical parameters in 164 clinically healthy Holstein

developments.title: Farm-level factors influencing enteric methane emissions from dairy cattle in smallholder farming systems of Malawi
developments.summary: Smallholder dairy farms are the backbone of the dairy sector in sub-Saharan Africa but face constraints such as feed scarcity and climate effects, making them predominantly low-output systems with high methane emission intensities. A study was conducted in Malawi to determine direct enteric methane ( CH 4 ) concentration values (ppm-m) and to investigate the farm-level variables influencing CH 4 f

developments.title: Rural electrification as multi-sectoral coevolution: The geography of electricity and dairy sector development in Rwanda
developments.summary: Research on multisectoral interactions is gaining attention for its potential to address global challenges, including climate change, food security, and energy access. These dynamics are especially relevant in sub-Saharan Africa, where expanding energy access is a key policy goal. This study contributes to the literature on sectoral coevolution with a case from a novel geographical and sectoral co

developments.title: Milky Mist создала национальную холодовую цепь для панира
developments.summary: Milky Mist Dairy Food превратила панир из преимущественно локального продукта в упакованную категорию, поставляемую по всей Индии. Компания связывает закупку молока, переработку, холодильную логистику и розничную дистрибуцию; по данным её документов к IPO, ей принадлежит 17–19% организованного частного рынка упакованного панира в стране.

developments.title: Uruguay is targeting Indonesia and Vietnam to expand dairy exports
developments.summary: Uruguay has sent an official mission to pursue new dairy business in two Asian markets. The initiative focuses on expanding the country’s exports.

developments.title: Italac acquires assets linked to Líder and Tânia brands
developments.summary: Italac has acquired selected assets from A.R.C. Logística e Alimentos, taking over the Líder and Tânia brands in Brazil. The transaction also covers three dairy plants and milk-collection points across four states.

developments.title: Inspection seals determine where Brazilian dairies can sell
developments.summary: In São Paulo, the inspection mark on a dairy product sets the geographic area in which it may be marketed. Municipal registration limits sales to the place of production, while state and federal systems allow progressively wider distribution; only the federal seal also permits exports.

developments.title: Brazil’s Senate debates raw-milk cheese disadvantage after EU deal
developments.summary: Brazil’s Senate is examining whether outdated domestic rules put artisanal raw-milk cheese at a disadvantage after an agreement with the European Union. The discussion concerns the market access granted to foreign equivalents, while technical studies cited by producers attest to the sanitary safety of Minas artisanal raw-milk cheese.

developments.title: Tirlán sets July milk price and expands drought support
developments.summary: Tirlán set its July manufacturing milk price at 39.08c/L, including weather and sustainability payments, while putting the average creamery milk price at 43.82c/L including VAT. The processor also expanded supplier assistance to €15m and approved a five-year payment framework for liquid-milk and autumn-calving producers.

developments.title: Pão de Queijo Production Links Nearly 10bn Litres of Milk in Minas Gerais
developments.summary: Minas Gerais directed 48.5% of its inspected milk to cheese-making in 2025, while producing about 9.78bn litres of milk. The state accounts for roughly two-thirds of Brazil’s pão de queijo output, according to industry estimates.

developments.title: Сотни молочных фермеров провели митинг в Каримнагаре из-за земельного спора
developments.summary: Сотни молочных фермеров вышли на митинг в Каримнагаре, протестуя против предполагаемого перевода земельных записей Karimnagar Dairy в пользу Telangana State Dairy Development Cooperative Federation через портал Bhu Bharati. Участники потребовали вмешательства властей, восстановления записей на имя предприятия и выплаты молочной субсидии в размере 4 рупий за литр.

developments.title: В Раджастхане школьная молочная программа столкнулась с дефицитом поставок в 58%
developments.summary: Программа Pannadhay Bal Gopal Yojana в Раджастхане получила лишь 1 573,81 т сухого обезжиренного молока вместо требуемых 3 756,43 т за трёхмесячный период. Схема рассчитана более чем на 6,9 млн учащихся примерно 65 000 государственных школ.

developments.title: Wisconsin Links 988 Lifeline to Farmer Wellness Helpline
developments.summary: Wisconsin is connecting the national 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline with its 24-hour Farmer Wellness Helpline. The state programme provides confidential crisis support and referrals for agricultural workers and rural families, while farm organisations offer peer assistance and suicide-prevention training.

developments.title: GlobalDairyTrade raised its price index by 2.3%
developments.summary: GlobalDairyTrade’s 410th auction recorded a 2.3% increase in its overall price index on August 18. The average winning price was $3,873 per metric ton, while 41,054 metric tons were ultimately traded.

developments.title: Frederico Westphalen Sets a Milk-Production Record with Half the Producers
developments.summary: Frederico Westphalen, in Rio Grande do Sul, recorded a milk-production record in 2025 despite having about half as many producers as before. The municipality rose to fourth place among regional producers, while the state’s output declined by 12.5% over the same period.

developments.title: The Marmeleiro Project Uses Genetics to Raise Milk Production
developments.summary: A dairy-production project in Marmeleiro, Brazil, combines genomic evaluation, technology and farm management. Sebrae/PR and the municipal government presented the initiative on Tuesday the 4th to provide participating producers with tools for production decisions.

developments.title: Drought Cuts Maize and Milk, Raising Costs in Galicia
developments.summary: A lack of rain and high temperatures are affecting forage maize and pastures in Galicia. Milk output is already falling as heat stress affects dairy operations, while their costs are rising.

developments.title: Arun Icecreams дебютировал на параде India Day в Нью-Йорке
developments.summary: Бренд Arun Icecreams впервые участвовал в параде New York India Day 16 августа 2026 года. На мероприятии на Мэдисон-авеню компания распространила более 15 000 порций мороженого и представила продукцию индийской и международной аудитории.

developments.title: Nestlé develops nutritional and functional dairy products for GLP-1 users
developments.summary: Nestlé is developing protein-rich foods and dairy products for people taking GLP-1 medicines and other medical weight-control therapies. The Swiss food group says its portfolio will include protein, fibre and micronutrients in formats intended for consumers with reduced appetites.

developments.title: Brazil’s spot milk prices fell as southern supply increased
developments.summary: Brazil’s average spot milk price declined by 2.9% in the first half of August, losing R$0.09 per litre from the previous fortnight. The market’s weakness was reported across all regions, amid increased milk collection in the South and subdued final demand.

developments.title: Women-led dairy societies expand across Gujarat
developments.summary: Women’s participation in Gujarat’s dairy cooperatives has increased over the past five years. The state now has 4,562 women-led dairy societies, while nearly 1.2m women are among its 3.6m dairy producers.

developments.title: Saudi Tadawul index slips to close at 10,798
developments.summary: Saudi Arabia’s main Tadawul index fell 0.26% on Sunday to finish at 10,798.97, while the parallel Nomu market and the MSCI Tadawul Index also declined. Almarai reported a slight year-on-year fall in first-half profit, and CATRION signed a SR75.7m agreement with Dammam Airports.

developments.title: Stephen Keeley becomes Isle of Man Creamery managing director
developments.summary: Isle of Man Creamery has appointed Stephen Keeley as its managing director after 27 years with the dairy cooperative. He succeeds Findlay Macleod, who has left the role.

developments.title: Danone opens GetPRO Professional grants for UK grassroots sports
developments.summary: Danone North Europe has opened applications for the latest GetPRO Professional Grassroots Sports Nutrition grants in the UK. The programme, run with The Nutrition Society, offers up to £2,000 per award to early-career sports nutritionists delivering projects in community sports clubs.

developments.title: NFU Cymru Opens Search for Dairy Stockperson of the Year
developments.summary: NFU Cymru and NFU Mutual have opened nominations for the 13th Dairy Stockperson of the Year award. The winner will receive £500 and a Welsh slate cheese board engraved for the occasion.

developments.title: Dairy farmers adopt specialised soy varieties to raise milk solids
developments.summary: Dairy farmers and animal-nutrition specialists are increasing their use of specialised soybeans in cattle rations. The feed is intended to improve milk’s fat and protein content, consistency and sensory properties.

developments.title: Characterization of structural profiles and performance of dairy farms with automatic milking systems in Brazil: a national overview
developments.summary: The adoption of Automatic Milking Systems (AMS) has expanded worldwide, including in Brazil, but national-scale information remains limited. This study characterized structural and productive profiles of modeled farm units using AMS in Brazil based on weekly operational data provided by DeLaval and Lely. A conceptual equivalence procedure was applied to harmonize variables across systems. The data

developments.summary: A long with global warming, the increasing heat stress is one of the most significant environmental factors seriously threatening animal welfare, production/yield, and reproductive performance in dairy and beef cattle farming.This stress condition, which becomes evident when the Temperature-Humidity Index (THI) exceeds the 68-72 threshold, disrupts the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis, thereby

developments.title: Mexican cattle experts promote integrated tick-control strategies
developments.summary: Specialists in Mexico are advocating a combined approach to managing cattle ticks in tropical and subtropical grazing areas. The approach brings together acaricide-resistance testing, pasture management, biological tools and compliance with withdrawal periods.

developments.title: Mathura authorities destroy 500 kg paneer as dairy racket is probed
developments.summary: Officials in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, destroyed 500 kg of contaminated paneer valued at Rs 15,000 during a raid on a manufacturing unit. They also confiscated chemicals, raw materials and 2,000 litres of milk, while nine samples were sent for testing.

developments.title: Glebe Farm plans could create homes for a livestock farm and micro dairy
developments.summary: Plans have been submitted for three self-build homes on farmland beside Aylmerton in Norfolk. The applicants say the scheme would house two farming families and support plans to develop the site into an arable and livestock farm with an orchard and micro dairy.

developments.title: Synlait denies takeover talks with A2 Milk, Fonterra
developments.summary: New Zealand dairy and infant-formula business Synlait Milk has denied it is in takeover talks with The A2 Milk Company and Fonterra. The post Synlait denies takeover talks with A2 Milk, Fonterra appeared first on Just Food .

developments.title: Tamil Nadu deploys 24-hour milk vending to reduce plastic in Kodaikanal
developments.summary: Dindigul district authorities have inaugurated an automated milk dispenser in Kodaikanal, allowing customers to buy chilled liquid milk around the clock. The unit is part of a modern milk parlour and is intended to replace disposable polythene pouches with customer-provided containers.

developments.title: Long-Term Breeding Strategies Propel Victorian Farms to the Top of DataGene’s Genetic Rankings
developments.summary: Consistent breeding work has enabled several dairy farms in the Australian state of Victoria to significantly improve their positions in the August Australian Breeding Values (ABV) rankings prepared by DataGene. Stuart Tracy’s herd in Waratah Bay became the new leading Holstein herd for the Health Weighted Index (HWI), with an average score of 342.

developments.title: a2 Milk expects China constraints but maintains long-term growth outlook
developments.summary: The a2 Milk Company expects supply-chain disruption in China to limit revenue growth during FY27, with first-half revenue likely to remain broadly flat. It forecasts mid-single-digit growth for the full year as it rebuilds retail inventory and expands shelf presence.

developments.title: Argentina's Dairy Sector Seeks a Common Competitiveness Agenda
developments.summary: Argentina's dairy industry discussed a shared agenda at the sixth International Dairy Seminar in Rafaela on July 29. Participants from farming, processing and government examined export strategy, milk pricing, informality, animal health, infrastructure, technology and workforce development.

developments.title: A2 Milk reports 44% lower net profit after asset realignment
developments.summary: The A2 Milk Company reported net profit after tax of $113.6m for the year ended June 30, 2026, down 44% from the previous year. Revenue rose 12.4% to a record $1.97bn, while underlying EBITDA increased 5.4% to $307.6m.

developments.title: Dairy Processors Are Expanding Plants and Utilities for Protein Production
developments.summary: Rising demand for high-protein foods has pushed food-grade whey powder to about $1,960 per ton, more than 50% above its level at the start of the year. Dairy processors have committed over $11 billion to new and expanded manufacturing capacity in the United States, but the projects face constraints involving utilities, equipment and construction capacity.

developments.title: The Global Cheese Market Is Projected to Reach $328.71bn
developments.summary: The global cheese market is valued at $208.66bn in 2026 and is projected to reach $328.71bn by 2034. Mozzarella accounts for 37.19% of the market by product type, while plant-based cheese is expanding faster than animal-based products.

developments.title: Lactalis Secures UK Cheddar Leadership Following $1.33 Billion Saputo Acquisition
developments.summary: Lactalis takes the lead in the UK cheddar market with a $1.33B acquisition of Saputo's UK Dairy Division, including Cathedral City and 5 plants.

developments.title: Lactalis Acquires Saputo’s UK Dairy Division for $1.33 Billion to Dominate British Cheddar and Spreads
developments.summary: Lactalis to acquire Saputo's UK Dairy Division for $1.33B (£988M), taking ownership of Cathedral City, Country Life, and five processing plants.

developments.title: U.S. Dairy Sector Projects 15 Billion-Pound Output Expansion by 2030 Driven by Component Yields and Processing Scale
developments.summary: U.S. dairy prepares to add 15B lbs of milk by 2030 backed by $13B in processing investments, higher cow productivity, and expanding export demand.

developments.title: Irish Butter Wars Erupt in US Market as Tirlán Challenges Kerrygold’s Premium Dominance
developments.summary: Tirlán’s Truly Grass Fed and Costco expansion sparks a transatlantic butter war with Kerrygold, testing Irish dairy export margins in the US.

developments.title: Wisconsin’s National Dairy Shrine Preserves Industry Heritage and Innovation in Fort Atkinson
developments.summary: Wisconsin's National Dairy Shrine Museum in Fort Atkinson preserves agricultural history, honors leaders, and bridges the farm-to-table consumer gap.

developments.title: 2026 Southwest Dairy Day: Experience Innovation at Full Circle Jersey Dairy
developments.summary: Mark your calendars! The 2026 Southwest Dairy Day, SWDD, will be held on Wednesday, Sept. 2 in Dalhart, and promises to be one of the most exciting educational dairy events of the year. Co-hosted [Read More ...]

developments.title: Whole Milk in Schools: Join the Coalition Supporting PA Senate Bill 1362
developments.summary: The Pennsylvania Whole Milk in Schools Task Force invites your dairy business, your farm, or you to join a growing statewide coalition supporting Senate Bill 1362, introduced by Senator David Argall, to establish a Pennsylvania [Read More ...]

developments.summary: Many prior posts from this Blog Spot and other sources have expressed the problem for dairy farmers with the low price of components and the high price of feed, employees, and other expenses. This [Read More ...]

developments.summary: This week’s episodes of The Dairy Signal® from Professional Dairy Producers® (PDP) will give producers insights on tools and trends that will impact their bottom line. Tuesday’s episode will feature the new Cull Cow LRP [Read More ...]

developments.title: Junior Holstein Association Members Encouraged to Build Career Skills Through Virtual Interview Contest
developments.summary: Strong communication and interviewing skills give young people a valuable advantage as they prepare for future educational and career opportunities. Junior members ages 12 to 21 can build these skills through Holstein Association USA’s Virtual [Read More ...]

developments.title: GLP-1 Weight-Loss Medications Drive Global Surge in New Zealand Whey Protein Demand
developments.summary: Surging use of GLP-1 weight-loss drugs and fitness trends drives global demand and higher prices for New Zealand whey and bioactive milk proteins.

developments.title: Southland Dairy Family Scales Artisanal Paneer Operation to Major Retail Channels
developments.summary: Southland's Good Guise family scales artisanal, fresh paneer processing in New Zealand to supply major food service chains and Costco.

developments.title: South Australian Dairy Industry Honors Automation, Genetics, and Supply Partnerships at 2026 Awards
developments.summary: SADA honors top 2026 South Australian dairy producers for excellence in robotic milking, genomic breeding, processor ties, and sustainability.

developments.title: KMR and Fonterra support 149 Northland and Auckland farms
developments.summary: Kaipara Moana Remediation and Fonterra have worked with dairy farmers on fencing and planting projects across the Northland and Auckland catchments of the Kaipara Moana. The partnership has helped fund 248 applications, 202,000 plants and more than 350 kilometres of fencing.

developments.title: Lactalis Agreed to Buy Saputo’s UK Dairy Business
developments.summary: French dairy group Lactalis has agreed to acquire Saputo’s dairy business in the United Kingdom. The transaction covers five plants, 1,300 employees and brands including Cathedral City, Davidstow and Country Life, with completion planned for 2027.

developments.title: Henning Cheese Wins Wisconsin’s 2026 Grand Master Title
developments.summary: Henning Cheese has received Wisconsin’s 2026 Grand Master Cheesemaker award for an 18-month Traditional Waxed Cheddar made by fourth-generation cheesemaker Joshua Henning. The cheese scored 99.175 in the Wisconsin State Fair Dairy Products Contest and later sold for $550 per pound at auction.

developments.title: Crediton Dairy reported lower profits in difficult markets
developments.summary: Crediton Dairy’s profit fell from £10.4m to £7m in the year ending 3 January, while turnover rose to £137.6m. The owner of Arctic Coffee and Pro Mlk attributed the result to weaker dairy markets, late declines in milk prices and unsustained cream prices.

developments.title: Morelos Trains More Than 300 Women in Artisan Cheese-making
developments.summary: The Club del Queso initiative has provided specialised training to more than 300 women across 12 municipalities in Morelos, Mexico. The programme covers cheese production and dairy processing, with the stated aim of supporting self-employment and adding value to locally produced milk.

developments.title: Veracruz Producers Make Mexico’s Largest Fresh Cheese to Promote Dairy and Tourism
developments.summary: Producers and traditional cheesemakers in Veracruz made a fresh cheese described as Mexico’s largest, using thousands of litres of milk from local dairy-producing areas. The collective event brought together dozens of cheesemakers and was presented as a showcase for the state’s livestock economy, dairy products and regional tourism.

developments.title: Heatwaves and drought are squeezing Swiss cheese makers
developments.summary: Swiss dairy farmers are facing reduced milk yields, depleted grass and higher feed costs as heat and drought persist. Organisations representing Gruyère and Tête de Moine producers report falling production, although cheese stocks remain sufficient for the year-end period.

developments.title: BinDawood Holding wins bid for E-Piim production assets
developments.summary: Saudi retail group BinDawood Holding has won an auction for the Paide and Põltsamaa production assets of bankrupt Estonian dairy company AS E-Piim Tootmine. Its Estonian subsidiary JUUST & JUBN OÜ submitted the winning bid of €135.25m, although the transaction is not yet complete.

developments.title: Africa’s dairy deficit keeps milk prices high
developments.summary: Africa imported about $7.5bn of dairy products in 2023 while exporting roughly $1.1bn, leaving several major markets exposed to international prices and currency movements. Nigeria’s milk imports accounted for about 64% of domestic availability in 2022, while Zimbabwe recorded higher production alongside producer costs above average prices.

developments.title: Mexican Livestock Accelerates Shift to Sustainable Meat and Dairy Production
developments.summary: Mexican livestock producers are adopting production models for meat and milk that incorporate environmental management. The changes include more efficient use of water and feed, alongside demands from international markets for traceability, animal welfare and deforestation-free supply chains.

developments.title: Dairy cows made up 78.5% of factory cow slaughter
developments.summary: Dairy cows represented 131,606 of the 167,635 cows slaughtered at Department of Agriculture-approved factories in Ireland during the first half of 2026. Suckler cows accounted for the remaining 36,029 animals.

developments.title: Global Whey Permeate Market Could Reach $2.57 Billion by 2034
developments.summary: The global dairy whey permeate market was valued at $1.53 billion in 2025. It could grow to $2.57 billion by 2034, representing a compound annual growth rate of 5.9%, according to a study by Growth Market Reports.

developments.title: National Dairy Shrine preserves Wisconsin’s dairy heritage in Fort Atkinson
developments.summary: The National Dairy Shrine Museum in Fort Atkinson, Wisconsin, documents the development of American dairying and its processing technology. The organization was founded in 1949, and its museum facility opened in 1981.

developments.title: Brinkworth Dairy wins Champion Gelato prize again
developments.summary: Brinkworth Dairy, near Swindon, has won the Champion Gelato award at the International Cheese and Dairy Awards for a second consecutive year. Its salted-caramel flavour took this year's prize after the dairy's raspberry gelato won in the previous competition.

developments.title: Researchers Map Serra Gaúcha Cheese Microbiota
developments.summary: A project in Brazil’s Serra Gaúcha is examining the microorganisms found in raw-milk colonial cheeses. Researchers are studying how the local environment may be linked to differences in aroma, flavour, texture and other characteristics.

developments.title: Drought Cuts La Paz Dairy Production by 20%
developments.summary: Drought has reduced dairy production in La Paz by 20%, according to producers’ federation Fedelpaz. The sector also experienced 47 days of road blockades, with reported economic losses reaching 58%.

developments.title: Paul Turner completed a 102-mile walk for Alder Hey
developments.summary: Paul Turner, a tanker driver for Isle of Man Creamery, walked 102 miles between the island’s dairy farms to raise funds for Alder Hey Children’s Hospital. His granddaughter Imogen, who had been treated at the hospital, joined him for the final stretch back to the creamery.

developments.title: Vietnam Gains Ground as a Strategic Dairy Market
developments.summary: Vietnam is emerging as a strategic market for dairy products, supported by a population of 101 million. The market description highlights opportunities for milk powder, cheese, ingredients and higher-value dairy products.

developments.title: EuroTier 2026 to Showcase Robotics, Genetics and New Forage Production Technologies at DLG Spotlights
developments.summary: Seven specialized DLG Spotlights dedicated to livestock robotics, breeding, forage production, emission reduction, energy, and alternative proteins will be organized at EuroTier 2026 in Hanover. The exhibition will take place from November 10 to 13, 2026, under the guiding theme “Intelligence in Animal Farming.”

developments.title: Partially Hydrolyzed Formula Reduced Food Allergy in Infants
developments.summary: A multicentre trial found that partially hydrolyzed formula was associated with a 47% lower risk of food allergy by age five among children with a family history of allergy. The same group also had lower rates of atopic dermatitis than children given standard formula containing intact protein.

developments.title: European Union to Showcase Dairy and Other Agri-Food Products at Anuga Select India 2026
developments.summary: The European Union will serve as the Official Partner Region of Anuga Select India 2026, which will take place from September 29 to October 1 at the Bombay Exhibition Centre in Mumbai. The European Commission will host an EU Pavilion at the event, showcasing dairy products and cheeses, among other categories.

developments.title: DailyBiz Reveals Owners of Five Major Agricultural Companies in Kazakhstan
developments.summary: The Kazakh business publication DailyBiz has presented information about the owners and beneficiaries of five major agricultural companies in the country — "Olzha Agro," "Grain Consortium of Kazakhstan," "Rodina Agrofirm," "Atameken-Agro," and "Zhuravlevka-1." The publication also includes data on taxes and other mandatory payments made by these companies.

developments.title: Fonterra and A2 Milk explore taking Synlait private
developments.summary: Fonterra and A2 Milk are examining a joint proposal to take Synlait private. A2 Milk owns 19.8% of the processor, while Fonterra would act as a funding and operational partner.

developments.summary: Genomic selection tools for feed efficiency have been extensively developed and validated in high-input cattle breeds, but it is unclear whether the same candidate genes are equally well characterized in water buffalo (Bubalus bubalis), the dominant dairy species across Pakistani smallholder systems. developments.summary: As long as silage remains a common livestock feed, the risk of an injury or fatality from silo gases is present. Every farm worker must understand the dangers associated with silo gases and how to [Read More ...]

developments.title: Sauce Montrull now has only one dairy farm
developments.summary: Sauce Montrull in Argentina has gone from supporting many small dairy holdings to having a single operating dairy farm. Raúl Lell, whose family began milking there in 1959, continues to produce milk while soybean and wheat farming occupy much of the surrounding land.

developments.title: Good Guise expands paneer supply to Costco and Pizza Hut
developments.summary: Good Guise, a family business from Southland, New Zealand, has expanded its fresh paneer production beyond local customers. It now supplies Costco in Auckland and has produced paneer cubes for Pizza Hut and other food-service clients.

developments.title: Uttar Pradesh Orders Immediate Dairy Plant Closures and Criminal Penalties for Adulteration
developments.summary: Uttar Pradesh has ordered immediate plant closures, stock destruction and criminal cases when dairy processors are found using foreign fats or harmful chemicals. The measures were issued by the state’s Food Safety and Drug Administration after inspections and laboratory tests identified adulterated dairy products.

developments.title: South Australian Dairy Awards Honour Producers in 2026
developments.summary: The South Australian Dairyfarmers’ Association recognised dairy producers at its 2026 awards dinner. The honours covered automation, genomic breeding, processor partnerships and resource management, as SADA marked its 90th anniversary.

developments.title: Artificial intelligence helps Higher Bojewyan Farm halve its empty rate
developments.summary: Higher Bojewyan Farm in Cornwall has recorded an 8% empty rate after investing in herd-monitoring technology, half the level reported a year earlier. The farm uses smaXtec’s internal bolus system to track heat, rumination, activity and temperature through a mobile app.

developments.title: Pablo Barrio’s Argentine-Flavoured Cheeses Attract Export Interest
developments.summary: Pablo Barrio makes about 5,000 litres of milk each month and uses it to produce cheeses with a range of flavours. He says the products have drawn international inquiries, although he does not yet plan to begin exporting.

developments.title: A Paraná Dairy Family Has Used Free-Stall Housing for 15 Years
developments.summary: Eliziane and Sandro Arnholt run a dairy farm in Marmeleiro, Paraná, where 60 cows are milked each morning. Their operation has used free-stall housing for at least 15 years, while the family says unstable milk prices remain a central challenge.

developments.title: Nestlé India is preparing its tenth plant in Odisha and prioritizing dairy decarbonization
developments.summary: Nestlé India is preparing to inaugurate a manufacturing facility near Khurda, Odisha, its tenth plant in the country. The company says upstream dairy sourcing accounts for more than 70% of its sustainability footprint and is a central focus of its emissions work.

developments.title: Amit Shah will lay foundation for dairy plant amid ₹6,262 crore works
developments.summary: India’s co-operation minister Amit Shah will lay the foundation stone for a dairy plant in Alwar, Rajasthan, on August 16. He will also inaugurate dairy and cattle-feed facilities and launch development projects valued at ₹6,262 crore across 17 districts.

developments.title: A century-old co-operative launches an app to expand cheese consumption
developments.summary: Santa Clara has introduced a digital tool designed to offer ideas for consuming cheese and to promote dairy products more broadly. The launch took place at the 34th FestiQueijo in Carlos Barbosa, in Brazil’s Rio Grande do Sul state.

developments.title: Fondue Becomes a Winter Ritual in Santa Catarina
developments.summary: Fondue has become a central winter dish for visitors to the Santa Catarina highlands, where cold weather favours hot, rich food. In 2025, food accounted for 36% of tourists’ spending in the region, with fondue among the dishes they seek out, photograph and recommend.

developments.summary: Livestock production plays a vital role in food security and rural livelihoods, particularly in tropical regions, where methane emissions from ruminant animals contribute significantly to global greenhouse gas outputs. developments.summary: Tannins are plant-derived compounds that can improve animal health by modulating gut health, and reducing the incidence of diarrhea, also influencing the emissions of nitrous oxide and ammonia in animal manure. developments.title: Canadian Processors Accelerate Capital Investments Amid National Cottage Cheese Shortage
developments.summary: Canadian dairy processors invest millions, led by Gay Lea Foods' $200M Toronto expansion, to address surging cottage cheese demand.

developments.title: Whole-Farm Digital Twins Emerge to Simulate Herd Decision-Making
developments.summary: UW-Madison's RuFaS model creates digital twins of dairy farms, allowing veterinarians to simulate herd management decisions before implementation.

developments.title: California Dairies Test Vermifiltration as Alternative to Anaerobic Digesters
developments.summary: California dairy farms adopt earthworm and microbe biofilters as a scalable, low-cost alternative to anaerobic digesters for manure remediation.

developments.title: Canadian Dairy Sector Urges Ottawa to Defend Food Sovereignty in U.S. Trade Negotiations
developments.summary: Canadian dairy leaders urge Ottawa to defend supply management and resist further market access concessions in ongoing U.S. trade negotiations.

developments.title: New Zealand’s $10 Million RMA Fines Create Legal Uncertainty for Dairy Operators
developments.summary: New Zealand's new $10M RMA fine cap creates legal uncertainty for dairy farmers as the Environment Court evaluates sentencing proportionality for SMEs.

developments.title: California Dairy on Display at the California Restaurant Show
developments.summary: The California Milk Advisory Board (CMAB) is bringing culinary inspiration with California dairy to the California Restaurant Show, August 23-25 at the Anaheim Convention Center. MAB will showcase the diversity of dairy products – from [Read More ...]

developments.title: Join Us for Our Q3 Milk Check-In
developments.summary: Wednesday, Aug. 26, 2026 2-3 p.m. ET Join the NMPF team for its quarterly update on policy, economics and on-farm best practices—an informal chance to hear what’s top of mind in the dairy industry. This [Read More ...]

developments.title: Support MSU’s Dairy Programs through MMPA match campaigns
developments.summary: MMPA’s history with Michigan State University (MSU) goes back to the beginning with our founding in MSU’s Agriculture Hall, and for generations MSU has helped strengthen the dairy industry through research, education and outreach. In [Read More ...]

developments.title: More Than $10,000 Awarded to Dairy Students through Klussendorf and McKown Scholarships
developments.summary: Seven dairy students from across the U.S. have been awarded a total of $10,500 in scholarships from the Arthur B. Klussendorf Memorial Association and the McKown/Klussendorf Fund. The Klussendorf Scholarships have been granted to students [Read More ...]

developments.title: Fall Crop Sales Closing Deadline is September 30
developments.summary: The deadline to insure fall crops in the Northeast for the 2027 crop year is September 30, 2026. Insurable fall crops include barley, forage production and wheat. Coverage availability varies by county. Visit CropGrowers.com for [Read More ...]

developments.title: Bongards' Creameries Announces $135 Million Expansion of Process Cheese Facility in Bongards, Minnesota
developments.summary: Historic investment will increase production capacity by 180 million pounds annually, strengthen U.S. dairy manufacturing, and support growing domestic and international demand. CBongards' Creameries, one of the nation's leading farmer-owned dairy cooperatives, today announced plans to [Read More ...]

developments.title: Key performance areas to focus on with automated milking systems
developments.summary: Progressive Dairy / Ag Proud outlines AMS herd and robot KPIs: incomplete milkings, peak milk flow and box time, so farms can judge whether voluntary milking is delivering production and unit throughput.

developments.title: Don’t guess; test: Using forage analysis to stretch winter feed dollars
developments.summary: Ag Proud describes lot-based hay and haylage sampling, lab dry matter, protein and TDN values, and how forage tests replace guesswork when balancing winter dairy and cattle rations.

developments.title: Suffolk dairy farmers urge cattle owners to vaccinate against bluetongue
developments.summary: Suffolk dairy farmers are urging livestock owners to vaccinate cattle as bluetongue serotype 3 spreads across Britain. The Salisburys, whose herd was affected during the disease’s first UK outbreak in 2007, vaccinated their 100 cattle this spring.

developments.title: Poles bought more fresh dairy products in early 2026
developments.summary: Sales of fresh dairy products in Poland rose during the first half of 2026, according to NielsenIQ. Natural yoghurt recorded the strongest growth among the products cited, while plant-based alternatives also increased their sales.

developments.title: EU cheese prices fell 2.3% and butter prices 16.6%
developments.summary: Eurostat reported year-on-year declines in the prices of cheese, butter and other milk-derived fats across the European Union. Between June 2025 and June 2026, cheese prices decreased by 2.3%, while the butter category fell by 16.6%.

developments.title: Río Deva Opens a Museum of Liébana’s Cheese Tradition
developments.summary: Family cheesemaker Río Deva has opened a museum in Camaleño, Cantabria, focused on more than 1,000 years of cheesemaking in Liébana. The project links dairy production with the region’s history and gastronomic tourism.

developments.title: Bidlea Dairy draws visitors beside a neighbouring mini zoo
developments.summary: Bidlea Dairy Ice Cream Farm in Twemlow, Cheshire, has become a visitor attraction alongside Holmes Chapel Mini Zoo. The farm serves 24 rotating ice-cream flavours each day and has free entry and parking.

developments.title: Dairy farming and Formula One increasingly rely on data
developments.summary: Modern dairy farms use sensors and automated systems in ways comparable to the monitoring technology found in contemporary cars and Formula One. These tools track animals, manage feed, monitor milk and incorporate weather information into farm operations.

developments.title: Lactalis agrees to acquire Saputo’s UK business
developments.summary: Lactalis has signed a definitive agreement to buy Saputo’s UK business, its fourth dairy transaction this year. Saputo valued the deal at about £988m, while completion is expected by the end of the first quarter next year, subject to regulatory approval.

developments.title: Canadian Dairy Groups Urge Ottawa to Defend Food Sovereignty in U.S. Talks
developments.summary: Canada’s main dairy farmer and processor associations have jointly called on the federal government to reject further agricultural concessions in the review of the Canada-United States-Mexico Agreement. Their statement came before an August 19 tariff deadline and amid renewed U.S. pressure on Canada’s supply-management system.

developments.title: Gloria says Argentine dairy is an established global brand
developments.summary: Gloria has acquired 80% of Saputo’s local operation in Argentina, opening a new phase for the company. Guillermo Pérez Mazás, Gloria Argentina’s commercial manager, said the country’s dairy products benefit from international recognition and that the industry can compete in higher-value categories.

developments.title: New Zealand’s RMA Fines of $10m Create Legal Uncertainty for Dairy Operators
developments.summary: Changes to New Zealand’s Resource Management Act have lifted the maximum fine for companies from $600,000 to $10m and raised the individual limit from $300,000 to $1m. Environment Court cases are testing how the new ceilings apply to small and medium-sized businesses, including incorporated family dairy farms.

developments.title: BinDawood Considers Investing in Lithuania’s Dairy Sector
developments.summary: BinDawood Holding is assessing whether to build a dairy-processing plant in Lithuania or acquire part of an existing company. The Saudi group has been examining opportunities for about six months as Lithuania’s dairy farms and cattle numbers decline.

developments.title: UW-Madison Develops Digital Twins for Dairy-Farm Decisions
developments.summary: Researchers at the University of Wisconsin-Madison have developed RuFaS, an open-source model that simulates dairy-farm operations before management changes are made. The platform is intended to help veterinarians and herd managers assess veterinary, nutritional and environmental interventions across an entire farm.

developments.title: Brazil’s Dairy Industry Seeks Equal Conditions Against Argentina and Uruguay
developments.summary: Brazil’s dairy industry is calling for equal conditions when competing with Argentina and Uruguay. The appeal concerns differences in competitiveness within Mercosur.

developments.title: Congress eased non-dairy milk rules, but schools lag
developments.summary: A law passed in January gave public schools more ways to offer non-dairy milk, but many cafeterias have not changed their menus. The provisions face higher costs, limited federal guidance and different requirements for breakfast and lunch.

developments.title: Canadian dairy companies are expanding production amid a national cottage-cheese shortage
developments.summary: Gay Lea Foods will invest $200m to expand its Clayson Road dairy facility in Toronto, citing a national shortage of cottage cheese. Canadian output rose 15% year on year in the first quarter of 2026, while the company expects its expansion to be finished by 2028.

developments.title: New Zealand’s Feeder Calf Market Remains Firm
developments.summary: New Zealand’s feeder calf market has maintained strong demand despite warnings of possible El Niño-related dry conditions. July sales produced the season’s highest prices, while August values settled at lower but still active levels.

developments.title: California dairies test vermifiltration as an alternative to anaerobic digesters
developments.summary: California dairies are testing vermifiltration, a treatment that uses earthworms and aerobic microbes to process dairy wastewater. The approach can produce irrigation water and reduce ammonia emissions, while its carbon-credit treatment remains unsettled.

developments.title: Healthier Farm Animals Can Reduce Emissions per Unit
developments.summary: Research on livestock systems suggests that preventing disease can improve growth, fertility, survival and production while lowering greenhouse-gas emissions per litre of milk or kilogram of meat. A new international project, Halow, will examine when better animal health produces genuine climate benefits.

developments.title: At least 30 cattle die after drinking contaminated water in Edomex
developments.summary: At least 30 cattle died in Santiago Tianguistenco, State of Mexico, after drinking water from local lagoons and other bodies of water that producers believe was contaminated. Local livestock farmers are seeking an urgent environmental and toxicological investigation into suspected industrial and urban wastewater discharges.

developments.title: Saexi Invests R$5.5m in a Simbrasil Dairy Project
developments.summary: Saexi is investing R$5.5m in a dairy project in Minas Gerais based on Simbrasil cattle. The first operating phase is targeting 12,000 litres of milk a day from animals selected for milk output and tropical-climate adaptability.

developments.title: Rondônia’s Milk Supply-Chain Inquiry Gains 30 More Days
developments.summary: Rondônia’s inquiry into the milk supply chain has received an additional 30 days. The extension will allow the commission to complete pending investigative steps and assess material gathered from public and private entities.

developments.title: Grupo Lala expands its functional portfolio with Lala Griego
developments.summary: The Mexican dairy company has consolidated its Lala Griego Greek-style yoghurt line as part of its functional and value-added food portfolio. The product is positioned for consumers seeking higher-protein nutrition and convenient options for active lifestyles.

developments.title: Woolworths will phase out Farmers’ Own milk by mid-2027
developments.summary: Woolworths will withdraw its Farmers’ Own milk brand from Australian stores by mid-2027 as supplier agreements expire. The product has already disappeared from South Australian shelves, with other states scheduled to follow.

developments.title: Danone Plans Selective Price Increases Amid Cost Pressures
developments.summary: Danone expects to make selective price adjustments as renewed inflationary pressure affects its costs. The company said the measures are planned from the third quarter of 2026.

developments.title: NCDFI and Indian Army Extend Four-Decade Dairy Partnership
developments.summary: India’s National Cooperative Dairy Federation and the Indian Army have renewed a dairy procurement partnership that began in 1984. The arrangement was valued at ₹1,627 crore for 2025–26 and covered 22.60 crore litres of milk.

developments.title: Ishida and NPS will showcase packaging systems at Propak Cape
developments.summary: Ishida and National Packaging Systems (NPS) will present packaging and filling equipment at Propak Cape in South Africa. The exhibition will also feature Ishida’s Inspira snacks packing system, a stick-pack and sachet machine, and equipment from both companies’ existing ranges.

developments.title: ALDDN Expanded Women’s Financial Access in Nigeria’s Dairy Economy
developments.summary: The Advancing Local Dairy Development in Nigeria programme opened 12,299 formal bank accounts for women and helped self-help groups mobilise about ₦75 million in savings. The six-year initiative linked financial services with farmer organisations and cooperatives in rural dairy communities.

developments.title: Aavin delays milk deliveries in Coimbatore
developments.summary: Milk deliveries to distribution points in Coimbatore have arrived as much as three hours late for more than three weeks. Aavin attributed the disruption to a sharp increase in orders after private competitors raised prices, while agents also reported delays in returning transport trays.

developments.title: Dairy Cows Require Management After Producing High Milk Volumes
developments.summary: Highly specialised dairy cows may produce between 30 and more than 50 litres of milk a day, placing substantial demands on their energy, fluid and nutrient supplies. Post-milking routines focus on udder hygiene, access to fresh feed and water, rest, and balanced nutrition.

developments.title: Gay Lea Foods invests $200m to boost cottage cheese production amid Canadian shortage
developments.summary: Gay Lea Foods invests $200m to boost cottage cheese production amid Canadian shortage

developments.title: Global cheese market set to reach $328bn as consumer tastes evolve
developments.summary: Global cheese market set to reach $328bn as consumer tastes evolve

developments.title: The use of infrared thermography for diagnosing limb disorders in dairy cattle.
developments.summary: Limb disorders in dairy cattle, along with mastitis and reproductive disorders, are among the most serious health problems in dairy farming. They negatively affect animal welfare, reduce milk yield and cause substantial economic losses for farmers. Traditional diagnostic methods, such as visual locomotion scoring and hoof trimming, are limited by subjectivity, infrequent use and low effectiveness

developments.summary: Pest bird intrusion into British Columbia (BC) dairy farms has become increasingly problematic in recent years due to changes in agricultural land use practices and habitat disruption. developments.summary: Dairy goats sustain milk production across marginal environments worldwide, yet genetic improvement of milk yield and composition remains slower than in cattle, constrained by smaller reference populations and limited functional validation. developments.title: Woolworths Phasing Out Farmers’ Own Direct Milk Supply Model
developments.summary: Woolworths is phasing out its Farmers' Own milk brand by mid-2027, leaving direct-supply dairy farmers facing uncertain farmgate contracts.

developments.title: New Zealand Feeder Calf Market Holds Firm Despite El Niño Weather Warnings
developments.summary: New Zealand feeder calf markets remain resilient against El Niño dry weather fears as strong demand and dairy-beef genetics support prices.

developments.title: World’s First Floating Dairy Farm Put Up for Sale in Rotterdam
developments.summary: Rotterdam's pioneer floating dairy farm is for sale as floor defects, strict Dutch regulations, and port lease expiration force its closure.

developments.title: Saputo Dairy Australia Expands National Partnership to Fight Youth Food Insecurity
developments.summary: Saputo Dairy Australia partners with Eat Up to donate 400,000 cheese slices annually, helping feed students in 1,200 schools nationwide.

developments.title: New Zealand Dairy Farmer Launches Grocery Price-Comparison App
developments.summary: Otago dairy farmer Will Duff launches CheckMyTrolley, an app helping New Zealand shoppers compare supermarket cart prices and cut food costs.

developments.title: eDairyMarket Renews Its Technological Infrastructure to Support the Global Growth of Dairy Trade
developments.summary: The renowned B2B marketplace by DairyCorp completely revamped the technological architecture it has operated on for over a decade. Without interrupting service, the platform migrated more than 2,700 user accounts, added self-management tools for sellers, advanced search filters, and a secure environment operating in four languages.

developments.title: NAIDC Elects New Leadership for 2026-2027
developments.summary: North American Intercollegiate Dairy Challenge® (NAIDC) recently elected new leadership, including one new board member and the 2026 – 2027 Executive Committee. As stated in the NAIDC mission statement, the organization strives to “Develop [Read More ...]

developments.title: DairyVoice Podcast: What Farmer’s Need to Know About The New World Screwworm
developments.summary: In this episode of DairyVoice, host Connie Kuber with Sealpro Silage Barrier Films interviews Dr. Jamie Jonker, Chief Science Officer and Vice President of Sustainability & Scientific Affairs with the National Milk Producers Federation. They [Read More ...]

developments.title: Calculate Your Pounds of Components and Energy Corrected Milk
developments.summary: Free Tool Available On Our Website Did you know the Center has an interactive tool to help dairy producers calculate their pounds of components and energy corrected milk (ECM)? The free tool is designed to help [Read More ...]

developments.title: The marathon of genetics: Using indexes effectively
developments.summary: CDCB chief research officer John Cole tells Progressive Dairy that genetic indexes are a long-horizon tool: pick the index that matches how the farm is paid, stay consistent, and wait for daughters to express the decision.

developments.title: How return-alley water can help dairy cows beat heat stress
developments.summary: Kansas State Extension and Bovine Veterinarian report that a water trough at the parlor exit can capture about 10% of daily intake (≈3.5 gallons) immediately after milking, supporting heat-stress management, milk yield and fertility.

developments.title: Panama raises tariffs on US powdered milk to 28.1%
developments.summary: Panama has temporarily increased duties on certain imports of whole milk powder from the United States after shipments exceeded the threshold for an agricultural safeguard under the two countries’ trade agreement. Depending on the product category, the total tariff will rise to either 11.3% or 28.1%.

developments.title: Gay Lea Foods invests $200m in Toronto dairy plant
developments.summary: Gay Lea Foods is investing more than $200m to expand its Clayson Road dairy manufacturing facility in Toronto. The project will increase capacity for cottage cheese and other high-protein dairy products, with completion expected in 2028.

developments.title: DM Mexicana announces $100m Texas investment for goat-milk supplements
developments.summary: Mexican company DM Mexicana plans to invest $100m in a Texas production line for goat-milk nutritional supplements. The products are intended for specialised formulas and may be considered for child-health programmes in the state.

developments.title: Conaprole aims to keep milk prices stable through year-end
developments.summary: Conaprole plans to leave the price paid to milk producers unchanged in August and September. The cooperative is considering using its expected annual profit to maintain that level through the end of the year, although its president said this could not be guaranteed.

developments.title: Missouri Cattle Producer Questions MDA Grant Selection Process
developments.summary: A southern Missouri cattle producer has questioned how the Missouri Department of Agriculture selected recipients for its fiscal 2026 beef and dairy grants. The department said more than 3,300 applications were independently scored without using applicants’ names or locations.

developments.title: Dairy derivatives signal downside as spot demand holds
developments.summary: Dairy futures markets are indicating greater downside risk, while physical buying remains firm. A 5,000-lot SGX-NZX milk futures trade and Fonterra’s lower payout forecast contrast with stronger volumes at recent Global Dairy Trade auctions.

developments.title: Global dairy markets establish firmer footing amid production uncertainty
developments.summary: Milk collections increased in several major exporting countries during the middle of the year, while China recorded a decline in domestic output. Dairy-trade data showed stronger powder prices, softer dairy-fat prices and a 16.5% annual rise in New Zealand’s June exports.

developments.title: Strong returns are lifting New Zealand’s spring bull outlook
developments.summary: New Zealand’s livestock market is entering the spring yearling bull sale season with strong demand and high price expectations. Firm beef export returns, dairy valuations and growing dairy-beef integration are supporting interest from both dairy farmers and commercial beef producers.

developments.title: Crèmerie St-Edouard launches on-farm milk processing in Alberta
developments.summary: Nikki and Richard Brousseau have opened a small processing facility and shop at their dairy farm near St Edouard, Alberta. The operation uses vat pasteurisation and direct sales to offer unstandardised milk in reusable containers.

developments.title: Mexico Assesses First Leche para el Bienestar Collection Centre in Morelos
developments.summary: Mexico’s federal government is assessing a proposed milk collection centre in Tehuixtla, Morelos, with local authorities and the state’s agricultural department. The facility is planned to receive up to 30,000 litres of fresh milk a day and pay small producers a guaranteed price of 11.50 pesos per litre.

developments.title: Laticínios Union Receives Provisional Approval for Mais Leite Saudável
developments.summary: Laticínios Union has been provisionally admitted to Brazil’s Mais Leite Saudável programme after technical review of its project. Its participation will be monitored for three years and remains conditional on meeting fiscal and project requirements.

developments.title: Adecoagro says Profertil offset agricultural and dairy declines
developments.summary: Adecoagro reported EBITDA of $258.3m for the first half of 2026. The company said the result was supported by its fertiliser business, while agriculture and dairy operations in Argentina faced lower prices and higher dollar-denominated costs.

developments.title: Milk prices in Mato Grosso recovered as collection hit a historic low
developments.summary: Milk in Mato Grosso averaged R$2.03 per litre in the first half of 2026, down 12.12% from a year earlier. Recent monthly prices rose while the state’s milk-collection index fell to its lowest level in the historical series.

developments.title: A five-day blackout cost Santa Vitória’s dairy sector R$11,460
developments.summary: A five-day electricity outage in Santa Vitória do Palmar, Rio Grande do Sul, affected 15 dairy-producing families after a cyclone. The local Emater office estimated dairy-chain losses at R$11,460, while fishing losses in the municipality reached about R$621,000.

developments.title: India’s NPDD and AHIDF Schemes Expand Dairy Infrastructure
developments.summary: India’s government is using the National Programme for Dairy Development and the Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund to expand organised milk collection, chilling and processing. Milk output reached an estimated 247.87m tonnes in 2024-25, while daily per-person availability rose to 485 grams.

developments.title: Will Duff launches New Zealand grocery price-comparison app
developments.summary: Otago dairy farmer Will Duff has launched CheckMyTrolley, a free app that lets New Zealand shoppers compare the cost of customised grocery baskets across supermarket chains. The tool uses publicly available pricing data to identify the cheapest retailer for a selected basket on a given day.

developments.title: Australian Dairy Farmers Reconsider Long-Term Infrastructure Investment
developments.summary: Australian dairy businesses are replacing short-term equipment decisions with infrastructure planning focused on the next 15 to 20 years. Farmers are assessing new parlours, extensions to existing facilities and automation upgrades as they respond to labour constraints, ageing equipment and changing herd sizes.

developments.title: Restaurants in Chihuahua Face 40% Increases in Key Inputs
developments.summary: Restaurants in Chihuahua are facing increases of up to 40% in essential food supplies and dairy products. Operators are absorbing part of the higher costs while gradually changing menu prices, dishes and purchasing practices.

developments.title: Madhya Pradesh bans analogue paneer to protect dairy identity
developments.summary: Madhya Pradesh has prohibited the production, distribution and sale of analogue paneer across the state. Chief Minister Mohan Yadav said the measure would support authentic milk-based products, while officials cited consumer-health and food-labelling concerns.

developments.title: Arla asks Danish institutions to return milk crates
developments.summary: Arla is asking institutions in Denmark to recover milk crates that have left its circulation. Each returned crate will generate DKK 5 for the Arla Foundation, while participating institutions can enter a competition for a farm visit.

developments.title: Madurai milk agents oppose Aavin’s proposed retail rules
developments.summary: Milk agents and dairy retailers in Madurai have objected to Aavin’s plan to replace 20 existing operating conditions with 56 draft rules. They are challenging provisions on depot spacing, spoilage, handling duties and property disclosures.

developments.title: Chile’s dairy prices rose in July, while liquid milk fell 4.2%
developments.summary: Chile’s consumer-price index recorded monthly increases for powdered milk, butter, dairy desserts, yoghurt and cheese in July. Liquid milk was the exception, falling by 4.2% and ranking among the foods that made the largest negative contribution during the month.

developments.title: Evaporated Milk Differs from Condensed Milk in Sugar Content
developments.summary: Evaporated milk is made by removing part of the water from regular milk, concentrating its natural components. Unlike condensed milk, it does not typically contain a large amount of added sugar and can be used in both sweet and savoury dishes.

developments.title: Mozzarella Remains the Leading Cheese for Pizza
developments.summary: Mozzarella is widely regarded as the best all-round cheese for pizza because it melts evenly, stretches when hot and browns without burning quickly. The choice within the category depends on moisture: lower-moisture varieties can limit excess water, while fresh mozzarella suits brief baking in very hot ovens.

developments.title: Dairy Plants Can Reduce Fuel Consumption Without Switching to Alternative Energy Sources
developments.summary: Dairy processing plants can reduce fuel consumption and associated emissions by optimizing their steam systems—even before electrifying their boiler rooms or switching to hydrogen, biogas, and other low-carbon energy sources. This was stated by Joshua Townsend, Applications Engineering Supervisor at Miura America.

developments.title: CDCB launches first national genetic evaluations for calf health
developments.summary: The August 2026 CDCB evaluations add Resistance to Diarrhea (DIA) and Resistance to Respiratory Problems (RSP) PTAs for Holsteins and Jerseys, built from DHI calf-health records with USDA AGIL, plus revisions to DPR, CCR, HCR and a new First Service to Conception trait.

developments.title: Heat Stress Detection in Dairy Cattle Using Intraruminal Bolus Sensors.
developments.summary: Heat stress represents one of the most economically and biologically consequential environmental challenges facing modern dairy production, with projected intensification under ongoing climate change. developments.title: Feed bunk space in automated milking systems
developments.summary: Penn State Extension reviews AMS research linking bunk space to intake and milk: about 25–28 inches per cow is associated with higher yield versus crowding, and feed push-ups do not fully offset a short bunk.

developments.title: Seroepidemiology and biochemical alterations associated with Neospora caninum infection in dairy cows from the northeastern region of Algeria
developments.summary: Bovine neosporosis is a major cause of abortion and stillbirth in cattle, causing significant economic losses worldwide. This study aimed to determine Neospora caninum seroprevalence, identify its potential risk factors and investigate alterations in selected biochemical traits in cattle from five Northeastern Algerian provinces. developments.title: Wageningen Researchers Develop Precision Fermentation for Dairy Proteins
developments.summary: Scientists at Wageningen University have achieved a breakthrough in precision fermentation, producing casein proteins that match bovine milk structure at scale. The process uses engineered yeast strains and could reduce dairy's carbon footprint by 85%.

developments.title: Federal lawmakers propose year-round visas for Idaho dairy farms
developments.summary: Bipartisan federal legislation would create a year-round visa category for livestock and dairy workers, while offering legal-status options to some experienced undocumented farm employees. The proposal is intended to address labor shortages affecting dairy operations, including those in Idaho.

developments.title: Argentina Reopens Indonesia’s Dairy Market to Exports
developments.summary: Argentina signed a sanitary agreement with Indonesia at the end of July. The agreement enables Argentine beef exports and reopens Indonesia’s market to dairy products.

developments.title: Whey Prices Rise and Pressure Infant Nutrition
developments.summary: The main constraint in the whey market is processing capacity rather than the availability of raw whey, according to Booijink. Prices for high-protein derivatives such as WPC80 and WPI have risen more sharply than those for basic whey powder, while infant formula remains subject to strict nutritional requirements.

developments.title: European milk prices fluctuated as butter prices continued to fall
developments.summary: The average European milk price paid by processors fell to €40.04 per 100kg in June, including bonuses, although movements varied between countries and companies. Prices remained below their levels in June 2025 and June 2024, while butter prices declined after a temporary improvement in June.

developments.title: EU Milk Production Rose 3.7% and Expanded Dairy Supply
developments.summary: Milk deliveries to processors in the European Union increased by 3.7% between January and May 2026 compared with the same period a year earlier. The expansion coincided with higher output in Australia, New Zealand and the United States, while EU dairy-product production varied by category.

developments.title: US lawmakers debate Farm Bill as Southern Cone exports shift
developments.summary: The Senate Agriculture Committee has advanced its review of the US Farm Bill 2026, prompting disputes over nutrition assistance, small farms and foreign land-investment rules. Meanwhile, Argentina increased dairy export volumes and destinations, while Chile and Uruguay recorded different movements in prices, shipments and markets.

developments.title: Bongards commits $135m to expand process-cheese facility
developments.summary: Bongards plans to invest $135m in an expansion of its process-cheese facility. The project will add about 120,000 square feet and raise annual manufacturing capacity by 180m pounds once fully operational.

developments.title: U.S. Dairy Exports Rose 9% and Reached Record Value
developments.summary: U.S. dairy exports increased by 9% in milk-solids-equivalent terms during the first half of 2026, while their value rose 12% to a record $5.31bn. Cheese and butterfat shipments led the expansion, offsetting lower exports of whey protein concentrates and non-fat dry milk.

developments.title: Canterbury Dairy Conversions Increase Demand for North Island Cows
developments.summary: Dairy conversions in Canterbury are creating a shortage of cattle in New Zealand’s South Island, prompting farm businesses to buy livestock from the North Island. Regional consents could add at least 25,000 cows to the milk pool over coming seasons, while strong demand has raised procurement and transport costs.

developments.title: A Canadian Trial Challenges Saturated-Fat Limits for Dairy Products
developments.summary: A Canadian trial found no changes in several cardiovascular and metabolic measures when participants consumed equivalent amounts of saturated fat from whole milk, aged cheddar and butter. The findings were presented as evidence that the structure of whole dairy foods may affect how their fats are processed.

developments.title: Fonterra lowers its farmgate milk-price forecast
developments.summary: Fonterra has reduced its forecast for the current season’s farmgate milk price, citing weaker Global Dairy Trade auction results. The change is expected to put pressure on cash flow for New Zealand dairy producers as they review spending and financing plans.

developments.title: Irish Farmers Warn Autumn Milk Supplies Will Fall Significantly
developments.summary: Ireland’s dairy farmers say milk deliveries are highly likely to decline significantly this autumn as drought conditions reduce grass availability and raise feeding costs. The Irish Creamery Milk Suppliers’ Association is urging co-operatives to increase prices, while Lakeland Dairies has raised its July base price in the Republic of Ireland to 38.5c/L.

developments.title: Processors end milk contracts as dairy farms face exits
developments.summary: Australian dairy processors are not renewing some milk contracts as they adjust collection networks and manage fluctuating intake against tight operating margins. Affected farms may have difficulty finding replacement buyers, particularly where alternative processors have limited capacity or do not accept new suppliers.

developments.title: Australia Tightens Dairy Code as Processors Obscure Price Signals
developments.summary: Australia is tightening its mandatory dairy code after processors published purchasing agreements close to statutory deadlines and used complex pricing formulas or broad ranges instead of fixed minimum payments. The changes follow a review that called for longer notice periods, wider definitions of exceptional circumstances and a framework for resolving disputes involving several parties.

developments.title: Aguascalientes produces 1.5m litres of milk daily
developments.summary: Aguascalientes is producing about 1.5m litres of milk a day, according to the state’s agri-food council. Nearly 1m litres are sent daily to other Mexican states for supply and processing.

developments.title: Jacob Wellock buys two heifers at Skipton
developments.summary: Jacob Wellock made his first appearance as a dairy judge at CCM Skipton Auction Mart in early August and later bought two heifers from the sale. The show champion sold for £2,900, while Wellock secured the reserve champion for £2,700.

developments.title: Peter Mulheron installed a portable solar-and-battery microgrid
developments.summary: Dairy farmer Peter Mulheron installed a 105kW solar system paired with 241kWh of battery storage at his farm in south-west Victoria. The portable microgrid is designed to match the farm’s electricity demand, which continues before sunrise and after sunset, while supplying about 90% of its grid consumption.

developments.title: Arla finds British dairy farmers struggle to recruit skilled workers
developments.summary: A survey by Arla found that 82% of British dairy farmers with vacancies received few or no applications from candidates with the necessary skills. Almost 65% said improved education and training was the most effective way to attract more people to the sector.

developments.title: United Dairy Farmers and Grippo Foods launch Fun Food Crunch
developments.summary: United Dairy Farmers and Grippo Foods are introducing Fun Food Crunch, a limited-time Homemade Brand ice-cream flavour combining popcorn ice cream, barbecue-spiced caramel and chocolate-covered pretzel pieces. The co-branded 16-ounce pints will reach Cincinnati-area Kroger stores and more than 170 UDF locations during the week of August 16.

developments.title: Study finds full-fat dairy may be healthier than previously thought
developments.summary: A 12-week University of Toronto study found no meaningful changes in weight, body composition, cholesterol or insulin resistance among adults consuming three daily servings of dairy. Participants who ate more dairy also recorded improved blood pressure and higher intakes of calcium, protein and vitamin D.

developments.title: Uttarakhand’s Proposed Policy Shift Emphasises Preventive Dairy Safety
developments.summary: Uttarakhand is considering a dairy-safety policy centred on preventive, science-based monitoring. The approach would distinguish between safely handled loose milk and inherently unsafe dairy products, rather than treating packaging format as the sole standard.

developments.title: Indian sweet makers face rising dairy input costs
developments.summary: Indian confectioners are reassessing retail prices as milk, khoya, paneer and ghee become more expensive before the autumn festive season. Some shops are raising prices, while others are absorbing the higher costs in anticipation of strong seasonal sales.

developments.title: Tasty Dairy Specialities Reports a First-Quarter Loss
developments.summary: Tasty Dairy Specialities reported a financial loss for the quarter ended June 2026. Revenue fell 18.08% sequentially from Rs 16.98 crore in the March quarter, while the net loss was slightly smaller than the previous quarter’s Rs 0.36 crore.

developments.title: Sharpham Cheese wins two three-star Great Taste Awards
developments.summary: Sharpham Cheese has received two three-star ratings in the 2026 Great Taste Awards for its Savour and Ticklemore cheeses. The result follows the dairy’s three-star award for Cremet in 2023 and precedes its entries in two Golden Forks categories.

developments.title: A Minas Gerais Farmer Doubled Milk Output with a Compost Barn
developments.summary: Alisson Gonzaga increased average milk production from 18 to 40 litres per cow per day after adopting the Compost Barn system at his farm in Divinópolis, Minas Gerais. The change replaced pasture-based management with a covered, open-sided barn and a managed organic bedding system.

developments.title: The future of herd decision-making may be virtual
developments.summary: University of Wisconsin–Madison’s open-source Ruminant Farm Systems (RuFaS) model is presented as a whole-farm digital twin (animals, manure, soil, crops, feed storage) so vets and advisers can test what-if herd decisions before applying them on farm.

developments.title: Knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding brucellosis in the West Bank, Palestine: high awareness and persistent risk behaviors
developments.summary: Brucellosis is a significant disease that can spread from infected livestock to humans, mainly through consuming unpasteurized dairy products or direct contact with animals. The disease remains endemic in the Middle East, including Palestine. This study examines the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) regarding brucellosis among adults in the West Bank. developments.summary: Livestock farming is a major source of antibiotic resistance in the environment. Although supplementing selenium improves the GI-tract microecosystem and host metabolomes, nano-selenium effects on rumen microbiome and resistome remain limited. developments.summary: Aerobic composting of cattle manure is often limited by slow humification and long duration. This study evaluated a staged inoculation strategy using phase-specific microbial consortia to enhance composting efficiency. developments.summary: The South Bandung Livestock Cooperative (KPBS) Pangalengan operated an upstream-to-downstream milk procurement system that involved farmers, Milk Collection Points (MCPs), and Dairy Processing Industries (IPS), within which a set of policies was enforced to control the quantity and quality of fresh milk. developments.summary: Khoya (khoa or mawa) is a traditional dairy product, prepared by heating and concentrating milk, which is widely used in preparation of indigenous milk sweets.
