developments.title: Wisconsin Cheese Makers Association urges Senate committee to advance Farm Bill
developments.summary: The Wisconsin Cheese Makers Association has asked the Senate Agriculture Committee to resume bipartisan negotiations on the Farm Bill after a 10-11 vote left the package stalled. The proposed legislation included measures on dairy processing, exports, nutrition programmes and farm risk management.

developments.title: US Dairy Farmers Add High-Oleic Soybeans to Cow Feed
developments.summary: Dairy farms in the US Midwest and Northeast are using high-oleic soybeans in customised feed rations. The beans contain more oleic acid than conventional soybeans and can command a premium for growers.

developments.title: U.S. Dairy Groups Press Mexico Over Cheese Names in USMCA Review
developments.summary: The National Milk Producers Federation and the U.S. Dairy Export Council have raised cheese-naming and geographical-indication issues in bilateral talks on the review of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement. They are seeking continued commercial use in Mexico of terms including feta, asiago, gruyere and gorgonzola.

developments.title: New Zealand’s planned fuel-tax increases threaten rural transport margins
developments.summary: New Zealand plans to raise fuel excise from early 2027, beginning with an increase of 12 cents per litre. Rural freight operators and primary producers face higher transport costs for milk collection, fertiliser distribution and stock cartage.

developments.title: US Dairy Targets Sub-Saharan Africa for Long-Term Growth
developments.summary: The US Dairy Export Council is focusing on Kenya, Senegal, Ghana and Ivory Coast as potential growth markets for American dairy exports. Its approach centres on developing trade links, improving cold-chain capacity and working with local commercial partners.

developments.title: Everett Thorburn built New Zealand’s cattle-genetics trade in Europe
developments.summary: A newly published book recounts Everett Thorburn’s career from farming and opera to marketing New Zealand bovine genetics in European markets. It describes how he used scientific breeding data and commercial trading to promote pasture-based cattle genetics beyond New Zealand.

developments.title: Canadian Grocers Reorganize Dairy Aisles Around Protein and Gut Health
developments.summary: Canadian grocery retailers are changing dairy merchandising as shoppers place greater emphasis on protein, digestion and functional nutrition. The Canadian dairy market is projected to reach US$16.9 billion this year, while more than 70% of consumers seek to raise their daily protein intake.

developments.title: Havanna marks 20 years in Brazil with dairy bets
developments.summary: Argentine confectionery brand Havanna is marking two decades in Brazil by expanding its ice-cream franchise model and developing dairy-linked products. The company has sold 160 Heladerias franchises in the model’s first year and expects them to generate 25% of its Brazilian revenue by 2029.

developments.title: El Niño Puts 250,000 Litres of Daily Milk Production at Risk
developments.summary: A dairy-producing area in Sergipe is facing shortages of silage and water as El Niño affects farming conditions. Santa Rosa do Ermírio produces about 250,000 litres of milk a day, and local producers say output could fall by up to 20%.

developments.title: U.S. company Planet Green enters the disputed lactoferrin market
developments.summary: Planet Green is preparing to expand into the lactoferrin market, an ingredient sector growing at an estimated 9% a year. The company is also planning to appoint a chief scientist to guide research, investment and product development.

developments.title: Wisconsin’s Sheep and Goat Cheese Sector Expands
developments.summary: Wisconsin has expanded its role in US sheep and goat dairying as demand grows for specialty cheeses made from non-bovine milk. The state has 14 sheep-dairy farms and about 78,000 dairy goats, according to state agricultural data.

developments.title: New York State Fair Sets Dairy Day for September 3
developments.summary: The Great New York State Fair will hold its annual Dairy Day in Syracuse on Thursday, September 3. The 49th edition will include industry awards, public exhibits and interactive activities focused on New York’s dairy sector.

developments.title: Jefferson County Landowner Prepares Site for Buyers as Southern Dairy Talks Slow
developments.summary: Ron Robbins is advancing approval work on his Jefferson County property after communication with Southern Dairy declined over the past four months. The Texas company says it remains committed to a dairy-processing plant in the Watertown area and is still interested in the land.

developments.title: Piá suspends production as Tirol weighs buying its brand
developments.summary: Piá has halted output at its dairy plant in Nova Petrópolis, Rio Grande do Sul, and placed employees on collective leave. The co-operative carries liabilities exceeding R$200m, while Santa Catarina-based Tirol is assessing a purchase of the Piá brand.

developments.title: Silva Capital acquires Cobungra Station for an estimated $50.3m
developments.summary: Silva Capital has unconditionally acquired Victoria’s 31,292-hectare Cobungra Station for an estimated $50.3 million. The fund plans to add native plantings and shelter belts while maintaining existing cattle operations, prompting calls for regulatory scrutiny.

developments.title: Caquetá’s livestock model expands and inspires eight Colombian departments
developments.summary: A livestock model developed in Caquetá is expanding across Colombia and has attracted interest from eight departments. Its approach combines dairy processing at farms with land management and environmental monitoring.

developments.title: Spain’s Cheese Consumption Grows as Imports Capture Much of the Increase
developments.summary: Spanish cheese sales rose by 3.6% to 463,110 tonnes between June 2025 and June 2026, while packaged liquid milk sales fell by about 1.4%. Cheese imports reached a record 435,000 tonnes in 2025, more than three times Spain’s exports.

developments.title: IDF World Dairy Summit 2026 has confirmed more than 100 speakers
developments.summary: The IDF World Dairy Summit 2026 has announced more than 100 international speakers. The event will take place in New Zealand from November 15th to 20th, with registration already open.

developments.title: Cotija cheese makers fight to preserve artisanal tradition amid succession and regulatory barriers
developments.summary: Only about 20 families in Mexico’s Sierra Jal-Mich region still make Cotija cheese by traditional methods. Their collective trademark allows sales in selected markets, but the Mexican Institute of Industrial Property has denied the product an appellation of origin after nearly two decades of applications.

developments.title: Toluca reopens Lechería para el Bienestar in San Mateo Oxtotitlán
developments.summary: Toluca’s municipal government has reopened a Lechería para el Bienestar outlet in San Mateo Oxtotitlán, Estado de México, with an initial register of 230 beneficiary families. The subsidised fortified-milk programme is intended to expand to 70 distribution points in the municipality this year.

developments.title: Irish Milk Prices Stayed Steady as Drought Cut Supply
developments.summary: Irish dairy processors made limited changes to milk payments as drought-related supply reductions supported market values. Kerry Agribusiness raised its base payout to 44c/L, while Lakeland Dairies lifted its baseline offer to 43.5c/L.

developments.title: India Targets Global Leadership in Dairy Exports
developments.summary: India is redirecting dairy policy from domestic self-sufficiency towards larger international trade, supported by annual milk production of 248m tonnes. The strategy focuses on disease-free zones, genetic improvement and upgraded infrastructure for value-added dairy exports to markets in Asia and the Middle East.

developments.title: Paraná Was Compared with Global Benchmarks in Milk Production
developments.summary: A seminar at Agroleite 2026 compared Paraná’s milk production with international references. The programme covered technology, markets and the public perception of Brazilian dairy farming.

developments.title: Llanforda Estate could expand Trefarclawdd dairy farm
developments.summary: Llanforda Estate is seeking permission to add two buildings and increase its dairy herd near Oswestry to 1,000 cows. Shropshire Council’s Northern Planning Committee is due to consider the application on August 18, despite objections from a parish council, six households and the council’s drainage department.

developments.title: Copacol tops ranking ahead of Nestlé and Unilever
developments.summary: Copacol, a co-operative based in Paraná, ranked first in GrowinC’s CPG Leaders 100, which assessed more than 21,000 fast-moving consumer-goods companies operating in Brazil. It scored 85.6 points, ahead of Unilever and Nestlé.

developments.summary: A longitudinal study of 2,400 Holstein cows found that specific gut microbiome signatures predict milk fat percentage with 78% accuracy. The findings open pathways for probiotic interventions in dairy nutrition.
